name: ハンドドリップ抽出タイマー・コーヒー日記：Gota
description:
毎日のコーヒーを、もう一段階おいしく。
ハンドドリップを楽しむすべての人へ。ステップ式タイマー、レシピ、抽出記録をひとつのアプリに。

■ 93種類の抽出方法、1,000を超えるレシピ
V60、エアロプレス、ケメックス、カリタウェーブ、オリガミ、オレア、フレンチプレス、モカポット、コールドブリュー、サイフォンなど、主要な抽出器具に対応。バリスタやワールド・ブリュワーズ・カップのファイナリストによるレシピを、分量、水量、比率、挽き目、温度、タイマー付きの注ぎ手順まで収録しています。

■ ステップ式抽出タイマー
レシピを選ぶと、タイマーが各ステップを自動で進めます。蒸らし、注ぎ、待ち、スワール — 視覚と音のガイドで、時計を見ずに抽出に集中できます。

■ Bluetoothスケール
対応するAcaiaスケールで、タイマー付きレシピの重量と注湯の流量をリアルタイム表示。目標重量を音で知らせ、注湯カーブを抽出履歴に保存できます。スケールなしでも抽出できます。

■ 音声ガイドと音声コントロール
各ステップを適切なタイミングで読み上げ、あなたは声で答えるだけ。「完了」「一時停止」「終了」と言えば、画面に触れずに抽出が進みます。手がふさがっていても大丈夫。オンにするかどうかは、あなたが決められます。

■ Live Brew 動画
カメラで抽出を撮影すると、アプリが動画を仕上げます。手順、重量、時間があなたの映像に重なり、最後はあなたの評価で締めくくり。そのまま共有できます。

■ AIバリスタ
最初の一投の前に、その豆での過去の抽出、お使いの器具、豆の鮮度を読み取り、設定を用意します。飲み終えたあとは、次の一杯のための調整をひとつだけ提案します。

■ AIによるレシピ・豆スキャン
レシピカードやコーヒー豆の袋を撮影するだけで、内容を自動で読み取ります。手入力は不要です。

■ 抽出ログと評価
一杯ごとに評価、フレーバータグ、テイスティングノートを記録。続けるほど、自分の好みに合うレシピと豆、そして好みの移り変わりが見えてきます。

■ インサイト
今飲んでいるコーヒーと次の一杯への提案を確認。記録した抽出をもとに、傾向と履歴を振り返れます。

■ 豆の管理
ロースター、原産地、プロセス、焙煎度を登録。袋ごとに抽出ログと紐づけて、どの豆がどの方法に合うかが見えてきます。

■ 挽き目ガイドとグラインダー
極細から極粗まで、挽き目を視覚的に確認できます。抽出方法ごとの推奨範囲つき。お使いのグラインダーを登録すれば、各レシピの挽き目が自分のクリック数で表示されます。

■ オリジナルレシピの作成
ステップ、注湯量、流速、タイミングを自由に設定して、自分だけのレシピを作成。QRコードやリンクで友人やお店と共有できます。

■ 学ぶ
豆、基本、淹れ方、テクニック、カッピングの5章・39レッスン。手を動かせるデモと、51語の用語集つきです。

■ さらに
コールドブリューアシスタント、SCAのブリューイング・コントロール・チャートを使った抽出計算ツール、抽出方法ごとの対応フィルター、お使いの器具の管理。

■ シンプルで集中できるデザイン
ダークモードに対応。グラム/オンス、摂氏/華氏の切り替えも可能です。日本語、英語、ドイツ語、スペイン語、韓国語、ポルトガル語で利用できます。

■ Gota Pro について
すべての抽出レシピ、無制限のオリジナルレシピ、AI機能（スキャン、バリスタ、コールドブリューアシスタント）を、月額または年額のサブスクリプションでご利用いただけます。

Gota は、家でも店でも、一杯のコーヒーに丁寧に向き合うすべての人のために作られました。

name: レシピを検索し管理するREPICI
description:
「きょうの献立、すぐ決まる。」

REPICI(レピシ) は、レシピサイトやレシピ本、オリジナルレシピなどあらゆるレシピを検索・管理することができるレシピ検索・管理アプリです。
煩わしい会員登録が不要で、無料で以下の機能がご利用いただけます。

主な機能
--------------------------------------------------------
■ 今日作るレシピだけを登録して、一覧表示できる「今日つく」
お気に入りに追加することなく、今日作るレシピだけを登録して、一覧表示できます。そのままカレンダーで過去に遡ることも可能なので、いつどんな献立だったかを後から確認することも可能です。未来や過去の日付に登録することも可能なので、来週の献立を一気に考える、みたいな使い方も簡単です。メモも追加できるので、お買い物メモや献立の感想などを書き込むことも可能です。

■ レシピ画面を手を触れずにスクロールさせる「かざしてスクロール」
レシピの画面に手を触れなくてもスクロールさせることができます。もうこれで、料理中に手が汚れていても全く気にすることなくレシピの続きを見ることができます。

■ レシピサイト横断検索
30以上のレシピサイトを横断検索することができます。検索したいレシピサイトだけを選んだり、検索したくないレシピサイトを外したりもワンタップで可能です。さらに、レシピサイトをジャンル別に検索できるので、投稿系やプロのレシピ系、スイーツ系、動画系などその時の探しているレシピに応じた検索ができます！お気に入りレシピサイトだけをまとめて「いつものサイト」として、それだけで検索することもできます！そして、ハッシュタグにも対応！ハッシュタグをつけてメモれば、ハッシュタグで検索できます。

■ マイレシピの登録
あなたのレシピを簡単に追加することができます。レシピ本を撮影してそれを写真で登録する「写真でレシピ」、直接レシピを入力して登録する「手入力でレシピ」、好きなレシピが載っているURLを入力して登録する「URLでレシピ」の３通りの登録方法があります。さらにマイレシピは、印刷およびPDFでのエクスポートができます。

■ Safari から登録
Safariでネットサーフィン中に見つけたブログや動画などのレシピをREPICIに送ることができます。Safariの下部中央にあるシェアアイコンをタップしてREPICIを選んでください。表示されない場合は、「その他」からREPICIを探して「有効」にしてください。

■ お気に入りの検索とiCloudでの共有
お気に入りレシピの検索も可能。タイトルやメモにいれたテキストを検索することができます。ハッシュタグにも対応しています。さらに、同じiCloud IDでログインしているIOS端末間でお気に入りの共有ができます。

■ お気に入りの自動バックアップ（登録したお写真等の画像は除く）
アプリがバックグラウンドに移行したタイミングでお気に入りのバックアップファイルを作成します。最新の30件のバックアップが常にローカルに保持されますので、お気に入りの不具合発生時にいつでもバックアップファイルから復元することができます。

--------------------------------------------------------
さらに、有料のREPICIアドバンス(12ヶ月/300円)に登録すると、以下の機能が有効になります。

■ フルバックアップ
アプリの全てのデータをサーバーにバックアップすることができます。もちろん、復元も可能です。万が一の場合に備えるだけでなく、機種変更時にもご利用可能です。機種変更時は旧端末で端末IDをコピーして、新端末で復元時にコピーしておいた端末IDをペーストするだけで、登録したお写真等の画像も含めて全てのデータを移行可能です。

■アプリ内広告削除
アプリ内広告をすべて削除します。
※ 外部サイト内の広告は削除対象外となります。

その他にも今後、さらなる機能追加を予定しています。

---------------------------
■ REPICIアドバンスの仕組みについて

【お支払い方法】
・REPICIアドバンスは年額300円（税込）です。
・お使いのApple IDアカウントに課金されます。
・申込日から起算して1年(12ヶ月)ごとに自動更新されます。
・REPICIアドバンスの無料期間中にApp Storeの画面上から有料でREPICIアドバンスに登録すると、その時点で無料期間が終了し、料金が発生します。

【自動更新の詳細】
・ REPICIアドバンスの有料期間の終了日の24時間以上前に自動更新を解除しない限り、会員期間は自動更新されます。
・自動更新後の料金は、会員期間終了日の24時間前までに請求されます。

【会員状況の確認・退会（自動更新の解除）方法】
会員状況の確認と退会は下記より可能です。

1. 「設定」アプリを開く
2. 最上部のご自身のユーザー名をタップ
3. 「サブスクリプション」から「REPICIアドバンス」を選択
4. 最下部の「サブスクリプションをキャンセルする」をタップ。
次回の自動更新日時の確認や、自動更新の解除・設定はこの画面にてお願いいたします。

なお、REPICIアプリ上からREPICIアドバンスの有料契約の解除を行うことはできませんのでご了承ください。

name: レシピポケット レシピ管理＆翻訳
description:
日本初！翻訳できるレシピアプリ！

海外のレシピサイトや外国語のレシピを、日本語に翻訳して読める。それが「レシピポケット」です。気になった世界中のレシピを、言葉の壁を気にせず、自分のレシピ帳にためていけます。

■ 海外レシピも、日本語で読める（翻訳機能）
英語・フランス語・イタリア語・中国語・韓国語など、外国語のレシピをアプリ内で日本語に翻訳して表示します。翻訳した内容はそのまま保存でき、材料や手順を自分の使いやすいように書き換えてカスタマイズすることも可能です。翻訳は無料で15回までお試しいただけます（以後はレシピポケット Plus）。海外サイトで見つけた憧れのレシピが、あなたのキッチンで作れる一品に変わります。

■ URLを貼るだけで取り込み
レシピページのURLをコピーして貼り付けるだけで、材料や手順を自動で読み取って保存します。SafariやSNSで見つけたレシピは、共有メニューから「レシピポケット」を選ぶだけで直接送れます。JavaScriptで作られたサイトにも対応した取り込みエンジンで、幅広いページからレシピを集められます。

■ Webからレシピを探せる（見つける）
アプリの中でレシピを検索できます。料理名や食材を入れるだけで、国内外のレシピサイトやYouTubeを横断して検索。気になったレシピはワンタップでそのまま保存できます。「これから作るものを探したい」ときも、アプリひとつで完結します。

■ 使い方ガイドを内蔵。はじめてでも迷わない
アプリの中に「使い方」ガイドを用意しました。レシピの取り込み方、共有メニューからの送り方、検索の使い方まで、手順を図入りで一つずつ確認できます。困ったときにすぐ開けるので、説明書を探す手間はありません。はじめての方でも、迷わず使い始められます。

■ インストール後すぐ使える、おすすめレシピ入り
ダウンロードした直後から、すぐに試せるおすすめレシピが入っています。空っぽの画面とにらめっこすることなく、最初のレシピを開いて、使い心地をその場で確かめられます。

■ 自分でレシピを作って登録
お店の味や、家族から受け継いだレシピも手入力で登録できます。材料・手順・分量に加えて、タグやメモも自由に書き込めるので、あなただけのレシピ帳が育っていきます。

■ iCloudで、いつでもどこでも同じレシピ
iPhoneで保存したレシピは、iCloudを通じて他の端末でも見られます。キッチンではiPad、買い物中はiPhone。同じレシピをいつでも手元に。

■ 見やすさにも配慮
文字のコントラストなど、読みやすさに配慮した画面づくりを心がけています。料理中の少し離れた場所からでも、手順を確認しやすくしています。


集めて、訳して、作る。世界中のレシピが、あなたのポケットの中に。
今日の一品を、「レシピポケット」と一緒に。

【主な機能】
・海外レシピの翻訳表示・保存（多言語対応）
・URL貼り付け／共有メニューからの取り込み
・Webレシピ検索（見つける）
・アプリ内・使い方ガイド
・おすすめレシピをプリイン
・手動でのレシピ作成（材料・手順・分量・タグ・メモ）
・iCloud同期
・読みやすさへの配慮（コントラスト等）

※一部の機能は、レシピポケット Plus（有料）でご利用いただけます。詳しくはアプリ内の「使い方」「Plusでできること」をご覧ください。

name: BrewLab
description:
コーヒーを、科学する。

BrewLabは、学術論文に基づいたアルゴリズムで、あなたのコーヒー豆に最適なレシピを生成するアプリです。勘や経験に頼らず、科学的な根拠から「なぜこの湯温・粉量・注ぎ方が良いのか」を提示します。

■ AIパッケージ解析

TapCook plans your dinners for the week and tells you what the groceries will cost before you leave the house.

Instead of deciding at 6pm, scrolling for ideas, and finding out the damage at the register, TapCook builds the week and the shopping list together — and keeps the total under the budget you set. Tick off the staples already in your cupboard and they come off the bill, this week and every week after. Don't like a dinner? Swap it and the list updates.

TapCook is currently available for US grocery stores only.

TapCook subscriptions are $9.99/month, or $29.99/year with a 7-day free trial on the yearly plan.

*Grocery Prices in TapCook are estimates, not live prices from any retailer. They start from a national reference price for each ingredient and are adjusted for the chain and region you choose. Real prices change often and vary by branch, so your checkout total will differ. TapCook is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to any grocery store, and store names are used only to show which one a plan was priced against.

*Always review ingredients, measurements, cooking instructions, food-safety guidance, and allergy information before cooking. Dietary and "won't eat" settings are a convenience, not an allergen control.

Have an idea, question, or issue? Email us at: support@tapcook.co

name: 타베로그 Tabelog - 일본 현지 맛집 찾기
description:
여행 전이나 여행 중에도 일본 최고의 로컬  맛집을 찾고, 리뷰를 확인하고, 테이블을 예약해보세요.

타베로그(Tabelog)는 일본 현지인과 여행자 모두에게 신뢰받는 일본 최고의 레스토랑 검색, 음식 리뷰, 테이블 예약 앱입니다. 일본 전역 80만 개 이상의 레스토랑과 8,200만 건이 넘는 실제 이용자 음식 평가 및 리뷰를 보유하고 있어, 일본에서 어디에서 먹을지 믿고 선택할 수 있는 가장 쉬운 방법입니다.

여행을 계획 중이든, 혼자 떠나는 여행이든, 혹은 근처에서 저렴하게 식사할 곳을 찾고 있든, 타베로그는 모든 순간에 맞는 레스토랑을 찾도록 도와줍니다. 스시, 야키니쿠, 라멘, 이자카야부터 카페, 디저트, 다양한 세계 요리까지 도쿄, 교토, 오사카 등 일본 전역에서 현지인들이 사랑하는 맛집을 만나보세요.

타베로그를 여행 가이드이자 음식 플래너로 활용해 보세요. 현재 위치 근처나 일본 어디든 레스토랑을 검색하고, 메뉴, 상세한 음식 리뷰, 사진, 실제 방문객의 팁을 확인할 수 있습니다. 음식 평점을 비교하고 좌석이 있는 경우 즉시 테이블 예약도 가능합니다.

한국에서 일본 여행을 계획 중이신가요? 타베로그는 해외 여행자를 위해 다음과 같은 편리한 기능을 제공합니다.
・현재 위치 근처 또는 일본 전역의 인기 점심·저녁 맛집 검색
・현지인들에게 사랑받는 동네 라멘집, 레스토랑, 카페 발견
・실시간 좌석 현황을 확인하고 테이블 예약 가능
・다국어 메뉴 및 캐시리스 결제 가능 매장 확인
・마음에 드는 장소를 저장하고 여행 일정을 간편하게 계획
・데이트, 가족 여행, 혼밥, 단체 모임에 맞는 레스토랑 추천
・방문 전 다국어 메뉴 및 카드 결제 결제 지원 여부 확인

타베로그를 선택해야 하는 6가지 이유:
1. 일본 전역 80만 개 이상의 레스토랑 — 도쿄와 교토만이 아닙니다
2. 실제 방문객이 남긴 신뢰할 수 있는 8,200만 건 이상의 음식 리뷰와 평점
3. 전국 300만 명의 등록 리뷰어가 매일 사진과 리뷰를 게시
4. 지도로 쉽게 찾을 수 있는 레스토랑 검색 기능
5. 실시간 좌석 확인이 가능한 온라인 예약
6. 개인 리스트로 맛집을 저장하고 식사 일정을 계획 가능
*매장 수는 2024년 5월 기준, 자사 조사에 따름.

여행 중 식사 계획부터 근처 저렴한 맛집 검색까지, 타베로그는 일본 여행 시 잊지 못할 미식 경험을 위한 레스토랑 탐색, 음식 발견, 로컬 맛집 예약을 모두 책임지는 필수 앱입니다.

name: Your Secret Menu for Starbucks
description:
500개 이상의 시크릿 메뉴 음료, 틱톡에서 화제인 인기 음료, 그리고 다음 커피 타임에 즐길 수 있는 다양한 커스텀 레시피를 만나보세요.

피드에서 계속 보이던 그 음료? 어떤 재료가 들어가는지 확인하고, 원하는 사이즈를 고른 뒤 Starbucks에서 어떻게 주문하면 되는지 간단한 주문 방법을 확인하세요.

사이즈 선택

인기 & 커뮤니티 레시피
틱톡 인기 음료, 크리에이터 추천, 커뮤니티가 직접 공유한 레시피를 만나보세요. 마음에 드는 음료는 저장하고, 나만의 레시피를 보내 앱에 소개될 기회도 잡아보세요!

독립 앱

name: Recipe Keeper
description:
Recipe Keeper은 모든 기기에서 사용할 수있는 사용이 간편한 올인원 레시피 구성, 쇼핑 목록 및 식사 플래너입니다.

빠르고 쉽게 레시피 추가
원하는만큼 정보를 많이 또는 적게 사용하여 레시피를 입력하십시오. 기존 문서 또는 앱에서 레시피를 복사하여 붙여 넣습니다. 식사 유형 및 카테고리별로 레시피를 분류하십시오. 사진을 추가하고 레시피를 평가하고 즐겨 찾기에 플래그를 지정하세요.

웹 사이트에서 레시피 가져 오기
웹에서 레시피를 검색하고 컬렉션에 바로 추가하세요. 수백 개의 인기 레시피 웹 사이트가 지원됩니다. 필요에 맞게 가져온 레시피를 사용자 정의하십시오.

요리 책, 잡지 및 손으로 쓴 조리법에서 스캔
휴대 전화의 카메라를 사용하거나 기존 사진 및 PDF 파일에서 레시피를 스캔하세요. OCR 기술은 이미지를 텍스트로 자동 변환합니다. 좋아하는 모든 가족 요리법을 영원히 안전하게 보관하십시오.

즉시 모든 조리법 찾기
이름, 재료 또는 방향으로 레시피를 빠르게 조회하거나 식사 유형, 카테고리 및 등급별로 레시피를 검색 할 수 있습니다. 냉장고에 남은 음식이 있나요? 그것을 사용할 레시피를 검색하십시오. 좋아하는 음식을 더 많이 요리하고 오랫동안 잊혀진 요리법을 재발견하여 식사 시간을 다시 흥미롭게 만드십시오.

친구 및 가족과 레시피 공유
이메일과 좋아하는 소셜 네트워크로 레시피를 공유하세요. 공유 가족 레시피 컬렉션을 만듭니다. 탭 한 번으로 다른 Recipe Keeper 사용자의 레시피를 추가하세요.

아름다운 요리책 만들기
표지, 목차, 사용자 정의 레이아웃 등이 포함된 PDF로 인쇄하거나 공유하기 위해 레시피에서 요리책을 만드십시오.

예상치 못한 손님?
레시피 제공량을 위아래로 조정하고 Recipe Keeper이 자동으로 재료를 다시 계산하도록합니다.

미리 계획하고 통제력 유지
통합 된 주간 및 월간 식사 계획을 통해 미리 식사를 계획 할 수 있습니다. 한 번에 모든 식사를 쇼핑 목록에 추가하십시오. 힌트와 제안에 따라 임의의 식사 계획을 만드십시오.

쇼핑 간소화
자동으로 항목을 통로별로 그룹화하는 완전한 기능을 갖춘 쇼핑 목록입니다. 필요한 것만 구매하여 비용을 절약하십시오. 잊어 버린 한 가지를 위해 더 이상 상점을 방문하지 마십시오.

모든 장치에서 사용 가능
모든 iPhone, iPad, Mac, PC 및 기타 모바일 및 태블릿 장치에서 레시피, 쇼핑 목록 및 식사 플래너를 공유하세요 (다른 플랫폼의 경우 별도 구매 필요).

기존 레시피 전송
Living Cookbook, MasterCook, MacGourmet, BigOven, Cook'n, My Cookbook, My Recipe Book, Paprika Recipe Manager, Pepperplate, OrganizEat, Recipe Box 등의 다른 앱에서 레시피를 전송하세요.

그리고 더!
• 25 가지 색 구성표, 밝고 어두운 모드 중에서 선택
• 영양 정보를 추가하고 영양 량별로 레시피를 검색합니다.
• 미국 / 영국식 및 미터법 단위 간의 레시피 변환
• 빠른 액세스를 위해 좋아하는 레시피를 홈 화면에 고정
• 레시피를 보는 동안 화면 잠금 비활성화
• 15 개 언어로 제공

훌륭한 지원
여러분의 의견을 듣고 싶습니다! 도움이 필요하거나 질문이 있거나 새로운 기능을 제안하려면 support@tudorspan.com으로 이메일을 보내주십시오.

오늘 Recipe Keeper을 무료로 사용해보세요!

Plan together with Family Share

Designed for real cooking

name: Family Cookbook - OrganizEat
description:
OrganizEat Recipe Keeper로 더욱 간편하고 체계적인 요리 경험을 시작해 보세요. 레시피 정리함, 요리책, 레시피 보관함의 모든 기능을 하나의 앱에 담아, 요리 과정을 쉽고 편리하게 만들어 드립니다.

올인원 레시피 정리함, 요리책, 레시피 보관함. 직접 입력할 필요가 없습니다! 사진을 찍고, 가져오고, 태그를 추가하고, 공유하세요. 지금 다운로드하세요!

OrganizEat Recipe Keeper로 요리의 창의력을 펼쳐 보세요

레시피는 OrganizEat Recipe Keeper의 핵심입니다. 좋아하는 레시피를 한곳에 저장하고, 언제든 확인하며, 체계적으로 정리할 수 있습니다. 파프리카 미트볼부터 나만의 비밀 레시피와 다양한 요리까지, 몇 번의 터치만으로 간편하게 찾아볼 수 있습니다.

주요 기능

간편한 레시피 저장: 웹사이트와 소셜 미디어에서 가져오거나 사진을 찍어 저장하세요. 직접 입력할 필요가 없습니다.

모든 기기에서 이용: 추가 비용 없이 iPhone, iPad, 컴퓨터에서 사용할 수 있습니다.

OrganizEat로 간편한 레시피 관리: 레시피 보관, 정리 등 필요한 모든 기능을 하나의 앱에서 이용하세요.

계정 연결: 다른 레시피 애호가들과 레시피를 공유하세요.

레시피를 관리할 때 가장 중요한 것은 체계적인 정리입니다. 레시피 모음, 레시피북 또는 레시피 보관함 등 원하는 방식으로 분류하세요.

직관적인 정리 기능으로 레시피에 태그를 추가하고, 좋아하는 요리를 손쉽게 찾을 수 있습니다. 필요에 맞는 레시피를 저장하고 관리할 수 있어 냉장고 속 재료를 활용한 요리 계획도 훨씬 간편해집니다.

OrganizEat Recipe Keeper는 단순히 레시피를 보관하는 데 그치지 않습니다. 새로운 레시피를 컬렉션에 추가하는 과정도 간단하게 만들어 줍니다. Allrecipes, Food Network 등 인기 웹사이트에서 레시피를 가져올 수 있습니다. 레시피 스캐너를 사용하면 사진 한 장만 찍어도 레시피를 즉시 저장할 수 있습니다. 시간을 절약할 수 있는 편리한 기능입니다!

체계적으로 정리하고 간편하게 요리하세요

화면 켜짐 유지 기능: 화면을 터치하지 않고도 편리하게 요리하세요.

원클릭 레시피 저장: 인터넷 브라우저에서 레시피를 바로 저장하세요.

맞춤형 레시피 정리: 레시피를 원하는 폴더에 맞게 정리하세요.

언제 어디서나 이용: 인터넷 연결 없이도 어디서든 레시피를 확인하세요.

집 안을 깔끔하게: 모든 레시피를 한곳에 보관하여 여러 요리책으로 인한 공간 낭비를 줄이세요.

소중한 레시피에는 안전한 보관 공간이 필요합니다. OrganizEat Recipe Keeper는 여러 기기에서 레시피를 안전하게 보관하고 언제든 이용할 수 있는 안정적이고 효율적인 솔루션을 제공합니다. 레시피를 손쉽게 동기화하고, 레시피 보관함이 항상 최신 상태로 유지된다는 안심을 누리세요.

요리를 좋아하고 체계적으로 정리하는 사용자라면, 다양한 맞춤 설정을 활용해 나만의 레시피 저널을 만들어 보세요.

메모와 코멘트를 추가하여 요리 경험을 더욱 풍부하게 만들 수 있습니다. 나만의 특별한 요리 여정을 담은 개인 레시피북을 완성해 보세요.

OrganizEat Recipe Keeper는 편리함을 가장 중요하게 생각합니다. 사용자 친화적인 인터페이스를 통해 요리 중에도 레시피를 쉽고 편리하게 확인할 수 있습니다.

화면이 계속 켜져 있도록 하는 기능도 제공하므로, 요리하는 동안 원활하게 탐색하고 레시피 보관함에 쉽게 접근할 수 있습니다.

가격은 지역에 따라 다를 수 있습니다. 구독료는 iTunes 계정을 통해 신용카드로 청구됩니다. 구매를 확인하면 iTunes 계정으로 결제가 청구됩니다.

name: Chow: Meal Planner & Groceries
description:
You've tried meal planning before. It worked for a week, maybe two, and then a late night or a sick kid or plain Wednesday exhaustion broke it. The groceries rotted. The delivery app won.

This moment — where the plan falls apart and takeout wins — isn't a failure of willpower. It's a design problem. Every system you've tried asks you to do seven things in a row: decide what to eat, find a recipe, figure out quantities, make a list, shop, cook, and use the leftovers before they rot. Miss one link and the whole chain breaks.

Chow connects the chain. Tell it who you're feeding, what you can't eat, and where you shop. It gives you a week of meals and one grocery list. Sunday handles Wednesday.

WHAT A WEEK LOOKS LIKE

Open Chow and your week is planned — portioned for your household, filtered for your allergies, matched to your store. very recipe comes from established food publications: real cooks, real kitchens, real ingredients. Nothing was generated out of thin air. Look for the Chow Approved badge to see recipes tasted by our Test Kitchen!

ONE GROCERY LIST, ACTUALLY USEFUL

• Sorted by aisle so you walk the store once
• Buy quantities that make sense
• A "Check you have" section pulls pantry staples off your shopping list
• By the end of the week the fridge is practically empty, because you used everything

THE PLAN BENDS

Life will rearrange your week. Chow expects that. Swap a meal you're not feeling. Skip a night you're eating out. Move Thursday's dinner to Saturday. The grocery list rewrites itself every time. A bad Tuesday doesn't blow up the rest of the week.

WHAT CHOW ISN'T

No calorie counting. No macro targets. No photographing your food. No infinite scroll of recipes you'll save and never cook. Chow answers one question — what's for dinner this week — and gets out of the way.

You don't have to become someone who loves meal planning. You just have to open the fridge on Wednesday night, exhausted, and find that Sunday already took care of it.

SUBSCRIPTION

Chow requires a subscription — there is no free tier. Choose weekly or yearly; the yearly plan includes a 3-day free trial. Prices are shown in the app before you're charged.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

name: Vego: Vegan Meal Planner
description:
Vego turns "what do I cook this week?" into a swipe. Tell it your cravings and your budget, swipe the recipes you like, and get one grocery list where everything is already priced and sorted by aisle.

Going plant-based rarely fails on willpower. It fails on logistics: the supermarket, the restaurant menu, and the recipe on TikTok with meat in it. Vego handles all three.

SWIPE YOUR WEEK INTO A GROCERY LIST
Pick the cuisines you're craving, tell us what's in your kitchen, set a budget, and start swiping. Recipes are generated around your profile, not pulled from a fixed database, and they share ingredients so nothing rots in the fridge. A budget meter fills as you keep dishes, so you always know where you stand. Then everything merges into one list, grouped by supermarket section, with an estimated price on every line.

Store out of tahini? Tap the item and Vego swaps it, then rewrites the affected recipes.

VEGANIZE ANY RECIPE FROM TIKTOK OR INSTAGRAM
Tap Share in TikTok or Instagram, pick Vego, and keep scrolling. It lands in your inbox and starts working. You get a side-by-side ledger: original ingredient on the left, your swap on the right, with the reason for each. Anything already fine stays as it is. Tap a swap to cycle alternatives, then save the full rewritten recipe, steps included. Any recipe page works too, just paste the link. Everything you save lands in your cookbook, ready to become next week's list.

SCAN THE MENU, KNOW WHAT TO ORDER
Photograph the menu, up to six pages. Vego reads it against your profile and hands you Best bets with prices, plus the exact phrase to say to the waiter for dishes that need one small change. No more interrogating the kitchen before you order.

CHECK ANY PRODUCT IN THE AISLE
Point the camera at a barcode and get a straight answer: fits your diet or it doesn't, and exactly which ingredient is the problem.

A PROFILE THAT REMEMBERS
A two-minute quiz sets the line: what you'd never eat, what you love, allergies, and how you eat, from vegan and vegetarian to pescatarian or just cutting back. Every recipe, menu verdict and swap is built on it. Change your mind later and everything re-tunes.

SHOP TOGETHER, LIVE
Share one list with your partner or flatmate. Both phones stay in sync, so you see every item they tick the second they tick it, and the list sits on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island while you shop. Your profile and your recipes stay private.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Take the taste quiz. Two minutes, once.
2. Pick your cravings and your budget.
3. Swipe the recipes you actually want to eat.
4. Shop the list, ticking as you go.
5. Next week, a completely new menu.

WHO IT'S FOR
Vegans tired of cooking the same six dinners.
Vegetarians who want the meat out of recipes they already love.
Anyone eating less meat without wanting a lecture about it.
People cooking for a plant-based partner.

LANGUAGE AVAILABILITY

SUBSCRIPTION REQUIRED

name: Love, Manuela
description:
Love, Manuela is a baking app created by Norwegian baker Manuela Kjeilen, known as @passionforbaking. For more than a decade, Manuela has shared her love of baking with people around the world. She has published nine baking books, hosted her own baking show on TV in Sweden, and inspires more than 1.6 million followers on Instagram with her cakes, recipes, and beautiful baking ideas.

Inside the Love, Manuela app, you get instant access to more than 470 baking recipes, all written in English, with high-quality step-by-step photos for every recipe from beginning to end.

One-time purchase. No subscription. New recipes are included when they are added.

For Manuela, taste always comes first. Beautiful cakes are lovely, but the most important thing is that every bite tastes delicious. Her recipes are created to let the flavors shine, with soft textures, creamy fillings, balanced sweetness, and desserts that taste just as good as they look. From everyday treats to celebration cakes, the recipes are made for home baking.

Inside the app, you will find sponge cakes in many variations, ganaches in delicious flavors like strawberry, latte, and banana milkshake, lots of Scandinavian-style cakes, light fillings, cheesecakes, ice creams, sweet dough, frostings, cookies, cupcakes, and so much more.

The app is made to feel like a growing digital baking book that you can return to again and again. It is easy to navigate, with clear recipe categories, improved search and filtering, and helpful tags so you can quickly find what you are looking for. A few more categories have also been added to make browsing even easier.

Each recipe opens with a large photo and a short introduction, followed by clear directions, recipe notes, a place where you can write your own notes, and step-by-step photos that guide you through the recipe. Whether you are baking a cake, preparing a filling, whipping a frosting, or making cookies, the app is designed to help you feel confident in every step.

New Cake Mode helps keep your screen awake while you read and follow a recipe, so you do not have to keep touching your phone or tablet while your hands are busy baking. The app has also been refined with improved UI, a smoother overall user experience, and an improved password reset flow.

Love, Manuela is not a subscription. It is a one-time purchase of $12.99, converted to your local currency by the App Store or Google Play. You get access to all recipes inside the app instantly, and when new recipes are added in the future, they are included at no extra cost.

Your purchase is connected to the store account you buy it with, either App Store or Google Play. You can restore your purchase anytime using the same store account.

What you get inside the app:

More than 470 baking recipes
Recipes written in English only
Clear and easy-to-follow instructions
High-quality step-by-step photos for every recipe
Easy recipe categories
Improved search and filtering
Helpful tags to find recipes faster
A place to write your own notes inside each recipe
Recipe notes and tips from Manuela
Cake Mode to keep your screen awake while baking
Access to new recipes when they are added
One-time purchase on this platform
No subscription

This is not a baking video app. The Love, Manuela app is focused on written recipes, high-quality photos, clear directions, recipe notes, and step-by-step pictures for every recipe. It is created for bakers who love to read, follow, save, and return to recipes whenever they want.

The Love, Manuela app has more than 75,000 registered users worldwide, and Manuela’s recipes are loved by home bakers, cake lovers, professional bakers, and bakeries around the world.

If you love soft cakes, sponge cakes, ganache, creamy frostings, light fillings, cupcakes, cookies, Scandinavian-style baking, sweet dough, cheesecakes, ice creams, and homemade desserts that taste as good as they look, you are going to love the Love, Manuela app.

Happy baking!

XO,
Love, Manuela

name: Balanced Roots Nutrition App
description:
Stop counting calories. Start hitting your minimums.

The Balanced Roots Nutrition App is a dietitian-designed meal planning app built around one simple method: the 90-30-50 method. At least 90g of protein, 30g of fiber and 50g of healthy anti-inflammatory fat every single day. When you consistently hit these three minimums, maintaining a calorie deficit, balancing hormones, stabilizing blood sugar and losing weight sustainably becomes effortless...without restriction, without obsession and without starting over every Monday.

Created by Courtney Kassis, Registered Dietitian, this app gives you everything you need to finally bridge the gap between knowing what to eat and actually doing it consistently.
WHAT'S INSIDE:

Dietitian-Created Structured Programs — Every meal and snack planned for you by a registered dietitian. Each program is built around the 90-30-50 method so your protein, fiber and healthy fat minimums are hit automatically every single day. No guesswork. No planning. Just follow the plan.

Auto-Generated Grocery List — Your full week of ingredients organized and ready. Shop once. Eat well all week. Never stand in the grocery store wondering what to buy again.

Recipe Swap Feature — Don't love what's on the plan? Swap it with one tap from the growing recipe library. Your grocery list and macros update automatically. The method stays intact. The meal changes.

Automatic Tracking — Calories, protein, fiber, fat and carbs are tracked automatically as you follow your program. Calories are visible for awareness, but they are never the focus. Hitting your 90-30-50 minimums is.

Growing Recipe Library — A database of 90-30-50 approved recipes added weekly. Every recipe is designed to be delicious, satisfying and built around real whole food ingredients. New recipes every week. Your subscription stays the same.

Community Platform — Connect with others following the method. Share wins, ask for support and stay consistent with a community that understands the journey.

Learn Section — Articles, blogs and education written by a registered dietitian to help you understand the method, apply it to everyday life and maintain it long term.

COMING SOON: New programs added regularly, including seasonal resets, blood sugar balancing, hormone health, autoimmune support, plant-based options and more. One subscription. Everything included. Forever.

THE 90-30-50 METHOD: The 90-30-50 method was developed and tested by Courtney Kassis, RD, through her own health journey, including losing 55 lbs postpartum and putting her Hashimoto's thyroiditis into remission through nutrition alone.

The method is simple. Every day hit a minimum of 90g of protein, 30g of fiber and 50g of healthy anti-inflammatory fat. When these three minimums are consistently met your body gets everything it needs to feel full, reduce cravings, balance hormones, stabilize blood sugar and lose weight sustainably without restriction, without calorie obsession and without white-knuckling through your day.

Not a diet. No starting over. Just minimums. And when you hit them consistently, everything changes.
For anyone who is tired of starting over. Built by a dietitian who was too.

Our bestsellers include , Smoky Chicken Tandoori, Chettinad Prawns, Chicken 65, Guntur Chicken,, and Andhra Chilli Chicken. Just place the marinated meat in a pan and relax while it cooks. At TenderCuts, we firmly believe that fresh food is the best for your health! To achieve the highest level of freshness, our produce is directly sourced from local farming and fishing communities. Steps to Order Food Delivery in Train Online

•	Enter Journey Details:
Type your 10-digit PNR number in the search box or select station or train.

• Pick Station & select restaurant: You will see list of stations & restaurants on each station. Pick a restaurant as per your preferences.


• Select Menu Items: Browse through the wide range and check prices alongside. Add your selected food items to your cart as per your diet plan.


• Confirm Passenger Details: Enter passenger name and contact details for delivery purposes.


• Make Payment: Safely make payments online or choose to pay at the time of delivery.
• Enjoy your meal: Your order will be delivered at your seat at the chosen station.




Benefits of Ordering Food in Train Online with Zoop
1. Convenience: Gone are the days when you had to step out of your trains and rush to the nearest food vendor on the platform to buy meals. Now, thanks to technology, you can easily pre-book food in trains online easily from the comfort of your smartphone or laptop. 
2. Variety: Explore new flavours from a range of cuisines like North Indian, South Indian, Chinese, Italian, Mughlai, Punjabi, Gujrati, Rajasthani, Bengali, Maharashtrian, and other popular Indian cuisines.
3. Authorized IRCTC Food Order Service: Zoop is official aggregator for online train food orders. It aims at providing safe & hygienic meals from a network of popular restaurants and kitchens across India.
4. Track Online Train Food Orders: Track all orders booked at IRCTC eCatering website or IRCTC Online Food on Track App along with those booked at Zoop platform.

name: IceForm Pro
description:
We have been making ice cream since 2015, and we still are. IceForm Pro is where we balance our own mixes, and where a recipe becomes a tech card, a label, a batch on the floor and a price you can defend.

Before it we worked in spreadsheets, then in calculators that were always missing something. Once that cost us a whole batch. Every mistake we made since has left a limit or a warning somewhere in this app.

BALANCING
A recipe is a balance of fat, sugars, solids, water, sweetness and freezing behaviour. Change an amount and every indicator moves with it. When a batch will not come into range, one button works out the amounts that will, respecting what you lock and the limits you set.
- The adaptive IceForm profile: MSNF, Sugars and Total Solids ranges follow the fat level you set, while POD and PAC balance independently. Every limit is yours to change.
- 32 built-in profiles for specific product categories. Duplicate one or build your own.

GANACHE
A recipe type of its own: Aw, Brix, SFC at 20 and 28, pH, caramelisation and melting points, plastic range, shelf life, consistency, fatty-acid profile and cocoa components.

WHAT YOU SEE
Balance Radar, PAC and POD, MSNF, Hardening Factor, frozen water, overrun, Coldness Perception, a scoopability gauge and a freezing curve in Celsius or Fahrenheit. Evaporation and overrun simulation shows what they do to every number.

INGREDIENTS
340+ curated ingredients, import from USDA FoodData Central by name or barcode, or your own through a guided composition editor. Cost and nutrition per 100 g and per serving, and a finished recipe can become an ingredient in another.

THE DAY ON THE FLOOR
Today opens on what is happening: what is in progress, what to make, what is in the way. A batch runs as a shift with timers and readings, and survives quitting. A recipe becomes products: pints, pans, cups, bars, each with its own pack, yield and price. Every finished lot carries the cost it was made at, and a lot that has to come off sale is followed to the tub and the slot it stands in.

WHAT IT COSTS AND EARNS
Three rungs, and the app works out which one your figures reach instead of letting you declare it: ingredients, plus overheads by the kilogram, plus hands and machine hours. A batch freezes its cost in layers the day it is made, so November's cream cannot rewrite October. Cost per litre, kilogram, scoop and piece on the real denominators. Price and margin by channel with the commission taken off first, break-even in portions a day, and the assortment split into stars, workhorses, puzzles and ballast. Eight reports, exported as a real spreadsheet.

THE ASSISTANT
Ask in plain words, in any language. It works your recipe through the tools you use, and the app does the calculating. It can draft a recipe, rebalance one you have, or fill an ingredient's composition from a name or a photo of its label. Bring your own provider: Apple Intelligence on device, Gemini, Claude or ChatGPT. Every change is yours to keep or undo.

iPhone, iPad and Mac, with iCloud sync.

SUBSCRIPTION
Balancing is free. Without a subscription you get the sample recipe, fully editable, the full read-out on anything you build, and one recipe and three ingredients of your own. Pro adds the working tool: the ingredient library, USDA and barcode import, import and export, tech cards, the calculators and the assistant. Pro+ adds the business: stock and orders, production and finished goods, costing, prices and margins. If a subscription lapses, your recipes and ingredients stay readable in full; you just cannot edit or add. The Pro+ sections close with their data intact.

PRIVACY
Your recipes are yours. They stay on your device and, if you choose, in your own iCloud. We never see them and train nothing on them. If you connect a cloud assistant, your request goes to the provider you chose, under their terms.

Terms of Use: https://iceform.pro/terms-and-service
Privacy Policy: https://iceform.pro/privacy-policy

description:
Struggle free, healthy recipes that are easy on the wallet. It’s as simple as that, and it’s a message that’s seen over 1 million people follow FitMenCook on social media.

Be honest, have you ever heard these complaints about healthy eating?

- “Eating healthy is too expensive!”
- “It takes too long! I don’t have hours to spend in the kitchen.”
- “Healthy food is too bland”
- “Meal prep is too complicated”

Kevin Curry, founder of FitMenCook, has been there. After spotting a picture of himself on a friend’s Facebook wall he knew it was time for a change.

He followed all the common advice, changed to a healthy diet and started hitting the gym.

For a few months, things were great, but after a while he found himself craving the old foods he was trying so hard to avoid.

He got his hands on every book he could find on nutrition and started experimenting in the kitchen.

His aims were simple:

A) Food should be easy to prepare and affordable
B) Food should be vibrant and tasty, never boring
C) Preparing food in advance is important
D) Following a, b, c helps you achieve your fitness goals

The results were a game changer for Kevin and now he’s sharing that message to the FitMenCook community on social media, inside the FMC app and as a bestselling cookbook author.

Top 5 features:

#1
SHOPPING LIST

We've taken the hassle out of grocery shopping. Add any recipes you want to your shopping list and we'll organise the list by aisle, so you can easily find the items you need.

#2
EASY STEP BY STEP VIDEO INSTRUCTIONS

If you’ve ever looked at recipe instructions and thought “this just looks too difficult for me” then you’ll find the included recipe videos very helpful. Not only is Kevin a great host, who’ll fill you with inspiration for healthy meals, but he’ll also break down the steps in a way that’s easy to follow.

#3
FOCUS ON MEAL PREP

Many of us don’t have time every day to spend in the kitchen.

Meal prep is the solution. Setting aside two days of the week as your main cooking days, you can prepare your meals in bulk and eat healthy all week.

This is a crucial part of the app, and many of the meals are designed with meal preparation in mind, to make healthy living fit with a busy life.

#4
MACRO COUNTING AND INTEGRATION WITH APPLE HEALTH APP

Every recipe includes nutritional information. Calories, protein, carbs, fat and fiber. You can also sync all this data to your Apple Health app.

#5
SCALE UP A RECIPE

Adjust the number of servings s by tapping the + and - buttons in the recipe view. You can also switch the measurements between metric and imperial.

EAT HEALTHIER, NO COMPROMISE
Want more protein, more veg, or just a more balanced plate? Every Mob recipe comes with full nutrition info and macros, including high protein and lighter options, plus veggie and vegetarian recipes. Eating well is easy, and it never feels like a diet.

WHAT YOU GET
- Smart shopping list, add every ingredient in one tap
- Weekly meal plans built for real life
- Search by ingredient to use up what you've already got
- Adjust portion sizes to match how many you're feeding
- High protein, veggie and family friendly recipes
- Save and organise recipes into your own collections
- Step by step recipes that keep your screen awake while you cook
- Nutrition and macros on every recipe
- Reliable, chef tested recipes that actually work

PERFECT FOR
Busy weeknights, families, meal preppers, and anyone who wants to eat better without spending the whole evening in the kitchen. Whether you're cooking for one, feeding a hungry household, or doing a big Sunday batch cook, Mob fits around you.

NO BOXES, NO LOCK IN
Unlike a meal kit, there's no rigid box turning up at your door. You buy your own ingredients, your way, at your own supermarket, and cook what you actually feel like eating. Mob gives you the plan and the recipes, you stay in control of the rest.

We're a community of over 1.5 million home cooks on a mission to make everyday cooking exciting again, not a chore, but something to look forward to. Cooking changes lives. description:
Love, Manuela is a baking app created by Norwegian baker Manuela Kjeilen, known as @passionforbaking. For more than a decade, Manuela has shared her love of baking with people around the world. She has published nine baking books, hosted her own baking show on TV in Sweden, and inspires more than 1.6 million followers on Instagram with her cakes, recipes, and beautiful baking ideas.

Inside the Love, Manuela app, you get instant access to more than 470 baking recipes, all written in English, with high-quality step-by-step photos for every recipe from beginning to end.

One-time purchase. No subscription. New recipes are included when they are added.

For Manuela, taste always comes first. Beautiful cakes are lovely, but the most important thing is that every bite tastes delicious. Her recipes are created to let the flavors shine, with soft textures, creamy fillings, balanced sweetness, and desserts that taste just as good as they look. From everyday treats to celebration cakes, the recipes are made for home baking.

Inside the app, you will find sponge cakes in many variations, ganaches in delicious flavors like strawberry, latte, and banana milkshake, lots of Scandinavian-style cakes, light fillings, cheesecakes, ice creams, sweet dough, frostings, cookies, cupcakes, and so much more.

A few more categories have also been added to make browsing even easier.

Each recipe opens with a large photo and a short introduction, followed by clear directions, recipe notes, a place where you can write your own notes, and step-by-step photos that guide you through the recipe. Whether you are baking a cake, preparing a filling, whipping a frosting, or making cookies, the app is designed to help you feel confident in every step.

New Cake Mode helps keep your screen awake while you read and follow a recipe, so you do not have to keep touching your phone or tablet while your hands are busy baking. The app has also been refined with improved UI, a smoother overall user experience, and an improved password reset flow.

Love, Manuela is not a subscription. It is a one-time purchase of $12.99, converted to your local currency by the App Store or Google Play. You get access to all recipes inside the app instantly, and when new recipes are added in the future, they are included at no extra cost.

description:
Total Keto Diet is your go-to keto diet app for low carb recipes, keto meals & exercise tracking. 1000s of delicious keto recipes, calorie & macro tracker, exercise & workout tracking, keto community, custom meal plans tailored around you and your goals, keto diet articles, shopping lists & more low carb diet goodness.

Total Keto Diet is made by Tasteaholics, a leading keto diet & low carb recipe resource, with the goal to make your keto diet easier and more achievable.

KETO DIET APP & LOW CARB RECIPE FEATURES:
• Macro Tracker - track your calories & macros every day - being on a low carb diet is easier than ever!
• Custom Meal Plans - tailored to you
• Hundreds of Keto Recipes
• Keto Calculator - get on track with your low carb diet using our keto calculator.
• Truly Low Carb -  our macro tracker includes total or net carbs to make your low carb diet even easier to follow.

• Shopping List – add ingredients from keto recipes or your own ingredients.
• Beginner’s Keto Diet Guide - to help you understand everything about the keto diet and get started with your keto diet immediately.

WHAT IS THE KETO DIET?

The keto diet (also known as a ketogenic diet, low carb diet and LCHF diet) is a low carbohydrate, high-fat diet. Maintaining a low carb diet is great for weight loss. Moreover, according to an increasing number of studies, a low carb diet helps reduce risk factors for diabetes, heart diseases, stroke, Alzheimer’s, epilepsy, and more!

WHY REDUCE CARBS?

We’re beginning to understand that carbs in large quantities are more harmful than previously thought, while most fats are healthy & essential (the basis of a low carb diet).

When you eat lots of carbs, your blood sugar is consistently elevated and, as a result, so is insulin. Insulin is a hormone that keeps your blood sugar in check by shuttling the glucose into cells, but when there’s a consistently high amount of insulin, your cells become resistant.

This insulin resistance makes it easier to store fat, and chronically high levels of insulin also cause excessive inflammation in the body, which contributes to heart disease, high blood pressure and eventually type 2 diabetes.

A keto diet can reverse these harmful effects & restores insulin sensitivity.

THE KETO DIET IS STARTING A NUTRITION REVOLUTION!

The nutritional landscape is changing. The keto diet (low carb diet) is growing in acceptance and a nutritional revolution is beginning. We are starting to realize the detrimental effects of our relationship with excess sugar & carbs.

The keto diet focuses on low carb recipes to keep your blood sugar stable, helping your body regain insulin sensitivity and keeping your mood & energy levels stable. When you’re on a ketogenic diet, you can expect to:
• Lose body fat
• Have consistent energy levels during the day
• Stay satiated after meals longer, less snacking and overeating

THOUSANDS OF LOW CARB DIET & KETO RECIPES!

We’ve included thousands of low carb recipes for you to choose from. 
• Keep carbs low – under 30g a day
• Increase your protein intake
• Keep you full and satiated from delicious meals

- “Eating healthy is too expensive!”
- “It takes too long! I don’t have hours to spend in the kitchen.”
- “Healthy food is too bland”
- “Meal prep is too complicated”

Kevin Curry, founder of FitMenCook, has been there. After spotting a picture of himself on a friend’s Facebook wall he knew it was time for a change.

He followed all the common advice, changed to a healthy diet and started hitting the gym.

For a few months, things were great, but after a while he found himself craving the old foods he was trying so hard to avoid.

He got his hands on every book he could find on nutrition and started experimenting in the kitchen.

His aims were simple:

A) Food should be easy to prepare and affordable
B) Food should be vibrant and tasty, never boring
C) Preparing food in advance is important
D) Following a, b, c helps you achieve your fitness goals

The results were a game changer for Kevin and now he’s sharing that message to the FitMenCook community on social media, inside the FMC app and as a bestselling cookbook author.

SHOPPING LIST

We've taken the hassle out of grocery shopping. Add any recipes you want to your shopping list and we'll organise the list by aisle, so you can easily find the items you need.

EASY STEP BY STEP VIDEO INSTRUCTIONS

Not only is Kevin a great host, who’ll fill you with inspiration for healthy meals, but he’ll also break down the steps in a way that’s easy to follow.

#3
FOCUS ON MEAL PREP

Many of us don’t have time every day to spend in the kitchen.

Meal prep is the solution. Setting aside two days of the week as your main cooking days, you can prepare your meals in bulk and eat healthy all week.

This is a crucial part of the app, and many of the meals are designed with meal preparation in mind, to make healthy living fit with a busy life.

#4
MACRO COUNTING AND INTEGRATION WITH APPLE HEALTH APP

Every recipe includes nutritional information. Calories, protein, carbs, fat and fiber. You can also sync all this data to your Apple Health app.

SCALE UP A RECIPE

At Simple Green Smoothies, we believe YOU were meant to do great things. We also know that in order to have the energy and confidence to make this a reality, you have to fuel your body properly. And it starts with a daily smoothie. Simple Green Smoothies helps by creating and sharing delicious green smoothie recipes + plant-based meal plans to inspire and encourage you along the wellness journey.

Jen Hansard, owner of Simple Green Smoothies, struggled with exhaustion and a serious Starbucks addiction in 2011. She was forced to take matters into her own hands when her family hit hard times - unemployment, WIC and no health insurance after moving across the country.

Armed with a daily green smoothie she'd blend for her husband, two kids (ages 1 1/2 and 3) and herself, they were all able to boost their immune system, have more energy and thrived during one of the most difficult time of their lives.

Jen know how to make healthy accessible to everyone- with price, taste and health benefits because she's been there. Healthy can (and should) taste good… and become an enjoyable part of your lifestyle. Today, Jen shares that passion as creator of Simple Green Smoothies.

name: Cookpad: Recipe Book & Meals
description:
Not sure what to cook tonight? Cookpad recommends: search by ingredient or by meal across thousands of authentic recipes from a global community of home cooks — all verified by the people who have actually cooked them.
WHAT SHALL I COOK TONIGHT?
Tell us what's in the fridge and we'll tell you what to make with it. It's not a list to scroll — it's a recommendation for tonight, with the proof that it works.
RECIPES VERIFIED BY THE COMMUNITY
Trustworthy recipes, written by the people who cook them every day, not by an editorial team. Every Cooksnap is a photo from someone who made it before you, with comments on how it went: where it goes wrong, whether the measurements add up, how long it really takes. That's how we know what to recommend — no editor decides it, the person who cooked it proves it.
THE RECIPES YOU GREW UP WITH
Cottage pie, corned beef hash, bubble and squeak, Sunday roast, Yorkshire puddings, scones and Victoria sponge: the dishes people actually make at home, written by the people who make them.
IMPORT FROM ANYWHERE, INCLUDING INSTAGRAM AND TIKTOK
Write your own recipes or import your favourites from any website, from Instagram, from TikTok, from a book or from a handwritten notebook. Build your own biggest recipe collection, all in one place.
Tap Share and the recipe is added straight to your collection — ingredients and steps separated, ready to follow. No more screenshots lost in your camera roll. Save them as drafts and finish them whenever you want.
AUTOMATIC TRANSLATION
Find a recipe in Spanish, Italian or Japanese and read it in English: the translation is automatic.
AD-FREE. ALWAYS.
No ads, not even in the free version. No banner to close with flour on your hands, no video starting up while you're reading the measurements.
YOUR DIGITAL RECIPE BOOK, ALL IN ONE PLACE
Your recipe book, recipe keeper and cooking app in one. Save recipes from anywhere and find them in seconds.
• Import & Scan: Import any recipe from a website or a social post in one tap. Snap a photo of a handwritten recipe or a cookbook page: AI turns it into a digital recipe.
• Create with AI: Write your own recipes with the AI Recipe Assistant, without forgetting a single step. Save the draft and finish it whenever you have time.
• Organise & Plan: Sort everything into private folders by theme — chicken, baking, gluten-free, breakfast. Build your weekly menu in a few taps and let your shopping list build itself from your recipes: you only add what's missing.
• Cook What You Have: Cook with what's already in your fridge or cupboard. Save money, use your leftovers and reduce food waste.
FOR EVERY TASTE AND NEED
Healthy lunch ideas, breakfast, easy midweek meals, packed lunches and batch cooking. Comfort food and classics, seasonal veg, and baking from lemon drizzle to sticky toffee pudding — plus cuisines from around the world: Indian, Italian, Thai, Japanese, Chinese.
Filters for vegetarian, vegan, keto, gluten-free, low-carb and baby-led weaning. Tools: air fryer, slow cooker, pressure cooker, bread maker, one-pan and no-bake.
SHARE YOUR COOKING
Share recipes with friends, family and the community — or keep them private, just for you. Upload photos of the dishes you've made (Cooksnaps) and tell everyone how it went. Follow home cooks and food creators from around the world.
JOIN A COMMUNITY THAT COOKS EVERY DAY
For everyone, beginners to experienced cooks.
PREMIUM
With Premium you get even more tools to cook your way:
• The most popular recipes at the top of every search.
• Import unlimited recipes.
• Advanced filters to match every recipe to your preferences.
Premium is available in the United Kingdom and 22 other countries.
Empty the fridge and find tonight's dinner.

name: Calculation of recipes
description:
ABOUT THE APP

	The Recipe Calculator application is a smart notebook where you can save your recipes and use a variety of modes to work with them.

	- 1 mode -
	You have a recipe that requires 500 ml of milk, and you only have 300 ml. Write down the quantity of any product, and the application will recalculate the quantity of all other products. The new recipe is ready.

	- 2 mode -
	Some recipe is designed for, say, 6 servings, and you want to cook for 4 servings. Specify the number of servings in a special column and get the number of products that you will need.
	You have found a recipe where a baking dish with a diameter of 21 cm is used, and you only have a mold with a size of 16 cm. Fill in the required fields in this mode and cook in the form that you have. In addition, you can recalculate not only the round shape, but also the rectangular one.

	- 3 mode -
	During the cooking process, the weight of the dish changes. This mode is designed specifically for calculating the weight of the finished dish.
	Both the total weight after cooking and the change in the weight of each product will be calculated. For a more accurate calculation, you can edit the change in the weight of products individually.

	- 4 mode -
	One click on this mode, and you get information about the calorie content of 100 grams of a dish, the 1st serving or the whole dish.

	- Shopping Lists -
	Create shopping lists based on recipes so that you don't forget to buy the right products.

	Besides that:
	1) There are several dozen pre-installed recipes
	2) Divide your recipes into 19 categories.
	3) Write down how much the product costs and estimate the approximate cost of preparing a dish according to the recipe.
	4) Log in to the application under any of your account, and all your recipes will never be lost. If you log in on another device under the same account, then, of course, your recipes will appear there as well.

	How does it work?
	The application has a built-in database of products that contains more than 3000 items with calorie. This information is used to accurately calculate the weight and energy value of products.

	In the Recipe Calculator, it is possible to purchase a paid Full version of the application, which differs from the free version by the absence of advertising and more advanced functionality.

name: beans - dial your espresso
description:
Your coffee bags are too good to throw away.

Every bag says something — the label, the story, the roaster's whole reason for being. Then the coffee's gone, and so is the bag, into the bin with the eggshells. beans keeps it: turn any bag into a keepsake 3D model and stand it on a shelf that's actually yours — one you'll want to look at.

Doesn't matter whether you're timing a shot on a manual lever machine or you just really like your fancy pod machine. If you've ever looked at an empty bag and thought "I'm not putting that one in the bin" — beans is for you.

SNAP A BAG, SKIP THE TYPING
Photograph the front of a bag, then the back. beans reads the label on your phone with Apple's Vision and on-device intelligence, then looks up what the label doesn't say: roaster, origin, process, tasting notes. Nothing to fill in by hand.

DIAL IN ONCE
Log every shot: dose, grind on your grinder's own scale, yield, time and temperature. Tell beans about your grinder and machine once, stepless or click, and it gives you a starting point for a new bag. Come back to a favourite weeks later and the recipe that worked is right there.

A SHELF OF YOUR OWN BAGS, IN 3D
Turn any bag into a 3D model before it's gone, and stand it on your shelf. Tap it and it lifts off the shelf into its own detail view. Arrange the shelf your way — it's a collection, not a spreadsheet.

NO SUBSCRIPTION
One payment unlocks beans for good. 3D models are made on request and each one costs real money to generate, so they're sold as render packs that never expire. The unlock includes your first render.

MADE WITH CARE
Light and dark, Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion and Increase Contrast are all respected. No account, no sign-in.

Requires iOS 27. Bag lookups and 3D models need a connection; your bags and shots are stored on your phone.

name: Cookpad Recipes

Every Cooksnap is a photo from someone who made it before you, with comments on how it went: where it goes wrong, whether the measurements add up, how long it really takes. That's how we know what to recommend — no editor decides it, the person who cooked it proves it.

AD-FREE. ALWAYS.
No ads, not even in the free version. No banner to close with flour on your hands, no video starting up while you're reading the measurements.
YOUR DIGITAL RECIPE BOX, ALL IN ONE PLACE
Your recipe keeper, cookbook and cooking app — all in one. Save cooking recipes from anywhere and find them again in seconds.

FOR EVERY TASTE AND NEED
Quick and easy weeknight dinners, chicken and salmon, filet mignon and scallops, soups and chili, breakfast and lunch, baking and desserts — plus cuisines from around the world: Mexican, Italian, Thai, Japanese, Chinese, Indian.
Filters for vegan, vegetarian, keto, gluten-free, dairy-free and baby-led weaning. Tools and methods: air fryer, slow cooker, Instant Pot, bread maker.
SHARE YOUR COOKING
Share recipes with friends, family and the community — or keep them private, just for you. Upload photos of the dishes you've made (Cooksnaps) and tell everyone how it went. Follow home cooks and food creators from around the world and ask for tips whenever you need them.
JOIN A COMMUNITY THAT COOKS EVERY DAY
For everyone — from beginners to experienced cooks — for weeknight dinners or special occasions.
PREMIUM
With Premium you get even more tools to cook your way:
• The most popular recipes at the top of every search.
• Import unlimited recipes.
• Advanced filters to match every recipe to your preferences.
Premium is available in the United States and 22 other countries.
Empty the fridge and find tonight's dinner.

•	Reduce Stress: With automated shopping lists that sync to your partner's phone in real-time, you no longer have to stress about forgetting ingredients or miscommunicating about who is doing the shopping run.

SMART MEAL PLAN GENERATOR
•	Tailored to You: Automatically generate meal plans based on your specific dietary needs, allergies, dislikes, and the exact number of people you are cooking for.

ADVANCED RECIPE MODULE

AUTOMATED SHOPPING LISTS

この度、クラシルはこれまで以上に便利で、楽しい料理体験を提供するプラットフォームへと進化します。
「レシピが見つかる場所」から「料理がしたくなる場所」へ。クラシルが新たに提供するサービスの価値・機能をよりわかりやすくお伝えするために、ロゴを含めたブランド全体のリニューアルを実施します。
クラシルは楽しく料理をできるような、心が動く、つくりたくなるレシピやコンテンツが見つかるプラットフォームです。
毎日のごはん作りに役立つ簡単レシピはもちろん、10分以内で作れる時短レシピ、お弁当や作り置きのレシピ、ダイエットレシピなどが簡単に見つかります。
これから料理をはじめたい方、もっと料理が上手になりたい方、日々のごはん作りのお悩みを解決したい方におすすめのレシピを多数ご用意しております。
（※1）【アプリダウンロード数】Sensor Tower調べ Sensor Tower「Food Blogs, Coupons & Recipe Resources」カテゴリにおける累計アプリダウンロード数がNo.1（期間：2016年2月1日〜2026年2月28日）（主要プラットフォーム合算値）（対象国日本）
（※2）【アプリ評価】Sensor Tower調べ Sensor Tower「Food Blogs, Coupons & Recipe Resources」カテゴリにおけるダウンロード数上位5アプリの内、レビュー平均評価No.1（期間：2016年2月1日〜2026年2月28日）（App Store）（対象国日本）
（※3）【レシピ動画数】自社調べ 国内主要レシピサービス7社における公開レシピ動画数No.1（管理栄養士監修の公式レシピ動画と、レシピクリエイターの投稿レシピ動画の合算値）（2026年4月時点）

◆クラシルで出来ること
・料理の工程が動画で見られる
・ショート動画でみんなのレシピが見られる
・ショート動画を投稿できる
・レシピ画像を投稿できる
・10分以内で作れる時短レシピが見つかる

・近所のスーパーの値段を比べてお得なお店が分かる
・お得な食材を使ったレシピが見つかる

・料理のレパートリーを増やしたい方
・動画で簡単にレシピを知りたい方
・これから料理を始めたい方

◆クラシルの機能紹介
・おいしいレシピ
レシピの数は50,000件以上。さまざまなジャンルのレシピがお楽しみいただけます。
・レシピの検索機能
「今日なにつくろうかな」とレシピや献立に困ったときも、食材や料理名で検索するとレシピのアイデアが沢山みつかります。

気に入ったレシピを保存しておけば、あなただけの料理のレパートリーを作ることができます。
・レシピのメモ機能
味の感想や自分だけのアレンジ方法を公式レシピに直接メモすることができます。

料理のレシピやテクニック・コツを動画や画像にまとめ、クラシルのweb・アプリ上で配信することができます。従来の「料理を作る楽しさ」だけではなく、「レシピを投稿し、多くの人に広める楽しさ」をクリエイターに提供しています。

「主菜・副菜・汁物」をそれぞれタップするだけで朝昼晩の献立を簡単に作ることができます。「和食・洋食・中華・韓国・エスニック」といった料理ジャンルの絞りこみ機能などお好みにあわせてレシピを選択し献立をつくることも出来ます。

近所のスーパーのお得な情報を見ることができます。チラシに掲載されているお得な食材からおすすめのレシピを提案。毎日の料理に役立ててくださいね。

気になるコンテンツを投稿しているクリエイターをフォローして、あなた好みのコンテンツを探すことができます。

好みのコンテンツを見つけたら、いいねやコメントでクリエイターに気持ちを伝えてみてください。

約50,000件のクラシルの正方形動画レシピは、管理栄養士の監修のもと、クラシル専属の調理人「クラシルシェフ」が考案しています。

クラシルは、皆様の健康的で安全な料理生活のサポートに役立てるよう、レシピ考案、動画作成、アプリ開発に努めております。手作り料理で素敵な食卓を彩れるよう、クラシルは今後も改善に取り組んで参ります。

All of your recipes are conveniently synced between all of your devices using iCloud.

Save your favourite recipe RSS feeds into Crouton to see new recipes as they’re published from your favourite blogs.

Quickly import recipes using AI. Import a recipe from a single photo with no manual entry required. Also supports plain text and images.

Share your recipes with friends and family using iCloud, so everyone knows what’s for dinner.

Pair to supported Bluetooth scales (such as the Acaia coffee scales) and have Crouton guide you through weighing your ingredients, avoid the mental juggling of recipe steps and amounts

name: OLLA Brew Lab: Coffee Roast
description:
OLLA Brew Lab is a coffee workbench for iPhone and iPad that keeps roast curves, brew logs and cupping records in one place.
It is made for home roasters, specialty coffee enthusiasts and small roasters.
Bean cards, brew logs and cuppings are free. Roast to Cup, the roastery workbench for curves, roast profiles and inventory, is part of OLLA Pro.

ROAST CURVES (OLLA PRO)
Log a roast live with large buttons for charge, yellowing, first crack and drop; development ratio and weight loss follow from what you record. Replay any curve, compare batches, and set a batch as your baseline. Import curve files in 11 formats; the source is detected from the file itself.

ROAST PROFILES: DESIGN BEFORE YOU CHARGE (OLLA PRO)
Set targets for first crack, drop and development ratio, and see the first-crack window, drop window and weight loss projected on the spot. No machine connection is needed. Save a design to the curve library, or export it as .alog, JSON or CSV.

YOUR BEAN LIBRARY
One card per bag: origin, variety, process, estate, altitude, roast level, roast date, purchase details and your own notes. Resting and drinking windows count down on their own; a Home Screen widget shows a pinned bean.
Photograph a label, a bean list or a cafe menu and OLLA reads it on device, showing the words each field came from; nothing is saved until you confirm. On supported devices, Apple Intelligence fills gaps, corrects misreadings and adds explanations and translation in three languages, all on device.
The Coffee Codex holds 2,000+ cross-linked entries, from origins and varieties to processing and brewing.

BREW LOG
Record dose, grind, water temperature, ratio, TDS, extraction yield, timing and sensory impressions. The Tools tab sits alongside, with a step-recipe brew timer, an extraction-yield calculator and brewing-water recipes.

CUPPING
Score on a classic ten-attribute sheet, or use sensory scoring: cup profile, quality impression and five-cup consistency. Describe flavor with 16 everyday words or the full flavor wheel, and export a cupping sheet as a PDF.
For professional sessions, OLLA Pro adds blind-coded assessment with cup-by-cup records and a five-class verdict from L5 to L1.

FIELD GUIDE
City coffee guides, one volume per city, readable offline. Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto and Fukuoka are published; the other cities on the city bar are still being curated. Each list is selected from public data by OLLA's own scoring.

COFFEE JOURNAL
Beans, brews, cuppings and roasts stay linked, gathered in one archive with search, filters and yearly stats.

HOW PEOPLE USE OLLA
· A home roaster designs the next batch, logs it, and cups it a few days later on the same bean card.
· A specialty coffee drinker scans a new bag, watches its resting window and dials in a pour over.
· A small roaster keeps green and roasted stock, lot codes and labels in one ledger with OLLA Pro.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No sign-up is required. No tracking, no ads, no third-party analytics. Your records stay on your device, and in your own iCloud if you turn on sync. Camera access is requested only when you scan and photo access only when you pick a photo; recognition runs on device. OLLA works in English, Simplified Chinese and Japanese.

OLLA PRO
OLLA Pro includes Roast to Cup (roast curves, pre-roast design, inventory, labels and assessment sessions), iCloud sync across devices, PDF reports with your shop name, and advanced widgets. Roast and inventory records from before 1.3.0 stay viewable.
OLLA Pro is a monthly or annual auto-renewing subscription, or a one-time purchase; the annual plan includes a 7-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. A subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

- “Healthy food is too bland”
- “Meal prep is too complicated”

Kevin Curry, founder of FitMenCook, has been there. After spotting a picture of himself on a friend’s Facebook wall he knew it was time for a change.

He followed all the common advice, changed to a healthy diet and started hitting the gym.

For a few months, things were great, but after a while he found himself craving the old foods he was trying so hard to avoid.

He got his hands on every book he could find on nutrition and started experimenting in the kitchen.

B) Food should be vibrant and tasty, never boring

SHOPPING LIST

Meal prep is the solution. Setting aside two days of the week as your main cooking days, you can prepare your meals in bulk and eat healthy all week.

name: クラシル - 毎日の献立に！レシピ動画で料理がおいしく作れる
description:
レシピプラットホーム『クラシル』

◆クラシルとは
クラシルは、アプリダウンロード数（※1）・平均レビュー評価（※2）・レシピ動画数（※3）のすべてにおいて国内No.1のレシピプラットホームです。2016年2月のサービス開始以降、「くらしを美味しく、あたたかく」をサービスコンセプトに掲げ、管理栄養士監修の「誰でも安全に・おいしい料理を作ることができるレシピ動画」を約50,000件以上提供してまいりました。おかげさまで、国内で最も利用されるレシピプラットフォームへと成長しました。
この度、クラシルはこれまで以上に便利で、楽しい料理体験を提供するプラットフォームへと進化します。
「レシピが見つかる場所」から「料理がしたくなる場所」へ。クラシルが新たに提供するサービスの価値・機能をよりわかりやすくお伝えするために、ロゴを含めたブランド全体のリニューアルを実施します。
クラシルは楽しく料理をできるような、心が動く、つくりたくなるレシピやコンテンツが見つかるプラットフォームです。
毎日のごはん作りに役立つ簡単レシピはもちろん、10分以内で作れる時短レシピ、お弁当や作り置きのレシピ、ダイエットレシピなどが簡単に見つかります。
これから料理をはじめたい方、もっと料理が上手になりたい方、日々のごはん作りのお悩みを解決したい方におすすめのレシピを多数ご用意しております。
（※1）【アプリダウンロード数】Sensor Tower調べ Sensor Tower「Food Blogs, Coupons & Recipe Resources」カテゴリにおける累計アプリダウンロード数がNo.1（期間：2016年2月1日〜2026年2月28日）（主要プラットフォーム合算値）（対象国日本）
（※2）【アプリ評価】Sensor Tower調べ Sensor Tower「Food Blogs, Coupons & Recipe Resources」カテゴリにおけるダウンロード数上位5アプリの内、レビュー平均評価No.1（期間：2016年2月1日〜2026年2月28日）（App Store）（対象国日本）
（※3）【レシピ動画数】自社調べ 国内主要レシピサービス7社における公開レシピ動画数No.1（管理栄養士監修の公式レシピ動画と、レシピクリエイターの投稿レシピ動画の合算値）（2026年4月時点）

◆クラシルで出来ること
・料理の工程が動画で見られる
・ショート動画でみんなのレシピが見られる
・ショート動画を投稿できる
・レシピ画像を投稿できる
・10分以内で作れる時短レシピが見つかる
・300円以内で作れる節約レシピが見つかる
・近所のスーパーの値段を比べてお得なお店が分かる
・お得な食材を使ったレシピが見つかる

◆こんな方におすすめ
・日々の献立に悩んでいる方
・料理のレパートリーを増やしたい方
・動画で簡単にレシピを知りたい方
・これから料理を始めたい方
・いまよりもっと料理上手になりたい方
・冷蔵庫の食材を使い切って料理をしたい方
・旬の食材を使って料理を楽しみたい方
・節約レシピで食費を抑えたい方
・忙しい日のために時短料理を活用したい方
・子供と一緒に料理を楽しみたい方
・離乳食のレシピを知りたい方
・近所のスーパーのお得な情報を知りたい方
・その日のお得食材を使って料理をしたい方
・新しいジャンルの料理に挑戦したい方

◆クラシルの機能紹介
・おいしいレシピ
レシピの数は50,000件以上。さまざまなジャンルのレシピがお楽しみいただけます。
・レシピの検索機能
「今日なにつくろうかな」とレシピや献立に困ったときも、食材や料理名で検索するとレシピのアイデアが沢山みつかります。
・レシピの保存機能
気に入ったレシピを保存しておけば、あなただけの料理のレパートリーを作ることができます。
・レシピのメモ機能
味の感想や自分だけのアレンジ方法を公式レシピに直接メモすることができます。
・レシピの投稿機能
料理のレシピやテクニック・コツを動画や画像にまとめ、クラシルのweb・アプリ上で配信することができます。従来の「料理を作る楽しさ」だけではなく、「レシピを投稿し、多くの人に広める楽しさ」をクリエイターに提供しています。
・かんたん献立機能
「主菜・副菜・汁物」をそれぞれタップするだけで朝昼晩の献立を簡単に作ることができます。「和食・洋食・中華・韓国・エスニック」といった料理ジャンルの絞りこみ機能などお好みにあわせてレシピを選択し献立をつくることも出来ます。
・チラシ機能
近所のスーパーのお得な情報を見ることができます。チラシに掲載されているお得な食材からおすすめのレシピを提案。毎日の料理に役立ててくださいね。
・クリエイターのフォロー機能
気になるコンテンツを投稿しているクリエイターをフォローして、あなた好みのコンテンツを探すことができます。
・いいね・コメント機能
好みのコンテンツを見つけたら、いいねやコメントでクリエイターに気持ちを伝えてみてください。

◆クラシルのレシピについて
約50,000件のクラシルの正方形動画レシピは、管理栄養士の監修のもと、クラシル専属の調理人「クラシルシェフ」が考案しています。
クラシルシェフとは、管理栄養士、栄養士、製菓衛生師、調理師、食品衛生管理者、野菜ソムリエ、料理教室の先生など料理のエキスパート。安心しておいしくお召し上がりいただけるレシピをご提供しております。
クラシルは、皆様の健康的で安全な料理生活のサポートに役立てるよう、レシピ考案、動画作成、アプリ開発に努めております。手作り料理で素敵な食卓を彩れるよう、クラシルは今後も改善に取り組んで参ります。
何かお困りのことやご相談がございましたら、クラシルサポートセンターinfo@kurashiru.com宛にご相談ください。

◆クラシルプレミアム (任意加入)
料理がもっと楽しく便利になる、プレミアム機能のご紹介
・人気のレシピランキングが見れる
・簡単レシピの検索ができる
・節約レシピの検索ができる
・レシピのお気に入り上限が10,000件になる
・料理の栄養素が確認できる
・レシピを人気順で検索できる

◆プレミアムサービスの仕組み
【お支払い方法】

【自動更新の詳細】

【会員状況の確認・退会（自動更新の解除）方法】
会員状況の確認と退会は下記より可能です。
1. 端末の「設定」アプリをタップ
2. 自分の名前をタップ
3. 「サブスクリプション」をタップ
4. kursahiru を選択し、登録内容を確認、「登録をキャンセルする」から解除

【ご契約済みのプランに定める期間中のキャンセル】

name: Cookpad Recipes
description:
Not sure what to cook tonight? Cookpad recommends: search by ingredient or by dish across thousands of authentic recipes from a global community of home cooks — all verified by the people who have actually cooked them.
WHAT SHOULD I COOK TONIGHT?
Tell us what's in the fridge and we'll tell you what to make with it. Chicken, salmon, ground beef, half a box of lasagna noodles: every recipe we put in front of you has already been cooked by someone before you, who left a photo of how it turned out (Cooksnap) and wrote up how it went. It isn't a list of recipes to scroll — it's a recommendation for tonight's dinner, with the proof that it works.
RECIPES VERIFIED BY THE COMMUNITY
Trustworthy recipes, written by the people who cook them every day, not by an editorial team. Every Cooksnap is a photo from someone who made it before you, with comments on how it went: where it goes wrong, whether the measurements add up, how long it really takes. That's how we know what to recommend — no editor decides it, the person who cooked it proves it.
IMPORT FROM ANYWHERE, INCLUDING INSTAGRAM AND TIKTOK
Write your own recipes or import your favorites from any website, from Instagram, from TikTok, from a book or from a handwritten notebook. Build your own biggest recipe collection, all in one place.
Tap Share and the recipe is added straight to your collection — ingredients and steps separated, ready to follow. No more screenshots lost in your camera roll. Save them as drafts and finish them whenever you want.
AUTOMATIC TRANSLATION
Find a recipe in Spanish, Italian or Japanese and read it in English: the translation is automatic.
AD-FREE. ALWAYS.
No ads, not even in the free version. No banner to close with flour on your hands, no video starting up while you're reading the measurements.
YOUR DIGITAL RECIPE BOX, ALL IN ONE PLACE
Your recipe keeper, cookbook and cooking app — all in one. Save cooking recipes from anywhere and find them again in seconds.
• Import & Scan: Import any recipe from a website or a social post in one tap. Snap a photo of a handwritten recipe or cookbook page: AI turns it into a digital recipe.
• Create with AI: Write your own recipes with the AI Recipe Assistant, without forgetting a single step. Save the draft and finish it whenever you have time.
• Organize & Plan: Sort everything into private folders by theme — chicken, desserts, gluten-free, breakfast. Build your weekly menu in a few taps and let your shopping list build itself from your recipes: you only add what's missing.
• Cook What You Have: Cook with what's already in your fridge or pantry. Save money, use your leftovers and reduce food waste.
FOR EVERY TASTE AND NEED
Quick and easy weeknight dinners, chicken and salmon, filet mignon and scallops, soups and chili, breakfast and lunch, baking and desserts — plus cuisines from around the world: Mexican, Italian, Thai, Japanese, Chinese, Indian.
Filters for vegan, vegetarian, keto, gluten-free, dairy-free and baby-led weaning. Tools and methods: air fryer, slow cooker, Instant Pot, bread maker.
SHARE YOUR COOKING
Share recipes with friends, family and the community — or keep them private, just for you. Upload photos of the dishes you've made (Cooksnaps) and tell everyone how it went. Follow home cooks and food creators from around the world and ask for tips whenever you need them.
JOIN A COMMUNITY THAT COOKS EVERY DAY
For everyone — from beginners to experienced cooks — for weeknight dinners or special occasions.
PREMIUM
With Premium you get even more tools to cook your way:
• The most popular recipes at the top of every search.
• Import unlimited recipes.
• Advanced filters to match every recipe to your preferences.
Premium is available in the United States and 22 other countries.
Empty the fridge and find tonight's dinner.
Get in touch: help@cookpad.com

Explore recipes from coffee professionals including James Hoffmann, Tetsu Kasuya, Lance Hedrick, Scott Rao, The Coffee Chronicler, April Coffee Roasters and World Brewers Cup champions.

- Discover coffee deals and new releases from specialty roasters.
- Browse beans by origin, process and flavor.
- Find new roasters and revisit your favorites.

YOUR COFFEE GEAR
- Organize grinders, brewers, kettles and scales with photos, notes and ratings.
- Save grinder settings for the coffees you brew.
- Find related Brew Logs on bean and Gear pages.
- Keep a wish list for your next setup.

BEANBOOK AI
- Scan bags to spend less time entering coffee details.
- Ask about origins, processing, flavor notes and brewing techniques.
- Get suggestions for grind size, temperature, resting time and extraction.
TRY IT WITH SAMPLE BEANS

Join 4 million+ home cooks who've made weeknight cooking easy. Plan your week, build your shopping list in a tap, and never cook the same thing twice.

Apple App of the Day and featured by Apple. Rated 4.5 stars by our community and loved in the press.

Mob turns cooking from a daily scramble into the best part of your day. Whether you want to get organised, eat a little healthier, or just stop making the same three dinners on repeat, we've got you, with delicious, reliable recipes and all the tools to plan, shop and cook around your real life.

GET ORGANISED
Pick your recipes and Mob handles the rest. Meal plan your week, get a smart shopping list sorted by supermarket aisle, and change portion sizes with a tap so you only buy what you need. Prep ahead so dinner's covered even on your busiest nights, and with our cook ahead and batch cook recipes you can cook once and eat well all week, we'll even show you how to freeze and reheat. From speedy weeknight dinners to packed lunches and preppable breakfasts, it all adds up to less time deciding, less money on takeaways, and less food going in the bin.

NEVER GET BORED
New recipes drop every week from our in house chefs, so there's always something fresh worth cooking. Search by whatever's already in your fridge, find quick dinner ideas for tonight, or plan meals ahead for the week. Curries, traybakes, pasta, stir fries, salads and slow cooked comfort food, save your favourites into collections and build your own go to list. It's real variety without the effort, and every recipe is designed to be genuinely delicious.

EAT HEALTHIER, NO COMPROMISE
Want more protein, more veg, or just a more balanced plate? Every Mob recipe comes with full nutrition info and macros, including high protein and lighter options, plus veggie and vegetarian recipes. Eating well is easy, and it never feels like a diet.

WHAT YOU GET
- Smart shopping list, add every ingredient in one tap
- Weekly meal plans built for real life
- Search by ingredient to use up what you've already got
- Adjust portion sizes to match how many you're feeding
- High protein, veggie and family friendly recipes
- Save and organise recipes into your own collections
- Step by step recipes that keep your screen awake while you cook
- Nutrition and macros on every recipe
- Reliable, chef tested recipes that actually work

PERFECT FOR
Busy weeknights, families, meal preppers, and anyone who wants to eat better without spending the whole evening in the kitchen. Whether you're cooking for one, feeding a hungry household, or doing a big Sunday batch cook, Mob fits around you.

NO BOXES, NO LOCK IN
Unlike a meal kit, there's no rigid box turning up at your door. You buy your own ingredients, your way, at your own supermarket, and cook what you actually feel like eating. Mob gives you the plan and the recipes, you stay in control of the rest.

OUR MISSION
We're a community of over 1.5 million home cooks on a mission to make everyday cooking exciting again, not a chore, but something to look forward to. Cooking changes lives. It's better for your health, your mood and your wallet, and we're building a movement of people who cook as part of their weekly routine and are proud to say: "I'm a cook."

Try Mob Premium free for 7 days. Get full access to Mob's recipe library and every premium feature.

If you choose to purchase Mob Premium, your Apple account will be charged once your trial has elapsed. Auto renewal can be turned off at any time in your App Store settings after purchase. Cancelling will stop future charges, but you'll keep premium features until the end of the current period. Deleting the app does not cancel your subscription.

name: WeChef - Recipe Journal
description:
DISCOVER WECHEF: YOUR ALL-IN-ONE RECIPE & MEAL COMPANION

From turning leftovers into something exciting, to saving recipes from the web, or organizing meals for special occasions – WeChef makes cooking easier, more fun, and stress-free. It’s your go-to partner for creating tasty, well-organized, and unforgettable meals.

SEARCH RECIPES BY INGREDIENTS
Turn your fridge into inspiration! Just enter what you have on hand, and WeChef will suggest creative recipes that help you minimize waste and maximize flavor. From veggies sitting in the fridge to random pantry staples – transform them into meals you’ll actually love. Cooking smarter has never been this easy.

IMPORT RECIPES FROM THE WEB
Spotted a great recipe online? Simply paste the link into WeChef, and it will pull in the ingredients, steps, and photos for you. Build your own personalized recipe library with favorites from across the web and keep everything organized in one place. Never lose track of your go-to recipes again!

DIGITIZE RECIPES WITH THE SCANNER
Bring your handwritten notes, cookbooks, or magazine clippings into the digital age. With WeChef’s smart OCR scanner, you can convert family recipes or PDFs into editable, searchable text – and keep those culinary treasures safe forever, accessible anytime, anywhere.

MOOD-BASED RECIPE SUGGESTIONS
Not sure what you’re craving? Just tell WeChef how you feel, and get recipe ideas that match your mood. Comfort food, quick & healthy bites, or festive treats – WeChef’s smart algorithm makes sure you always land on the perfect dish.

SIMPLIFIED MEAL PLANNING
Plan your meals like a pro! Add recipes to your calendar, generate shopping lists, and even set reminders so dinner is always on time. Whether you’re prepping for the week or planning a family feast, WeChef keeps everything organized and stress-free.

SURPRISE MODE FOR ADVENTUROUS COOKS
Feeling spontaneous? Let WeChef surprise you with a random recipe! Explore new cuisines, rediscover old favorites, and add some excitement to your meals. Who knows what delicious adventure awaits?

EFFORTLESS PORTION ADJUSTMENTS
Cooking for one or feeding a crowd? WeChef automatically adjusts recipe quantities for perfect portions every time. No more guessing or wasted ingredients – just accurate, reliable measurements tailored to your needs.

INTERACTIVE RECIPE ORGANIZER
Save and organize your recipes beautifully. Sort by type, occasion, or rating, add personal notes and photos, and find your favorites in seconds. Your collection has never looked this good – or been this easy to use.

ADVANCED RECIPE SEARCH
Looking for something specific? Search by name, ingredient, category, or dietary need. Whether it’s a gluten-free dinner, a quick breakfast, or a clever way to use leftovers, WeChef helps you find exactly what you need in no time.

WHY CHOOSE WECHEF
WeChef isn’t just another recipe app – it’s your personal kitchen assistant. From inspiration and planning to cooking and sharing, it makes every step of the journey easier, more fun, and more delicious. Say goodbye to the daily “What’s for dinner?” struggle, and hello to endless possibilities.

WE’D LOVE YOUR FEEDBACK
Your opinion helps us grow! Share your ideas, suggestions, or feedback at support@wechef.site and help shape the future of WeChef. Together, we’ll make cooking even more inspiring and stress-free.

name: Pam Fitness & Food
description:
THE BASICS:
1.⁠ ⁠Yummy and healthy recipes, using natural ingredients. No artificial sweeteners, etc.
2.⁠ ⁠I love to replace „bad“ ingredients of classic recipes - for example cane sugar or white flour - with more healthy alternatives. Therefore we can still eat dessert. But we get important nutrients, vitamins and minerals at the same time. The result? Food and sugar cravings will say goodbye.
3.⁠ ⁠Quick & easy! I know, it’s not possible to spend hours in the kitchen every day.
4.⁠ ⁠All recipes are perfect for a fit lifestyle. Huge amounts of fats or sugar (alternatives) are therefore not part of the Pam app.
5.⁠ ⁠Take responsibility! If you want to feel amazing, you have to know about what you eat, the quality of the ingredients and how your dish was prepared. You should not give the responsibility about your health to somebody else. That means: less processed foods, more homemade meals!

GET READY FOR:
•⁠  ⁠A big selection of recipes - with weekly updates.
•⁠  ⁠Special „search“ filters, so you can find the food that YOU enjoy. High protein, no nuts, low carb or vegan? Simply select your preferences.
•⁠  ⁠Blog articles and helpful tips on: food knowledge, cooking & fitness tricks, motivation, personal topics and much more.
•⁠  ⁠Direct access to all of my workout videos, incl. search filters to find the right video for your goal.
• AI Custom Meal Planner that creates a personalized plan based on your preferences, goals, macros, and calories
• Macros and Calories Calculator so you can calculate and understand your daily needs easily
• Journal feature to reflect, track your Mind and Body journey, and see how far you have come
•⁠  ⁠Meal & Workout Plan: structure your week of meals and workouts with the intuitive planner feature. Not sure where to start? Just add my „Pam Plan“!
•⁠  ⁠Shopping List: add all ingredients of a recipe or have fun writing your own list.
•⁠  ⁠Notifications: enable if you want to be notified whenever I publish new content.

RECIPES
•⁠  ⁠All recipes are created by me, my brother, mom or my cousin!
•⁠  ⁠95% for a fit lifestyle, 5% by my brother Dennis & 100% delicious.
•⁠  ⁠Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Sweets, Drinks & Snacks.
•⁠  ⁠The recipes are perfect for everyday use, including meal prep ideas. But luckily we also have the time to bake a cake or muffins now and then!
•⁠  ⁠Easy step-by-step cooking instructions.
•⁠  ⁠Calories & macros included with every recipe.
•⁠  ⁠Type in the number of portions you want to cook. The amounts of ingredients will change accordingly.
•⁠  ⁠Meal Planner: structure your week with the meal planner tool.
•⁠  ⁠Shopping List: make sure you have all ingredients by using the shopping list.

WORKOUTS
•⁠  ⁠Direct access to all my workouts videos.
•⁠  ⁠Filter according to your training needs: difficulty level, workout type and focus area.
•⁠  ⁠Workout Planner: structure your week of exercise with the workout planner tool. If you want, you can also copy one of my 13 Pam Plans.

PAMMUNITY
• A safe space to connect, share, and grow together with other Pammies.
• Join groups around cooking, workouts, wellness, self care, and more.
• Ask questions, start conversations, and support each other along the journey.
• Post, comment, and share your thoughts with a community that grows together.
• Need quick advice? Ask Pam directly and be part of the conversation.
• This is just the beginning. We’ll continue growing and building Pammunity together.

MEMBERSHIP OPTIONS
•⁠  ⁠Free: The app is free to try out, with a selection of free content.
•⁠  ⁠Premium: Choose between a monthly or yearly subscription plan to unlock premium recipes and blog content. The first week is free and you can cancel your subscription any time.
•⁠  ⁠My Cookbook: unlock all recipes and articles of my last bestseller „You Deserve This“.

I would love to welcome you in the Pam App!
Lots of love,
Pam
