name: Bake Margin
description:
Know what to charge. Protect every order's margin.

BakeMargin is the pricing and order app for home bakers and small custom-cake businesses. Instead of guessing, you get a clear cost breakdown and a suggested price you can actually trust, so you stop undercharging and keep your profit.

It works offline. No ads, no tracking, no account to create. Your recipes, customers, and orders live on your device.

KNOW YOUR REAL COST
Add ingredient prices, then let BakeMargin do the math. Density and unit conversions, waste percentage, labour, and overhead all roll into one honest cost per batch and per serving.

GET A PRICE YOU CAN TRUST
Set a target margin and see a suggested price, line by line. Every number is explained, so you can stand behind your quote.

BUILD A PRODUCT CATALOG
Save your cakes, cupcakes, and cookies as reusable priced products and drop them into any order in seconds.

TAKE CUSTOM ORDERS THE RIGHT WAY
Capture every request with a structured brief: event date, servings, flavours, allergies, and design notes. Nothing falls through the cracks.

QUOTE, THEN INVOICE
Turn a request into a branded PDF quote, then into an order and invoice. Send something that looks as professional as your bakes.

CHARGE THE RIGHT TAX
Save the taxes you charge, like VAT or a reduced rate, and apply them to an order with a tap. An order can carry several at once, and each one prints on its own line so your customer sees exactly what they are paying.

TRACK PAYMENTS AND BALANCES
Log deposits, partial payments, balances due, and refunds. Manual cash and transfer payments always work offline.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
See every order on a baking calendar and get capacity warnings before you overbook.

SHOP SMARTER
Build a shopping list that subtracts what you already have in stock, so you only buy what an order really needs.

SCAN A RECEIPT
Snap a grocery receipt to update your ingredient prices and keep your costs current.

SEE WHAT EARNS
The profit dashboard shows revenue, cost, profit, and margin over time, plus your top earners, so you know which bakes are worth your time.

BACK UP AND EXPORT
Keep your data safe with backup and CSV export.

FREE TO START
Cost recipes, set prices, and run orders for free. An optional Pro upgrade unlocks deeper tools like the profit dashboard, the smart shopping list, and more PDF types. Eligible new subscribers can try Pro free for 3 days.

PRIVACY FIRST
Your bakery data stays on your device and works offline. App Store purchases are handled by Apple. Optional iCloud sync needs a network connection.

Price every bake with confidence. Download BakeMargin and protect your margin on every order.

name: Fridge Expiry Date Tracker
description:
Stop throwing out food you forgot you had. FridgeLog tracks every item in your fridge, freezer and pantry, then warns you before it spoils — so you finally use what you buy instead of binning it.

Most reminder apps make you fight a generic to-do list. FridgeLog is built around one job: knowing what's fresh. Add an item, set its use-by date, and everything sorts itself by storage zone and urgency — colour-coded so the food you need to eat first is always right on top.

WHAT YOU GET
- See every item's freshness at a glance, ranked by how soon it expires
- Expiry reminders that ping you before food goes off, not after
- Fridge, freezer and pantry organised separately so nothing hides at the back
- Categories for produce, dairy, meat & fish, eggs, leftovers, bakery, condiments, drinks, frozen and pantry staples
- Attach a photo from your library so you know exactly what's in that container
- A grocery list that fills itself from low or used-up items, plus anything you add by hand
- Waste insights: your save rate, a most-tossed categories chart and recent activity
- A built-in shelf-life guide for how long common foods actually last

PERFECT FOR
- Busy households tired of finding spoiled leftovers
- Meal preppers juggling batch-cooked containers
- Anyone trying to spend less and waste less at the supermarket
- People who never know what's already in the fridge before shopping

WHY NOT JUST USE A NOTES APP OR STICKY NOTE?
A list can't tell you what's about to expire. FridgeLog sorts by urgency, reminds you in time, and turns your inventory into a shopping list automatically — so you actually act before food is wasted.

PRIVACY
Everything stays on your device. No account, no ads, no tracking — FridgeLog works 100% offline.

FULL ACCESS
The free plan tracks up to 12 items. Unlock unlimited items, every storage zone, expiry alerts, the auto grocery list and full waste insights with a weekly or yearly plan, or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Give every ingredient a fair chance to be used. Add your first item today and start cutting food waste.

name: Love, Manuela
description:
Love, Manuela is a baking app created by Norwegian baker Manuela Kjeilen, known as @passionforbaking. For more than a decade, Manuela has shared her love of baking with people around the world. She has published nine baking books, hosted her own baking show on TV in Sweden, and inspires more than 1.6 million followers on Instagram with her cakes, recipes, and beautiful baking ideas.

Inside the Love, Manuela app, you get instant access to more than 470 baking recipes, all written in English, with high-quality step-by-step photos for every recipe from beginning to end.

One-time purchase. No subscription. New recipes are included when they are added.

For Manuela, taste always comes first. Beautiful cakes are lovely, but the most important thing is that every bite tastes delicious. Her recipes are created to let the flavors shine, with soft textures, creamy fillings, balanced sweetness, and desserts that taste just as good as they look. From everyday treats to celebration cakes, the recipes are made for home baking.

Inside the app, you will find sponge cakes in many variations, ganaches in delicious flavors like strawberry, latte, and banana milkshake, lots of Scandinavian-style cakes, light fillings, cheesecakes, ice creams, sweet dough, frostings, cookies, cupcakes, and so much more.

The app is made to feel like a growing digital baking book that you can return to again and again. It is easy to navigate, with clear recipe categories, improved search and filtering, and helpful tags so you can quickly find what you are looking for. A few more categories have also been added to make browsing even easier.

Each recipe opens with a large photo and a short introduction, followed by clear directions, recipe notes, a place where you can write your own notes, and step-by-step photos that guide you through the recipe. Whether you are baking a cake, preparing a filling, whipping a frosting, or making cookies, the app is designed to help you feel confident in every step.

New Cake Mode helps keep your screen awake while you read and follow a recipe, so you do not have to keep touching your phone or tablet while your hands are busy baking. The app has also been refined with improved UI, a smoother overall user experience, and an improved password reset flow.

Love, Manuela is not a subscription. It is a one-time purchase of $12.99, converted to your local currency by the App Store or Google Play. You get access to all recipes inside the app instantly, and when new recipes are added in the future, they are included at no extra cost.

Your purchase is connected to the store account you buy it with, either App Store or Google Play. You can restore your purchase anytime using the same store account.

What you get inside the app:

More than 470 baking recipes
Recipes written in English only
Clear and easy-to-follow instructions
High-quality step-by-step photos for every recipe
Easy recipe categories
Improved search and filtering
Helpful tags to find recipes faster
A place to write your own notes inside each recipe
Recipe notes and tips from Manuela
Cake Mode to keep your screen awake while baking
Access to new recipes when they are added
One-time purchase on this platform
No subscription

This is not a baking video app. The Love, Manuela app is focused on written recipes, high-quality photos, clear directions, recipe notes, and step-by-step pictures for every recipe. It is created for bakers who love to read, follow, save, and return to recipes whenever they want.

The Love, Manuela app has more than 75,000 registered users worldwide, and Manuela’s recipes are loved by home bakers, cake lovers, professional bakers, and bakeries around the world.

If you love soft cakes, sponge cakes, ganache, creamy frostings, light fillings, cupcakes, cookies, Scandinavian-style baking, sweet dough, cheesecakes, ice creams, and homemade desserts that taste as good as they look, you are going to love the Love, Manuela app.

Happy baking!

XO,
Love, Manuela

name: FitMenCook - Healthy Recipes
description:
Struggle free, healthy recipes that are easy on the wallet. It’s as simple as that, and it’s a message that’s seen over 1 million people follow FitMenCook on social media.

Be honest, have you ever heard these complaints about healthy eating?

- “Eating healthy is too expensive!”
- “It takes too long! I don’t have hours to spend in the kitchen.”
- “Healthy food is too bland”
- “Meal prep is too complicated”

Kevin Curry, founder of FitMenCook, has been there. After spotting a picture of himself on a friend’s Facebook wall he knew it was time for a change.

He followed all the common advice, changed to a healthy diet and started hitting the gym.

For a few months, things were great, but after a while he found himself craving the old foods he was trying so hard to avoid.

He got his hands on every book he could find on nutrition and started experimenting in the kitchen.

His aims were simple:

A) Food should be easy to prepare and affordable
B) Food should be vibrant and tasty, never boring
C) Preparing food in advance is important
D) Following a, b, c helps you achieve your fitness goals

The results were a game changer for Kevin and now he’s sharing that message to the FitMenCook community on social media, inside the FMC app and as a bestselling cookbook author.

Top 5 features:

#1
SHOPPING LIST

We've taken the hassle out of grocery shopping. Add any recipes you want to your shopping list and we'll organise the list by aisle, so you can easily find the items you need.

name: Pestle: Recipe Manager
description:
Save recipes from Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube and more with Pestle.

IMPORT FROM ANYWHERE
Import recipes from anywhere on the internet to Pestle, and keep just the ingredients and steps. Just tap 'Share', and 'Save to my Cookbook'. 

GUIDED COOKING
Turn any recipe into a step-by-step process with Pestle's guided cooking experience. Control Pestle hands-free for those messy recipes, set as many timers as you want & get reminders for quantities with just a tap.

DEVICE SYNC
Find a recipe on your iPhone, and cook it for dinner on your iPad with seamless, instant sync. For the power users, you can even switch between your iPad & iPhone with Handoff.

HOUSEHOLDS
Create a Pestle Household and share all of your recipes with your family, and create Meal Plans together, too!

DISCOVER
Pestle learns where you save recipes from and suggests to you their latest creations. Add your favorite foodie blogs and always stay up to date.

MEAL PLAN
Pestle can help you plan out your next 14-days by allowing you to assign recipes to each day. And, of course, syncs everywhere.

SHOPPING LIST
Take every ingredient from your recipe and add it to your shopping list! Already got Olive Oil? No worries, just tap it to remove it from your list.

BOOKMARKS
When Pestle isn't able to intelligently extract recipe details, Bookmarks are saved to take you straight back to the source.

RECIPE SCANNING
We get it, not all recipes are online. If you have a big collection of physical recipes, worry not, Pestle has a recipe scanner to digitize them! 

There's a lot more you can do with Pestle, but we'll let you discover it!


The use of Pestle is outlined in our Terms of Use, which can be found at https://pestlechef.app/terms.

With the help of artificial intelligence Eatty can recognize calories from food photos and automatically track your daily intake. This makes it easier to understand what you eat and make better choices without manual logging.

Eatty brings together the essential tools for healthy eating in one place:
- Healthy recipes tailored to your preferences
- Calorie tracking including photo based recognition
- Flexible meal planning for everyday life
- Smart grocery lists and ingredient based recipe suggestions

Eatty is not about strict diets or limitations. It focuses on building long term habits supporting balance and helping you enjoy food while taking care of your health.

Some features of Eatty are available through auto renewable subscriptions. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in your App Store account settings.

name: Rocoto Mercado
description:
Rocoto Mercado is a practical management companion designed for small food businesses, market stalls, and Rocoto-focused kitchens that want to keep daily operations organized in one place.
Manage market sessions, production batches, pantry inventory, menu items, and financial records through a structured and easy-to-use workflow.
With Rocoto Mercado, you can:
• Record market sessions, sales, expenses, servings, and estimated profit. 
• Organize Rocoto production batches with ingredient quantities, preparation time, heat levels, quality ratings, and production costs. 
• Monitor pantry ingredients, stock levels, suppliers, storage information, expiry dates, daily usage, and reorder needs. 
• Build and manage menu items with recipe details, serving costs, selling prices, profit margins, popularity, and availability. 
• Maintain a business ledger for sales, purchases, expenses, payments, and other financial activity.

Rocoto Mercado combines food preparation management with practical small-business organization, helping you keep important operational records clear, consistent, and accessible.
Whether you are planning a production batch, checking ingredient stock, reviewing menu profitability, or recording daily transactions, Rocoto Mercado keeps your Mercado workflow organized from preparation to sale.

name: Cookpad: Recipe Book & Meals
description:
Not sure what to cook tonight? Cookpad recommends: search by ingredient or by meal across thousands of authentic recipes from a global community of home cooks — all verified by the people who have actually cooked them.
WHAT SHALL I COOK TONIGHT?
Tell us what's in the fridge and we'll tell you what to make with it. Chicken, eggs, mince beef, half a bag of pasta: every recipe we put in front of you has already been cooked by someone before you, who left a photo of how it turned out (Cooksnap) and wrote up how it went. It's not a list to scroll — it's a recommendation for tonight, with the proof that it works.
RECIPES VERIFIED BY THE COMMUNITY
Trustworthy recipes, written by the people who cook them every day, not by an editorial team. Every Cooksnap is a photo from someone who made it before you, with comments on how it went: where it goes wrong, whether the measurements add up, how long it really takes. That's how we know what to recommend — no editor decides it, the person who cooked it proves it.
THE RECIPES YOU GREW UP WITH
Cottage pie, corned beef hash, bubble and squeak, Sunday roast, Yorkshire puddings, scones and Victoria sponge: the dishes people actually make at home, written by the people who make them.
IMPORT FROM ANYWHERE, INCLUDING INSTAGRAM AND TIKTOK
Write your own recipes or import your favourites from any website, from Instagram, from TikTok, from a book or from a handwritten notebook. Build your own biggest recipe collection, all in one place.
Tap Share and the recipe is added straight to your collection — ingredients and steps separated, ready to follow. No more screenshots lost in your camera roll. Save them as drafts and finish them whenever you want.
AUTOMATIC TRANSLATION
Find a recipe in Spanish, Italian or Japanese and read it in English: the translation is automatic.
AD-FREE. ALWAYS.
No ads, not even in the free version. No banner to close with flour on your hands, no video starting up while you're reading the measurements.
YOUR DIGITAL RECIPE BOOK, ALL IN ONE PLACE
Your recipe book, recipe keeper and cooking app in one. Save recipes from anywhere and find them in seconds.
• Import & Scan: Import any recipe from a website or a social post in one tap. Snap a photo of a handwritten recipe or a cookbook page: AI turns it into a digital recipe.
• Create with AI: Write your own recipes with the AI Recipe Assistant, without forgetting a single step. Save the draft and finish it whenever you have time.
• Organise & Plan: Sort everything into private folders by theme — chicken, baking, gluten-free, breakfast. Build your weekly menu in a few taps and let your shopping list build itself from your recipes: you only add what's missing.
• Cook What You Have: Cook with what's already in your fridge or cupboard. Save money, use your leftovers and reduce food waste.
FOR EVERY TASTE AND NEED
Healthy lunch ideas, breakfast, easy midweek meals, packed lunches and batch cooking. Comfort food and classics, seasonal veg, and baking from lemon drizzle to sticky toffee pudding — plus cuisines from around the world: Indian, Italian, Thai, Japanese, Chinese.
Filters for vegetarian, vegan, keto, gluten-free, low-carb and baby-led weaning. Tools: air fryer, slow cooker, pressure cooker, bread maker, one-pan and no-bake.
SHARE YOUR COOKING
Share recipes with friends, family and the community — or keep them private, just for you. Upload photos of the dishes you've made (Cooksnaps) and tell everyone how it went. Follow home cooks and food creators from around the world.
JOIN A COMMUNITY THAT COOKS EVERY DAY
For everyone, beginners to experienced cooks.
PREMIUM
With Premium you get even more tools to cook your way:
• The most popular recipes at the top of every search.
• Import unlimited recipes.
• Advanced filters to match every recipe to your preferences.
Premium is available in the United Kingdom and 22 other countries.
Empty the fridge and find tonight's dinner.
Contact: help@cookpad.com

4. Kho quà tặng hấp dẫn: 
Bằng cách tham gia các tính năng chính của Ứng dụng, bạn sẽ có cơ hội tích lũy Hảo Hảo Xu/ Điểm Hảo Hảo.

Với Điểm Hảo Hảo, bạn sẽ có cơ hội để tăng hạng thành viên và nhận được các lợi ích cao hơn.

5. Tính năng chính:
_ Cộng đồng MyHaoHao: Gợi ý món ăn ngon từ mì Hảo Hảo và cho phép người dùng tương tác, góp ý, chia sẻ công thức của chính mình đến cộng đồng ở phần bình luận. 
_ Trò chơi “Hảo Hảo Go”:  Tham gia trò chơi, hoàn thành nhiệm vụ bằng cách thu thập nguyên liệu và nấu thành món ăn hoàn chỉnh để nhận Hảo Hảo Xu/ Điểm Hảo Hảo. _ Giới thiệu bạn bè: Cho phép người dùng mời bạn bè tham gia ứng dụng bằng cách sao chép mã giới thiệu và chia sẻ đường dẫn tải Ứng dụng đến bạn bè để nhận Hảo Hảo Xu/ Điểm Hảo Hảo. 
_ Vòng quay may mắn: Tham gia vòng quay may mắn mỗi ngày để nhận thêm giỏ chơi game Hảo Hảo Go/Hảo Hảo xu. Bạn có thể quét mã QR trên gói mì Hảo Hảo để nhận thêm 1 lượt chơi vòng quay mắn khi đã hết lượt quay.

_ Hảo Hảo Runner: Giúp bạn theo dõi số bước chạy bộ mỗi ngày để vừa có cuộc sống vui khỏe vừa thu thập giỏ chơi game Hảo Hảo Go khi đạt được các mốc về số bước đề ra trên ứng dụng.
_ Giveaway bởi admin: Bạn sẽ được tặng Hảo Hảo Xu/ Điểm Hảo Hảo vào các dịp đặc biệt được thông báo trên ứng dụng. Số Hảo Hảo Xu/ Điểm Hảo Hảo nhận được sẽ tùy vào hạng thành viên của bạn.
_ Với Hảo Hảo Xu đã được tích lũy, bạn có thể lựa chọn đổi Xu lấy quà tặng mà mình yêu thích.

Không cần tài khoản, không quảng cáo phiền. Mở app, quay, đi ăn.

name: Crouton: Recipe Manager
description:
Crouton is feature packed recipe organizer & meal planner. The best place to store your favorite recipes from where ever you find them, websites, cookbooks or a handwritten note from your Grandma.  

IMPORT ANYWHERE
Crouton supports importing recipes from almost everywhere! Pull recipes automatically out of websites and just save the bits you need. You can also scan recipes straight out of your recipe book using OCR 

PLAN YOUR WEEK
With your favourite recipes on hand, Crouton makes it very easy to plan your meals for the week (or even long into the future). If you’re stuck for recipe ideas let Crouton automatically generate the meal plan from your organized dinner recipes.

STEP BY STEP MODE
Crouton offers a unique step by step mode. Focus on one recipe step at time as you cook, you can tap on ingredients within a step to get the quantity (saves you jumping back and forth between the steps and ingredients). With hands free mode you can move between steps without touching your device! Perfect for when you have messy hands.

TIMERS
Start timers with a tap. Crouton detects times within recipes and lets you start timers straight from the steps. A convenient heads up display keeps the times front of mind while you continue to use the app.

GROCERY LISTS
Create shopping lists directly from your recipes, easily copy just the ingredients you need to your list. Integrates with Reminders for convenient access. Your groceries have never been easier!

CLOUD SYNCING
All of your recipes are conveniently synced between all of your devices using iCloud. 

RECIPE FEEDS
Save your favourite recipe RSS feeds into Crouton to see new recipes as they’re published from your favourite blogs.

AI IMPORTING
Quickly import recipes using AI. Import a recipe from a single photo with no manual entry required. Also supports plain text and images. 

FAMILY SHARING
Share your recipes with friends and family using iCloud, so everyone knows what’s for dinner.

GUIDED WEIGHING
Pair to supported Bluetooth scales (such as the Acaia coffee scales) and have Crouton guide you through weighing your ingredients, avoid the mental juggling of recipe steps and amounts

COMBUSTION PROBE SUPPORT
Crouton pairs with Combustion's temperature prove to provide live updates on your cook

Crouton also offers a range of customization including custom icons and app colors.

name: Cookpad: Recipe Book & Meals
description:
Not sure what to cook tonight? Cookpad recommends: search by ingredient or by meal across thousands of authentic recipes from a global community of home cooks — all verified by the people who have actually cooked them.
WHAT SHALL I COOK TONIGHT?
Tell us what's in the fridge and we'll tell you what to make with it. Chicken, eggs, mince beef, half a bag of pasta: every recipe we put in front of you has already been cooked by someone before you, who left a photo of how it turned out (Cooksnap) and wrote up how it went. It's not a list to scroll — it's a recommendation for tonight, with the proof that it works.
RECIPES VERIFIED BY THE COMMUNITY
Trustworthy recipes, written by the people who cook them every day, not by an editorial team. Every Cooksnap is a photo from someone who made it before you, with comments on how it went: where it goes wrong, whether the measurements add up, how long it really takes. That's how we know what to recommend — no editor decides it, the person who cooked it proves it.
THE RECIPES YOU GREW UP WITH
Cottage pie, corned beef hash, bubble and squeak, Sunday roast, Yorkshire puddings, scones and Victoria sponge: the dishes people actually make at home, written by the people who make them.
IMPORT FROM ANYWHERE, INCLUDING INSTAGRAM AND TIKTOK
Write your own recipes or import your favourites from any website, from Instagram, from TikTok, from a book or from a handwritten notebook. Build your own biggest recipe collection, all in one place.
Tap Share and the recipe is added straight to your collection — ingredients and steps separated, ready to follow. No more screenshots lost in your camera roll. Save them as drafts and finish them whenever you want.
AUTOMATIC TRANSLATION
Find a recipe in Spanish, Italian or Japanese and read it in English: the translation is automatic.
AD-FREE. ALWAYS.
No ads, not even in the free version. No banner to close with flour on your hands, no video starting up while you're reading the measurements.
YOUR DIGITAL RECIPE BOOK, ALL IN ONE PLACE
Your recipe book, recipe keeper and cooking app in one. Save recipes from anywhere and find them in seconds.
• Import & Scan: Import any recipe from a website or a social post in one tap. Snap a photo of a handwritten recipe or a cookbook page: AI turns it into a digital recipe.
• Create with AI: Write your own recipes with the AI Recipe Assistant, without forgetting a single step. Save the draft and finish it whenever you have time.
• Organise & Plan: Sort everything into private folders by theme — chicken, baking, gluten-free, breakfast. Build your weekly menu in a few taps and let your shopping list build itself from your recipes: you only add what's missing.
• Cook What You Have: Cook with what's already in your fridge or cupboard. Save money, use your leftovers and reduce food waste.
FOR EVERY TASTE AND NEED
Healthy lunch ideas, breakfast, easy midweek meals, packed lunches and batch cooking. Comfort food and classics, seasonal veg, and baking from lemon drizzle to sticky toffee pudding — plus cuisines from around the world: Indian, Italian, Thai, Japanese, Chinese.
Filters for vegetarian, vegan, keto, gluten-free, low-carb and baby-led weaning. Tools: air fryer, slow cooker, pressure cooker, bread maker, one-pan and no-bake.
SHARE YOUR COOKING
Share recipes with friends, family and the community — or keep them private, just for you. Upload photos of the dishes you've made (Cooksnaps) and tell everyone how it went. Follow home cooks and food creators from around the world.
JOIN A COMMUNITY THAT COOKS EVERY DAY
For everyone, beginners to experienced cooks.
PREMIUM
With Premium you get even more tools to cook your way:
• The most popular recipes at the top of every search.
• Import unlimited recipes.
• Advanced filters to match every recipe to your preferences.
Premium is available in the United Kingdom and 22 other countries.
Empty the fridge and find tonight's dinner.
Contact: help@cookpad.com

description:
Organize your recipes. Create grocery lists. Plan your meals. Download recipes from your favorite websites. Seamlessly sync to all your devices.

• Multitasking support on iPad.
• Add multiple, full-sized photos to each recipe. Embed photos in your directions.

Platforms

name: Pam Fitness & Food
description:
THE BASICS:
1.⁠ ⁠Yummy and healthy recipes, using natural ingredients. No artificial sweeteners, etc.
2.⁠ ⁠I love to replace „bad“ ingredients of classic recipes - for example cane sugar or white flour - with more healthy alternatives. Therefore we can still eat dessert. But we get important nutrients, vitamins and minerals at the same time. The result? Food and sugar cravings will say goodbye.
3.⁠ ⁠Quick & easy! I know, it’s not possible to spend hours in the kitchen every day.
4.⁠ ⁠All recipes are perfect for a fit lifestyle. Huge amounts of fats or sugar (alternatives) are therefore not part of the Pam app.
5.⁠ ⁠Take responsibility! If you want to feel amazing, you have to know about what you eat, the quality of the ingredients and how your dish was prepared. You should not give the responsibility about your health to somebody else. That means: less processed foods, more homemade meals!

name: Love, Manuela
description:
Love, Manuela is a baking app created by Norwegian baker Manuela Kjeilen, known as @passionforbaking. For more than a decade, Manuela has shared her love of baking with people around the world. She has published nine baking books, hosted her own baking show on TV in Sweden, and inspires more than 1.6 million followers on Instagram with her cakes, recipes, and beautiful baking ideas.

Inside the Love, Manuela app, you get instant access to more than 470 baking recipes, all written in English, with high-quality step-by-step photos for every recipe from beginning to end.

One-time purchase. No subscription. New recipes are included when they are added.

For Manuela, taste always comes first. Beautiful cakes are lovely, but the most important thing is that every bite tastes delicious. Her recipes are created to let the flavors shine, with soft textures, creamy fillings, balanced sweetness, and desserts that taste just as good as they look. From everyday treats to celebration cakes, the recipes are made for home baking.

Inside the app, you will find sponge cakes in many variations, ganaches in delicious flavors like strawberry, latte, and banana milkshake, lots of Scandinavian-style cakes, light fillings, cheesecakes, ice creams, sweet dough, frostings, cookies, cupcakes, and so much more.

The app is made to feel like a growing digital baking book that you can return to again and again. It is easy to navigate, with clear recipe categories, improved search and filtering, and helpful tags so you can quickly find what you are looking for. A few more categories have also been added to make browsing even easier.

Each recipe opens with a large photo and a short introduction, followed by clear directions, recipe notes, a place where you can write your own notes, and step-by-step photos that guide you through the recipe. Whether you are baking a cake, preparing a filling, whipping a frosting, or making cookies, the app is designed to help you feel confident in every step.

New Cake Mode helps keep your screen awake while you read and follow a recipe, so you do not have to keep touching your phone or tablet while your hands are busy baking. The app has also been refined with improved UI, a smoother overall user experience, and an improved password reset flow.

Love, Manuela is not a subscription. It is a one-time purchase of $12.99, converted to your local currency by the App Store or Google Play. You get access to all recipes inside the app instantly, and when new recipes are added in the future, they are included at no extra cost.

Your purchase is connected to the store account you buy it with, either App Store or Google Play. You can restore your purchase anytime using the same store account.

What you get inside the app:

More than 470 baking recipes
Recipes written in English only
Clear and easy-to-follow instructions
High-quality step-by-step photos for every recipe
Easy recipe categories
Improved search and filtering
Helpful tags to find recipes faster
A place to write your own notes inside each recipe
Recipe notes and tips from Manuela
Cake Mode to keep your screen awake while baking
Access to new recipes when they are added
One-time purchase on this platform
No subscription

This is not a baking video app. The Love, Manuela app is focused on written recipes, high-quality photos, clear directions, recipe notes, and step-by-step pictures for every recipe. It is created for bakers who love to read, follow, save, and return to recipes whenever they want.

The Love, Manuela app has more than 75,000 registered users worldwide, and Manuela’s recipes are loved by home bakers, cake lovers, professional bakers, and bakeries around the world.

If you love soft cakes, sponge cakes, ganache, creamy frostings, light fillings, cupcakes, cookies, Scandinavian-style baking, sweet dough, cheesecakes, ice creams, and homemade desserts that taste as good as they look, you are going to love the Love, Manuela app.

Happy baking!

XO,
Love, Manuela

description:

◆クラシルとは
クラシルは、アプリダウンロード数（※1）・平均レビュー評価（※2）・レシピ動画数（※3）のすべてにおいて国内No.1のレシピプラットホームです。2016年2月のサービス開始以降、「くらしを美味しく、あたたかく」をサービスコンセプトに掲げ、管理栄養士監修の「誰でも安全に・おいしい料理を作ることができるレシピ動画」を約50,000件以上提供してまいりました。おかげさまで、国内で最も利用されるレシピプラットフォームへと成長しました。
この度、クラシルはこれまで以上に便利で、楽しい料理体験を提供するプラットフォームへと進化します。
「レシピが見つかる場所」から「料理がしたくなる場所」へ。クラシルが新たに提供するサービスの価値・機能をよりわかりやすくお伝えするために、ロゴを含めたブランド全体のリニューアルを実施します。
クラシルは楽しく料理をできるような、心が動く、つくりたくなるレシピやコンテンツが見つかるプラットフォームです。
毎日のごはん作りに役立つ簡単レシピはもちろん、10分以内で作れる時短レシピ、お弁当や作り置きのレシピ、ダイエットレシピなどが簡単に見つかります。
これから料理をはじめたい方、もっと料理が上手になりたい方、日々のごはん作りのお悩みを解決したい方におすすめのレシピを多数ご用意しております。

（※2）【アプリ評価】Sensor Tower調べ Sensor Tower「Food Blogs, Coupons & Recipe Resources」カテゴリにおけるダウンロード数上位5アプリの内、レビュー平均評価No.1（期間：2016年2月1日〜2026年2月28日）（App Store）（対象国日本）
（※3）【レシピ動画数】自社調べ 国内主要レシピサービス7社における公開レシピ動画数No.1（管理栄養士監修の公式レシピ動画と、レシピクリエイターの投稿レシピ動画の合算値）（2026年4月時点）

◆クラシルで出来ること
・料理の工程が動画で見られる
・ショート動画でみんなのレシピが見られる
・ショート動画を投稿できる
・レシピ画像を投稿できる
・10分以内で作れる時短レシピが見つかる
・300円以内で作れる節約レシピが見つかる
・近所のスーパーの値段を比べてお得なお店が分かる
・お得な食材を使ったレシピが見つかる

◆こんな方におすすめ
・日々の献立に悩んでいる方
・料理のレパートリーを増やしたい方
・動画で簡単にレシピを知りたい方
・これから料理を始めたい方
・いまよりもっと料理上手になりたい方

◆クラシルの機能紹介

レシピの数は50,000件以上。さまざまなジャンルのレシピがお楽しみいただけます。

「今日なにつくろうかな」とレシピや献立に困ったときも、食材や料理名で検索するとレシピのアイデアが沢山みつかります。

味の感想や自分だけのアレンジ方法を公式レシピに直接メモすることができます。

クラシルは、皆様の健康的で安全な料理生活のサポートに役立てるよう、レシピ考案、動画作成、アプリ開発に努めております。手作り料理で素敵な食卓を彩れるよう、クラシルは今後も改善に取り組んで参ります。

不論是健康輕食、家常小菜，還是挑戰高難度甜點，愛料理都能幫你輕鬆上手，享受幸福美味時光。

▶ 快速搜尋食譜

▶ 個人化收藏清單，隨時管理喜好食譜

▶ 創作並分享私房食譜
輕鬆上傳你的拿手好菜，記錄料理歷程，讓更多料理愛好者嘗試，成為社群中的料理達人！

▶ 交流烹飪心得
分享跟著食譜做的試做成果，上傳照片記錄自己的烹飪故事。還可即時留言詢問食譜作者，獲得專業回覆，解決你的料理疑惑。

▶ 百大分類，一站式滿足料理需求
不論你喜歡家常菜還是高人氣烘焙作品，愛料理為你提供完整的菜色分類，一站解決每日菜單的煩惱，隨時隨地變化餐桌風格！

▶ 採買清單功能，輕鬆準備食材
根據食譜內容生成食材採買清單，買菜時再也不用翻找食譜，幫助你快速完成購物，高效備料！

name: FitMenCook - Healthy Recipes
description:
Struggle free, healthy recipes that are easy on the wallet. It’s as simple as that, and it’s a message that’s seen over 1 million people follow FitMenCook on social media.

Be honest, have you ever heard these complaints about healthy eating?

- “Eating healthy is too expensive!”
- “It takes too long! I don’t have hours to spend in the kitchen.”
- “Healthy food is too bland”
- “Meal prep is too complicated”

Kevin Curry, founder of FitMenCook, has been there. After spotting a picture of himself on a friend’s Facebook wall he knew it was time for a change.

He followed all the common advice, changed to a healthy diet and started hitting the gym.

For a few months, things were great, but after a while he found himself craving the old foods he was trying so hard to avoid.

He got his hands on every book he could find on nutrition and started experimenting in the kitchen.

His aims were simple:

A) Food should be easy to prepare and affordable
B) Food should be vibrant and tasty, never boring
C) Preparing food in advance is important
D) Following a, b, c helps you achieve your fitness goals

The results were a game changer for Kevin and now he’s sharing that message to the FitMenCook community on social media, inside the FMC app and as a bestselling cookbook author.

Top 5 features:

#1
SHOPPING LIST

We've taken the hassle out of grocery shopping. Add any recipes you want to your shopping list and we'll organise the list by aisle, so you can easily find the items you need.

#2
EASY STEP BY STEP VIDEO INSTRUCTIONS

If you’ve ever looked at recipe instructions and thought “this just looks too difficult for me” then you’ll find the included recipe videos very helpful. Not only is Kevin a great host, who’ll fill you with inspiration for healthy meals, but he’ll also break down the steps in a way that’s easy to follow.

#3
FOCUS ON MEAL PREP

Many of us don’t have time every day to spend in the kitchen.

Meal prep is the solution. Setting aside two days of the week as your main cooking days, you can prepare your meals in bulk and eat healthy all week.

This is a crucial part of the app, and many of the meals are designed with meal preparation in mind, to make healthy living fit with a busy life.

#4
MACRO COUNTING AND INTEGRATION WITH APPLE HEALTH APP

Every recipe includes nutritional information. Calories, protein, carbs, fat and fiber. You can also sync all this data to your Apple Health app.

#5
SCALE UP A RECIPE

Adjust the number of servings s by tapping the + and - buttons in the recipe view. You can also switch the measurements between metric and imperial.

There’s more including:
- Over 1000 recipes
- Search by ingredient: Type in Chicken Rice to see all recipes containing both of these ingredients
- Filter by tags
- Add recipes to favorites
- Add notes to recipes
- Share recipes with friends and family
- Available in English and Spanish

For a video demonstration of the app in action, take a look at: http://fitmencook.com/app/

Optional Meal Planner Subscription:

name: Brewfather
description:
Powerful and easy to use tool for your brewing needs. Easily create and manage your recipes. Keep track of all the details in your batches and your ingredients inventory.

Brewfather is made from the ground up to give you the best recipe design and brewing experience on both desktop and mobile devices. With a modern design that is easy to use. Get your recipes done in no time! With automatic synchronization between all your devices and offline support. 

Combining a powerful recipe designer with intuitive batch tracking and inventory management to make your brew-day easier. Integrated with many popular devices to aid your brewing. Explore the recipe library with hundreds of quality recipes.

Features:
* Powerful, intuitive and easy to use interface with dark mode support
* Multi-device support - one app everywhere - always!
* Offline support, auto-saving, and automatic synchronization
* Fully-featured and easy to use recipe designer
* Complete batch tracking - log every step of your brew
* Fermentation chart
* Recipe library with hundreds of quality recipes available for you
* Brew timer with alarms and notifications for your brew day!
* Profiles for your equipment, mash schedule, fermentation steps, and water
* Highly customizable equipment profile to suit any brewing system
* Large customizable ingredients database with thousands of ingredients
* Inventory stock & cost tracking
* Multiple style guidelines (BJCP, Brewers Association, Norbrygg, SHBF, DØDL)
* Supports custom style guidelines
* Print your recipe or batch to PDF
* Import and export BeerXML
* Metric and US/Imperial units
* Scale recipes up/down
* Easily share recipes
* Estimate your Final Gravity based on many variables
* Calculate every important detail of your recipes and batches
* Easy to use yeast amount and yeast starter calculator
* Integrated water adjustment calculator with mash pH
* Strike temperature calculation
* Proper calculation of hop-stand bitterness

And many more tools and features to help your brewing.

Integrations:
* Remote logging from Tilt, RAPT Cloud, iSpindel, Brewpiless, MyBrewbot, Plaato Airlock, Plaato Keg, Floaty, Brewbrain and Custom Stream
* Webhook support
* Brewtools Cloud integration
* Recipe sending to Brewtools brewers
* Full SmartPID two-way integration, for brew-day and fermentation control
* Programmable API for custom integrations

Happy brewing!

---

Brewfather is free to use, with an optional Premium subscription to unlock premium features and unlimited recipes/batches.

New accounts get 30 days of free Premium access.

Brewfather Premium:
* Unlimited number of recipes
* Unlimited number of batches
* Import and export features

* Ingredient cost tracking
* Custom style guidelines
* Ability to restore deleted recipes and batches
* Add manual readings for the fermentation chart

name: Recipe Keeper
description:
Recipe Keeper is the easy to use, all-in-one recipe organizer, shopping list and meal planner available across all of your devices.

ADD RECIPES QUICKLY AND EASILY
Enter your recipes with as much or as little information as you like. Copy and paste recipes from your existing documents or apps. Categorize your recipes by course and category. Add photos, rate your recipes and flag your favorites.

IMPORT RECIPES FROM WEBSITES
Search for recipes on the web and add them straight to your collection. Hundreds of popular recipe websites supported. Customize imported recipes to suit your needs.

SCAN FROM COOKBOOKS, MAGAZINES AND HANDWRITTEN RECIPES
Scan recipes using your phone's camera or from your existing photos and PDF files. OCR technology automatically converts images to text. Keep all your favorite family recipes safe forever.

FIND ANY RECIPE INSTANTLY
Quickly lookup your recipes by name, ingredient or directions or simply browse your recipes by course, category and rating. Got leftovers in the fridge? Search for a recipe to use them up. Cook more of your favorite meals and rediscover those long-forgotten recipes to make mealtimes interesting again.

SHARE RECIPES WITH FRIENDS AND FAMILY
Share your recipes by email and to your favorite social networks. Create a shared family recipe collection. Add recipes from other Recipe Keeper users with a single tap.

CREATE BEAUTIFUL COOKBOOKS
Create cookbooks from your recipes for printing or sharing as a PDF with cover page, table of contents, custom layouts and more.

UNEXPECTED GUESTS?
Adjust a recipe serving size up or down and let Recipe Keeper automatically recalculate your ingredients for you.

PLAN AHEAD AND STAY IN CONTROL
Integrated weekly and monthly meal planner allows you to plan your meals in advance. Add all your meals to your shopping list in one step. Recipe Keeper can even create a random meal plan for you based on your hints and suggestions. Get rid of that "what should I cook tonight?" feeling.

MAKE SHOPPING SIMPLER
Fully featured shopping list that automatically groups your items by aisle. Save money by only buying what you need. No more trips back to the store for that one thing you forgot.

AVAILABLE ACROSS ALL OF YOUR DEVICES
Share your recipes, shopping lists and meal planner across all your iPhones, iPads, Macs, PCs and other mobile and tablet devices (separate purchase required for other platforms).

"ALEXA, ASK RECIPE KEEPER FOR COOKIE RECIPES."
Search your recipes, cook hands-free with step-by-step instructions and add items to your shopping list using the Recipe Keeper skill for Amazon Alexa, (English language only).

TRANSFER YOUR EXISTING RECIPES
Transfer your recipes from other apps such as Living Cookbook, MasterCook, MacGourmet, BigOven, Cook'n, My Cookbook, My Recipe Book, Paprika Recipe Manager, Pepperplate, OrganizEat, Recipe Box and many more.

AND MORE!
• Choose from 25 different color schemes, light & dark modes
• Format recipes using bold and italics
• Customizable recipe collections, courses and categories
• Add nutrition information and search for recipes by nutritional amounts
• Check off ingredients while cooking, highlight the current direction
• Adjustable text size when viewing recipes - great for reading recipes across the kitchen
• Convert recipes between US/Imperial and Metric units
• Link related recipes together
• Add links to online videos
• Pin your favorite recipes to the home screen for quick access
• Works offline - take your recipes with you wherever you go
• Bulk update multiple recipes at once
• Screen lock disabled while viewing recipes - no more messy fingers on screen trying to wake your device
• Available in 15 languages

GREAT SUPPORT
We love hearing from you! If you need any help, have a question, or want to suggest a new feature, please email us at support@tudorspan.com

Cook more. Eat healthier. Shop smarter. Try Recipe Keeper free today!

Best app for this purpose I could find, and I looked at a bunch."

"Finally an app that gives a complete nutritional breakdown of food. This holistic approach takes the focus off calories and back onto food as a whole. As a nutritionist, I highly recommend it to all my clients."

"Great app! Especially to nutritionists, when a patient asks for some random ingredient we don't know all its values! Works like a lucky charm!"
▸ Great! by Awesome short stories

Show and hide foods by categories such as hiding meats for vegetarians or dairy & eggs for vegans to customize Nutrients to your diet.

"This app is the best food app ever. It has never frozen on me and it is so informational. It helps my fiance and I keep healthy and buy the right foods."
▸ Amazing!!! by Kana557

Search for Baked Foods, Beef, Beverages, Breakfast Cereals, Cereal Grains & Pasta, Dairy & Eggs, Fish & Shellfish, Fruits, Nuts & Seeds, Oils, Pork, Poultry, Seafood, Spices & Herbs, Vegetables and more in Nutrients!

"An embarrassment of riches! The most thorough and complete nutrition atlas I have ever seen! If you want to know what you eat I strongly suggest this great app!"

"Love it! The update is amazing. Very informative app. Especially if you are trying to eat healthier or get more of one type of nutrient. You can eat more of that type of food."

Best New Product SCAA EXPO 2010

VST CoffeeTools™ allows professional and home users to quickly compute proper brew formulas using any method of brewing coffee or espresso. Used with a coffee refractometer (not included) VST CoffeeTools will apply measurements of brew formula and coffee TDS to compute normalized extraction yield – a crucial metric for ensuring the sweetest coffee and espresso. 

COFFEE BREWED TO GOLD CUP STANDARDS
•Use VST CoffeeTools™ with any VST coffee refractometer to compute brew recipes and measure results to meet internationally accepted Gold Cup standards as practiced by the Specialty Coffee Associations of America (SCAA) and Europe (SCAE), as well as the Norwegian Coffee Association (NCA) and European Coffee Brewing Center (ECBC). 

COMMUNICATE
•Recipes & Measurements can be eMailed and shared with customers, clients and colleagues for quick, detailed communication of all brewing parameters. Full database sorting, import and export is supported.

COFFEE MODE
•VST CoffeeTools™ for Coffee offers professional baristas and specialty roasters the tools to design, measure, diagnose and refine any brew method to ensure excellence in coffee brewing.
•Metric, English (U.S. Custom) or mixed units, and conversions of weights and volume is fully supported.
•Compatible with all drip and immersion brewing methods and works with any VST Coffee refractometer displaying % TDS to 0.01% – temperature corrected for coffee. Accuracy recommended: +/- 0.05% or better. 
•Save, share, import measurements and details, including TDS, Ext Yield, Dose, Brew Formula, CO2, Moisture, Brew Time, Brew Method, Temperature, Pre-Infusion, Grinder/Setting, Roaster, Roast Style, Farm/Farmer, Barista Name/Notes and much more.

COFFEE LITE MODE (discontinued)

ESPRESSO MODE
•VST CoffeeTools™ for Espresso offers professional baristas and specialty roasters the tools to design, measure, diagnose and refine espresso extraction.
•Eliminate sour or bitter shot defects by making adjustments to quickly dial in measured Extraction Yield.
•Presets for Single, Double or Triple shots as Normale, Lungo or Ristretto can be loaded and custom preset for personal preferences.
•Works with any VST Coffee refractometer displaying % TDS to 0.01% or 0.1% – temperature corrected for coffee. Accuracy recommended: +/- 0.1 % TDS or better.
•Save, share, import measurements and details, including TDS, Yield, Dose, Brew Formula, Shot Time, Temperature, Pressure, Pre-Infusion, Grinder/Setting, Roaster, Roast Style, Farm/Farmer, Barista Name/Notes and much more.

SUGAR MODE
• Sugar mode allows beverage industry professionals to measure Sucrose, Glucose, Fructose and Invert Sugars at any temperature from 15-40 Deg C for use in concentrates and related sugar-based beverages.
•Simply enter Refractive Index and Temperature from any refractometer to compute and displays all values for Specific Gravity, Density, Total Weight, Mass Fraction and Dry Substance weight.
•VST CoffeeTools™ for Sugars is accurate to +/- 0.00003 nD per ICUMSA Tables (1998 & 2000). Final accuracy depends on accuracy of instrument.

CORN MODE
•CORN mode allows beverage industry professionals to measure High Fructose Corn Syrups HFCS42 and HFCS55 at any temperature from 10-50 Deg C for use in concentrates and related HFCS-based beverages.
•Simply enter the Refractive Index and TEMP from any refractometer to compute and displays all values for Specific Gravity, Density, Total Weight, Mass Fraction and Dry Substance weight.
•VST CoffeeTools™ for CORN Syrups has been tested against the Corn Refiners Association tables for syrup composition, and is fit to be accurate to better than +/- 0.0001 nD and less than +/- 0.02 % Mass Fraction. Final accuracy depends on accuracy of instrument.

name: Tıkla Gelsin® - Yemek Siparişi
developer: Ata Express Elektronik Iletisim Tanitim Pazarlama Dagitim Sanayi Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirket
description:
İyi Ki Sen De Bizdensin! Lezzet Dolu Dünyamıza Hoş Geldin!

Tıkla Gelsin® dünyasında her sipariş bir deneyim, her kullanıcı ise ailemizin bir parçası. "İyi ki sen de bizdensin" diyoruz çünkü favori lezzetlerine giden yolda seni en iyi biz anlıyoruz. Canın Burger King®’in efsane ateşini mi çekti, yoksa Popeyes®’ın çıtır tavuklarını mı? Belki de sıra beklemeden hızlıca bir Gel Al siparişi vermek istiyorsun... Tercihin hangisi olursa olsun, senin hızına ve keyfine ayak uydurmak için buradayız. Seninle birlikte büyüyen bu toplulukta, sadece bir uygulama kullanıcısı değil, her zaman önceliğimiz olan özel bir misafirimizsin. Hadi, bu lezzet yolculuğunda sana özel avantajların ve en sevdiğin restoranların tadını çıkarmaya başla!

Neden Tıkla Gelsin®?
Geniş Restoran Ağı: Türkiye'nin dört bir yanından binlerce restoran ve mutfak seçeneği.
Özel İndirimler: Siparişlerinde sana özel kampanya ve kupon fırsatlarını yakala.
Kolay Sipariş: Kullanıcı dostu arayüzle birkaç dokunuşla sepetini tamamla.
Canlı Takip: Siparişinin tüm aşamalarını anlık olarak izle.
Güvenli Ödeme: Tıkla Pay Cüzdan, kredi kartı ve yemek kartları ile hızlıca öde.
Gel Al Seçeneği: Sıra beklemeden yemeğini restoranda ye veya paket olarak al.
Cüzdan Avantajı: Tıkla Pay ile yükledikçe Tıkla Para kazan, siparişlerinde kullan.
Arkadaşını Davet Et: Sevdiklerini Tıkla Gelsin® dünyasına kat, birlikte kazan.
7/24 Destek: Chatbot ve canlı destek ekibimizle her an yanındayız.

Favori Lezzetlerin Tek Uygulamada!
Online yemek siparişinin yıldızı Tıkla Gelsin®; Burger King®, Popeyes®, Arby’s®, Subway®, Sbarro®, Usta Dönerci®, Usta Pideci®, Amasya Et Ürünleri® ve Milgo® lezzetlerini tek çatıda topluyor. Dönerden pizzaya, tavuk menülerinden enfes içeceklere kadar canın ne çekiyorsa; evde, işte ya da restoranda sadece birkaç tık uzağında!

Sana Gelsin veya Gel Al!
Sana Gelsin seçeneğiyle favori restoranını seç, online veya kapıda ödeme yöntemiyle siparişin hızlıca kapına gelsin. Vaktin kısıtlıysa Gel Al özelliğini kullan; siparişini önceden ver, restorana vardığında sıra beklemeden yemeğini teslim al.

Tıkla Pay ile Kazancını Katla
Tıkla Pay Cüzdan’ına hızlıca para yükle, pratik ödemenin tadını çıkar. İlk yüklemeye özel ve sonraki işlemlerinde kazandığın Tıkla Para’larla siparişlerini çok daha hesaplı hale getir.

Oyna Kazan ile Eğlenceyi Yakala
Sadece yemek değil, eğlence de bizde! Oyna Kazan özelliğiyle şansını dene ve siparişlerinde kullanabileceğin sürpriz hediyeler kazan.

Hemen Tıkla Gelsin®’i indir, bu lezzet dolu aileye katıl ve keyifli bir yemek deneyimi yaşamaya başla!

Sepette indirim fırsatlarını kaçırma
Tıkla Gelsin® yemek sitesi ve yemek siparişi uygulaması, kullanıcılarına benzersiz kampanyalar ve indirimler sunuyor. Burger King® siparişi, Popeyes® siparişi, Arby’s® siparişi, Subway® siparişi, Sbarro® siparişi, Usta Dönerci®, Usta Pideci® siparişi, Amasya Et Ürünleri® siparişi, Milgo® siparişi… Tıkla Gelsin® ile hepsi aynı uygulamada! Yapman gereken tek şey sepetini enfes lezzetlerle doldurmak ve indirim fırsatlarını yakalamak!

Fırsatlar ve İndirimler Tıkla Gelsin®’de
Tıklapay Cüzdan özelliği, ilk yüklemeye özel yüklediğin miktara göre değişen oranda Tıkla Para kazandırıyor. Sonraki para yüklemelerinde kazancını çoğaltma şansın var! Üstelik Arkadaşını Davet Et özelliği de Tıkla Para kazanma fırsatı sunuyor.
Lezzetli yemeklerin keyfini çıkarmak hiç bu kadar kolay olmamıştı. Hemen Tıkla Gelsin®’i indir ve keyifli bir yemek deneyimi yaşa!

name: Starbucks Türkiye
description:
Welcome to the exclusive world of Starbucks® Mobile App!

Features:
Your first coffee is on Starbucks!
Starbucks mobile app not only features delicious coffee and food options, but also offers great deals and promotions. And first-time users get a welcome coffee when they complete their registration!

Pay as you like and earn stars!
Whether you pay cash or by credit card or Starbucks® Mobile, you will earn stars in all your purchases.

Contactless Payment Convenience!
Use the QR code that appears when you shake your phone while the app is open to pay easily and quickly. You will earn stars in every purchase without waiting at the cash register!
Earn Stars with Every Beverage!
Earn one star in every purchase (for a minimum purchase amount of 25 TL). For every 15 stars you collect, you will receive a free tall drink!

Star-studded campaigns!
Don’t miss the surprises and campaigns only available to Starbucks Mobile App members or Starbucks Card holders! We also offer special deals and promotions for Starbucks Mobile App members. Starbucks Card holders and app users, who meet the campaign conditions after clicking the “Join campaign” button, may earn stars or benefit from the special offers.

Celebrate Your birthday with Starbucks coffee!
Enjoy a tall coffee as our birthday gift to you (provided that you have shopped at least once within the year and spent over 25 TL).

The mobile app makes it easy to top up Starbucks Card using a credit card and track your balance. Besides, you may now earn stars in all your purchases when you pay cash or by Starbucks® Mobile or credit card. You may view your balance, stars, and transaction history. The addresses of Starbucks stores, information on the product offering, and order tracking are other useful features of the app. If you are wearing a Garmin watch, you may also pay with the QR code on your smart watch. Download our app now for the unique Starbucks experience in the mobile world and start enjoying the exclusive privileges and surprises!

Starbucks mobile app is designed to offer the coffee fans the taste and quality they love. The app features freshly ground coffees, filter coffees and espresso-based drinks. Remember to check out various Starbucks products such as tumblers, mugs and coffee cups if you want to enjoy your coffee at home or in the office. Refreshing drinks such as Frappuccino and Cool Lime or Latte, Cortado, Americano, Mocha, White Chocolate Mocha, Ristretto Bianco, hot chocolate for coffee lovers, and many more options are available on the mobile app.

Cakes, cheesecakes, cookies, desserts, doughnuts, brownies and wafers to accompany your coffee and pastries, sandwiches, bagels, wraps, and salads to satisfy your hunger… Special flavors like Cool Lime, Berry Hibiscus, Orange Mango Refresha, White Chocolate Mocha, Chai Tea Latte, and parfait… all awaiting you on the mobile app.

There are so many options to choose from at Starbucks. Try our hot teas, chocolate cake or delicious croissants and snacks, and don’t miss the special espresso-based drinks such as Espresso Con Panna, Caffe Mocha, Caffe Latte, Misto coffee, Latte Macchiato, and Ristretto Bianco. Popular coffees like Caffe Americano and Caffe Misto are also here! If you want to take your coffee wherever you go or make your own at home, we offer a variety of Starbucks tumblers and coffee pods.

Your opinions matter to us. To help us improve your Starbucks mobile app experience, please send us your feedback and suggestions by email to infostarbucks-tr@alshaya.com. Remember, stars with every drink deal with every purchase, and a birthday coffee is only available to Starbucks Mobile App members. Download Starbucks Mobile App now and start enjoying your unique coffee experience!

name: Pluxee Türkiye
developer: Pluxee Calisan Deneyimi Danismanlik Ve Pazarlama Hizmetleri Anonim Sirketi
description:
Türkiye’nin lider kurumsal yan haklar çözümleri sunan Pluxee çalışan dünyasına renk katmak için yenilendi! Pluxee Türkiye mobil uygulaması ile hesabına tanınan bakiyeyi binlerce anlaşmalı restoran, kafe, market ve mağazada rahatlıkla kullanabilirsin. Pluxee Türkiye uygulamasının dijital cüzdan ve online alışveriş özelliği sayesinde artık tüm harcamalarını tek kanaldan yönetme imkanına sahipsin! İş yaşamında ve sosyal yaşamındaki tüm ihtiyaçların için Pluxee yanında.

Neden Pluxee Türkiye?
Yemek kartı ve hediye bakiyeleri tek uygulamada
Kullanıcı dostu arayüz
QR ve mobil kod ile ödeme imkanı
Binlerce üye iş yerinde avantajlı fırsatlar
Online alışveriş hizmeti
Hızlı ve güvenilir harcama yönetimi

Yemek Kartı ve Hediye Bakiyelerin Yönetimi Tek Uygulamada
Bir yemek kartı uygulamasında ihtiyacın olabilecek her şey Pluxee’de! Kullanıcı dostu arayüz tasarımıyla öne çıkan uygulamamız iş dünyasının temposuna ayak uydurman için geliştirildi. Pluxee Türkiye ile yemek kartı ve online hediye kartı bakiyelerini pratik bir şekilde kullanabilirsin. Ayrıca yüklenmeyi bekleyen yemek kartı ücreti ve geçmiş harcamalarına ait detayları kolayca görüntüleyebilirsin. 
Uygulamayı İndir, QR Kod İle Öde, Zaman Kaybetme!

Pluxee Türkiye ile restoranlarda ödeme yapmak artık daha kolay ve hızlı. Artık fiziksel kartını yanına almana gerek yok!  Pluxee Türkiye uygulamasındaki QR kod ile ödeme özelliğinden yararlanarak pratik bir şekilde ödeme yapabilirsin. Hijyenik, hızlı ve güvenli bir ödeme deneyimi için doğru adrestesin.

120.000‘den Fazla Harcama Noktasını Uygulama ile Keşfet!
Binlerce üye iş yerinin bulunduğu Pluxee dünyasının seçim özgürlüğü Pluxee Türkiye uygulamasında da geçerli. 120.000’den fazla harcama noktasını uygulama üzerinden görüntüleyerek konumuna en yakın yerleri rahatlıkla keşfedebilirsin. Bunun için uygulama içerisinde yer alan “Pluxee’li Mekanlar” bölümüne tıklaman yeterli. Bu bölümden yemek kartı geçen marketleri ve diğer harcama noktalarını rahatlıkla görüntüleyebilirsin. 

Fırsatlarla ve Kampanyalarla Dolu Bir Uygulama
Pluxee’nin çalışan dünyasına özel sunduğu fırsatları incelemen ve faydalanman artık çok kolay! Pluxee Türkiye uygulaması ile sana özel sunduğumuz kampanyaları ve anlık hediyeleri rahatlıkla takip edebilirsin. Pluxee’nin ayrıcalıklı hizmetleri arasında bulunan Plus Puan sistemi uygulamada seni bekliyor. Pluxee bakiyen ile yaptığın harcamalarda %10’a varan Pluxee Puan kazanma imkanına sahipsin. Kazandığın Plus Puan’ları uygulama üzerinden rahatlıkla değerlendirebilirsin. 

Geniş Online Alışveriş Ağı Pluxee Uygulamasında
Pluxee Türkiye sadece fiziksel alışverişlerde değil, online alışverişlerde de harcama yapma imkanı sunan yemek kartı firmaları arasında yer alıyor. Yemek ve market ihtiyaçlarını hızlı bir şekilde karşılamak için online alışveriş imkanından da faydalanabilirsin. Online alışveriş imkanı sunan üye işyerleri, kampanyalar ve daha fazlası Pluxee Türkiye uygulaması ile elinin altında. 

Senden gelen talep ve önerileri önemsiyoruz. Daha iyi hizmet sunmak için uygulamamızı güncellemeye devam edeceğiz. Yeni önerilerin ya da taleplerini musteri.hizmetleri@pluxeegroup.com adresi üzerinden bizlerle paylaşabilirsin.

name: Kahve Dünyası – Çekirdek Kazan
developer: Altınkılıçlar Kahve Kakao Ürünleri Ticaret Ve Sanayi A.Ş.
description:
KAHVE DÜNYASI ARTIK SANA DAHA YAKIN!

Kahve Dünyası uygulamasıyla artık seni daha yakından tanıyor, sana özel kampanyalar hazırlıyoruz. Böylece 190’dan fazla mağazamızda alışveriş yaparken; hediye kahve, ödül puanlar kazanıp mobil uygulamamızla kolayca ve dilediğince harcayabilirsin. Üstelik uygulamayı ilk kez indiren kullanıcılara bir adet Kahve Damgası bizden hediye!  

Özellikler:

· Türkiye’nin ilk uzaktan kahve sipariş sistemi Hazır Al artık hayatımızda. Seçtiğin mağazadan, seçtiğin ürünleri sepete ekle. Mağazamıza geldiğinde sipariş teslim numarasını söylemen yeterli. Siparişini sıra beklemeden teslim alabilirsin. 


· Her alışverişten Kahve Dünyası ödül puanı; ÇEKİRDEK topla, dilediğince harca! Kazanılan her ÇEKİRDEK 1 TL değerinde olup, ÇEKİRDEKLER mağazalarımızda para gibi kullanılabilir.


· Kazandığın ÇEKİRDEKLERİ dilersen mağazalarımızda harcayabilir, ya da sevdiklerine hediye olarak gönderebilirsin.


· Aldığın her Al-Götür kahvede 6 adet DAMGA biriktir, 1 adet Al-Götür Kahve kazan.


· Unutma, ÇEKİRDEK ve DAMGA kazanmak için QR kodunu her alışverişinde kasaya okutmalısın. “QR kodumu nasıl okutacağım?” dersen; uygulama sağ üst köşesindeki QR koda tıklayarak ya da telefonunu sallayarak gelen QR kodu kasaya gösterip kampanyalardan yararlanabilirsin.


· İşlem Geçmişi sekmesinden ÇEKİRDEK, DAMGA ve sana özel indirimler gibi işlem geçmişlerini kolaylıkla takip edebilirsin.


· Yol Tarifi Al özelliği ile mağazalarımıza ulaşmak artık çok kolay! Semt, Cadde, Sokak gibi bilgilerle sana en yakın mağazaları aratabilir, ilgili mağazanın menüsü, açık oturma alanı, otopark ve internet erişimi gibi bilgileri de tek tıkla inceleyebilirsin.


· Sana özel kampanyalardan ilk sen haberdar ol!


Kahve Dünyası Hakkında;


2004 yılında İstanbul’un Eminönü semtinde açtığımız ilk mağazamızla yakaladığımız büyüme ivmesini, her geçen gün daha da artırarak Türkiye’nin 34 şehrine ulaştık. 2011 yılında Londra Piccadilly Circus’ta açtığımız ilk yurt dışı mağazamızda gördüğümüz ilgiye karşılık olarak, ülke dışındaki girişimlerimize de hız verdik. Bugün yerli ve yabancı tüm tüketicilerimizin beğeni ve taleplerinden aldığımız güçle Türkiye, İngiltere, Romanya, Kuveyt ve Suudi Arabistan’da yer alan 190’dan fazla mağaza ile toplam 350’den fazla noktada müşterilerimizle buluşuyoruz.

Kaliteli ve lezzetli ürün yelpazemiz ve kusursuz servisimizle, kahve keyfi ve kahve falı kültürünün ayrılmaz bir parçası olan Türk kahvesi ve diğer özgün lezzetlerimizi, Türk ikram geleneği ve konukseverliğini sergileyerek dünyaya tanıtmaya devam ediyoruz.

name: CookRight: AI Sous Chef
description:
Cooking for a table where one person has a peanut allergy, one’s keto, and one hates mushrooms? CookRight turns “who’s eating + what do you fancy” into one recipe everyone at your table can actually eat.

Set your table once. Up to 8 eater profiles — allergies, diets (halal, kosher, vegan, keto, low-FODMAP), goals, dislikes, and real appetites, from toddler portions to teenage ones.

Ask for dinner, not a search. Tap a mood — quick, comfort, one pot — or type a craving. In about 90 seconds you have a recipe scaled to your table’s real portions, with a named check for every person on it: no peanuts (Ali) · keto (Sara) · 30 min.

Allergies are hard limits, not preferences. Every recipe — and every substitution — is checked against a versioned allergen list, including hidden sources like soy sauce (wheat) or marzipan (almond). There is no override button. We didn’t hide one; we didn’t build one. When we’re not certain about an ingredient, we say “may contain” and treat it as if it does.

One base, two finishes. When one eater’s portion must differ, the recipe forks late — cook one pot, finish one portion separately, with clear cross-contamination guidance when an allergy is involved.

Cook Mode built for kitchens. Big type you can read at arm’s length, one step in focus, timers inline, screen stays awake, works fully offline once the recipe is open.

It learns quietly. Your answers become preferences — after a week it stops asking how spicy.

Free for good. Three fresh dinners a month, your saved recipes, your whole household and the full allergen checking cost nothing. CookRight Pro removes the monthly limit for $4.99/month or $39.99/year. Allergy checking is never behind the paywall.

Always check labels — ingredients change. CookRight helps you plan around dietary rules; it is not medical advice.

name: Recipe Box - Recipy
description:

Recipe Box – Recipy makes it incredibly simple to save, organize, and cook your favorite meals, all in one place. Say goodbye to messy screenshots, scattered notes, and endless scrolling. We built Recipe Box – Recipy for home cooks who want less chaos and more great food. Import recipes from social media, snap a photo of a dish to generate a recipe, browse the web inside the app, or paste raw text to instantly create clear cooking instructions.

Automatically see calories, protein, carbs, and fats for every recipe you save.

Your Recipe Box stays synced across all your devices, so your recipes are always with you.

Features

• Save Recipes – Import recipes directly from Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube; ingredients and steps are automatically formatted into a readable recipe.

GET ORGANISED
Pick your recipes and Mob handles the rest. Meal plan your week, get a smart shopping list sorted by supermarket aisle, and change portion sizes with a tap so you only buy what you need. Want more protein, more veg, or just a more balanced plate? Every Mob recipe comes with full nutrition info and macros, including high protein and lighter options, plus veggie and vegetarian recipes. Eating well is easy, and it never feels like a diet.

WHAT YOU GET

PERFECT FOR
Busy weeknights, families, meal preppers, and anyone who wants to eat better without spending the whole evening in the kitchen. Whether you're cooking for one, feeding a hungry household, or doing a big Sunday batch cook, Mob fits around you.

NO BOXES, NO LOCK IN
Unlike a meal kit, there's no rigid box turning up at your door. You buy your own ingredients, your way, at your own supermarket, and cook what you actually feel like eating. Mob gives you the plan and the recipes, you stay in control of the rest.

name: Mela - Recipe Manager
description:
Mela is a simple, elegant and modern recipe manager that syncs with iCloud.

SYNC
Sync your recipes with iCloud, either privately (default) or by sharing a recipe library with other iCloud users.

IN-APP BROWSER WITH LIVE PREVIEW
Quickly save a recipe while browsing: If Mela detects a recipe on the currently viewed page, it will be displayed in Mela's native recipe viewer*, on the same screen on the iPad and a swipe-left away on the iPhone. Want to add or view a recipe from outside of Mela? No problem, just use Mela's sharing extension.

FEEDS
Subscribe to your favorite recipe blogs to view all the recipes in Mela's native recipe viewer*.

COOK MODE
The cook mode makes it easy to follow all steps while cooking, displayed using a larger font to make sure everything stays readable even when you're not right in front of your device. You can add multiple recipes to the cook mode, easily letting you switch between them.

TIMERS
No need to switch to another app for setting up a timer. When in cooking mode, Mela let's you easily create and manage timers.
Timers come with support for Live Activities (iOS 16.1+).

SCANNER
Scan a recipe from a book: With the help of text recognition, you can just add it to your personal collection and view it in Mela's native recipe viewer, as any other recipe.

GROCERIES
Mela uses the Reminders.app to manage your grocery list. This has the advantage that you’re always able to access your grocery list on all your devices even if Mela is not installed on a specific device.

CALENDAR
Do your meal planning by using Mela's built-in calendar. It's managed by Calendar.app which also has the advantage that you're always able to access it on all your devices. There's also a widget, showing you the next planned meal from your calendar.

ORGANIZING
Recipes can be organized in categories, marked as “Favorite” or as “Want to Cook”.

PRINTING
Of course, Mela supports printing in case there’s a recipe you want to have on paper or save as PDF.


Please note: 
If iCloud Sync is enabled (default), Mela will sync these items with iCloud:
- Recipes
- Browser bookmarks
- Subscription list (feeds)
Not synced:
- Feed recipe entries
- Browser history
Groceries are always stored in Reminders.app

Mela is free to download but will require a one-time purchase to unlock all features.


* Extracting recipes only works for websites that support this, most of them do.

name: Minik Lokmalar
description:
Minik Lokmalar – Ek gıdaya geçişte en büyük yardımcınız

Minik Lokmalar, ek gıdaya geçen bebekler için özenle hazırlanmış, sağlıklı ve dengeli yemek tarifleri sunan kapsamlı bir mobil uygulamadır. Her tarif, bebeklerin gelişim dönemleri ve beslenme ihtiyaçları göz önünde bulundurularak oluşturulmuştur. Uygulama, ebeveynlere güvenilir içerikler sunarken aynı zamanda kullanım kolaylığıyla da ön plana çıkar.

Uygulamada yer alan tarifler, yalnızca lezzetli değil, aynı zamanda besleyici değerleriyle de öne çıkar. Her tarifin altında yer alan besin içeriği açıklamaları sayesinde, bebeğinize hangi vitamin ve mineralleri kazandırdığınızı kolayca öğrenebilirsiniz. Tarifler, uzman görüşleri doğrultusunda, bebeğinizin ayına ve gelişim sürecine uygun olarak seçilmiştir.

Minik Lokmalar'ın kullanıcı dostu arayüzü sayesinde sevdiğiniz tarifleri favorilerinize ekleyebilir, istediğiniz zaman kolayca erişebilirsiniz. Böylece zaman kazanır ve en çok tercih ettiğiniz tariflere her an ulaşabilirsiniz.

Tarif açıklamaları oldukça detaylıdır. Hangi malzemelerin nasıl hazırlanacağı, pişirme süreleri ve dikkat edilmesi gereken noktalar adım adım açıklanır. Bu sayede mutfakta deneyimi olmayan ebeveynler dahi gönül rahatlığıyla tarifleri uygulayabilir.

Bebeğinizin sağlığı bizim için öncelikli. Bu nedenle tariflerde bulunan potansiyel alerjenler açıkça belirtilmiştir. Bu özellik sayesinde bebeğinizin hassasiyetlerini göz önünde bulundurarak güvenli bir şekilde tarif seçebilirsiniz.

Uygulamada her damak zevkine uygun geniş bir tarif yelpazesi bulunur. Mevsimsel malzemelere göre güncellenen tarifler, taze ve sağlıklı beslenme alışkanlıklarını destekler.

Minik Lokmalar ile:

Ek gıdaya geçiş sürecini bilinçli ve planlı yönetebilirsiniz.

Bebeğiniz için sağlıklı, dengeli ve lezzetli öğünler hazırlayabilirsiniz.

Favori tariflerinizi saklayabilir, dilediğiniz zaman tekrar ulaşabilirsiniz.

Alerjen bilgileri sayesinde daha güvenli tercihler yapabilirsiniz.

Gıda içeriği hakkında bilgi sahibi olarak besin çeşitliliği sağlayabilirsiniz.

Minik Lokmalar, ebeveynlerin en değerli yol arkadaşı olmak için tasarlandı. Siz de uygulamayı indirerek bu yolculukta bebeğinizin sağlıklı gelişimine katkıda bulunabilirsiniz.

name: CookRight: AI Sous Chef
description:
Cooking for a table where one person has a peanut allergy, one’s keto, and one hates mushrooms? CookRight turns “who’s eating + what do you fancy” into one recipe everyone at your table can actually eat.

Set your table once. Up to 8 eater profiles — allergies, diets (halal, kosher, vegan, keto, low-FODMAP), goals, dislikes, and real appetites, from toddler portions to teenage ones.

Ask for dinner, not a search. Tap a mood — quick, comfort, one pot — or type a craving. In about 90 seconds you have a recipe scaled to your table’s real portions, with a named check for every person on it: no peanuts (Ali) · keto (Sara) · 30 min.

Allergies are hard limits, not preferences. Every recipe — and every substitution — is checked against a versioned allergen list, including hidden sources like soy sauce (wheat) or marzipan (almond). There is no override button. We didn’t hide one; we didn’t build one. When we’re not certain about an ingredient, we say “may contain” and treat it as if it does.

One base, two finishes. When one eater’s portion must differ, the recipe forks late — cook one pot, finish one portion separately, with clear cross-contamination guidance when an allergy is involved.

Cook Mode built for kitchens. Big type you can read at arm’s length, one step in focus, timers inline, screen stays awake, works fully offline once the recipe is open.

It learns quietly. Your answers become preferences — after a week it stops asking how spicy.

Free for good. Three fresh dinners a month, your saved recipes, your whole household and the full allergen checking cost nothing. CookRight Pro removes the monthly limit for $4.99/month or $39.99/year. Allergy checking is never behind the paywall.

Always check labels — ingredients change. CookRight helps you plan around dietary rules; it is not medical advice.

- “It takes too long! I don’t have hours to spend in the kitchen.”
- “Healthy food is too bland”
- “Meal prep is too complicated”

Kevin Curry, founder of FitMenCook, has been there. After spotting a picture of himself on a friend’s Facebook wall he knew it was time for a change.

He followed all the common advice, changed to a healthy diet and started hitting the gym.

For a few months, things were great, but after a while he found himself craving the old foods he was trying so hard to avoid.

He got his hands on every book he could find on nutrition and started experimenting in the kitchen.

His aims were simple:

A) Food should be easy to prepare and affordable
B) Food should be vibrant and tasty, never boring
C) Preparing food in advance is important
D) Following a, b, c helps you achieve your fitness goals

The results were a game changer for Kevin and now he’s sharing that message to the FitMenCook community on social media, inside the FMC app and as a bestselling cookbook author.

Not only is Kevin a great host, who’ll fill you with inspiration for healthy meals, but he’ll also break down the steps in a way that’s easy to follow.

#3
FOCUS ON MEAL PREP

Many of us don’t have time every day to spend in the kitchen.

Meal prep is the solution. Setting aside two days of the week as your main cooking days, you can prepare your meals in bulk and eat healthy all week.

This is a crucial part of the app, and many of the meals are designed with meal preparation in mind, to make healthy living fit with a busy life.

#4
MACRO COUNTING AND INTEGRATION WITH APPLE HEALTH APP

Every recipe includes nutritional information. Calories, protein, carbs, fat and fiber. You can also sync all this data to your Apple Health app.

THE BASICS:
1.⁠ ⁠Yummy and healthy recipes, using natural ingredients. No artificial sweeteners, etc.

3.⁠ ⁠Quick & easy! I know, it’s not possible to spend hours in the kitchen every day.
4.⁠ ⁠All recipes are perfect for a fit lifestyle. Huge amounts of fats or sugar (alternatives) are therefore not part of the Pam app.
5.⁠ ⁠Take responsibility! If you want to feel amazing, you have to know about what you eat, the quality of the ingredients and how your dish was prepared. You should not give the responsibility about your health to somebody else. That means: less processed foods, more homemade meals!

•⁠  ⁠Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Sweets, Drinks & Snacks.

Struggle free, healthy recipes that are easy on the wallet. It’s as simple as that, and it’s a message that’s seen over 1 million people follow FitMenCook on social media.

Be honest, have you ever heard these complaints about healthy eating?

- “Eating healthy is too expensive!”
- “It takes too long! I don’t have hours to spend in the kitchen.”
- “Healthy food is too bland”

Kevin Curry, founder of FitMenCook, has been there. After spotting a picture of himself on a friend’s Facebook wall he knew it was time for a change.

For a few months, things were great, but after a while he found himself craving the old foods he was trying so hard to avoid.

He got his hands on every book he could find on nutrition and started experimenting in the kitchen.

His aims were simple:

A) Food should be easy to prepare and affordable
B) Food should be vibrant and tasty, never boring
C) Preparing food in advance is important

FOCUS ON MEAL PREP

Meal prep is the solution. Setting aside two days of the week as your main cooking days, you can prepare your meals in bulk and eat healthy all week.

This is a crucial part of the app, and many of the meals are designed with meal preparation in mind, to make healthy living fit with a busy life.

•Extraction Yield normalization is automatically provided on the VST Universal Brewing Control Chart for all brew methods: Drip, Infusion, Espresso, Cupping; brew water temperature (volume measurements); liquid retained in spent grounds; CO2 & Moisture content of the ground coffee.  Defaults are provided for all preferences, and may be customized separately for all modes as required.

• A wide array of Presets are provided in all modes of operation that are typical of those found in home and commercial service. Each mode provides a full set of custom Presets that are user defined.

• Full recipe details database maintained separately for Coffee, Espresso and Cupping. Sorting by Date, Name and Taste Score provided. 

• The VST Universal Brewing Control Chart supports direct touch-screen data input, pan and zoom functions, auto-scrolling of chart with ordinate and abscissa axis and reset functions. 

Design points for % TDS and % EXT are step-less with snap-to-grid increments provided (TDS @ 0.05% and EXT at 0.1% increments). 

Region of Interest (ROI) overlays are optionally provided for SCAA, SCAE, NCA regions with taste defect labels. Custom User defined ROI is also included separately for all modes.  

• Complete calculation results are displayed for: Dose, Brew Water, Beverage, Liquid Retained Ratio, Spent Grounds Weight, Coffee or Espresso Brew Ratio, Extraction Yield in both Design and Measured values.

BATCHES & FERMENTATION

BREW DAY TIMER

- Hold-temperature prompts for every mash step

RECIPE & CALCULATORS
- Estimate original gravity and beer colour (SRM) from your grain bill

YEAST & CELLAR
- Strain library with ideal fermentation temperature ranges
- Malt and hop store with alpha-acid tracking
- Low-stock flags so you reorder before brew day

SANITATION & TASTING
- Equipment sanitation checklist to keep infection out
- Tasting passport to grade head, body, aroma and finish on every batch

BUILT FOR
- All-grain and BIAB brewers optimising efficiency
- Extract beginners getting to grips with the numbers
- Lager and ale brewers managing strain temperatures
- Anyone bottling who wants carbonation without bottle bombs

Measure once, brew with confidence.
LabBrew keeps the chemistry honest, batch after batch.
