description:
Love, Manuela is a baking app created by Norwegian baker Manuela Kjeilen, known as @passionforbaking. For more than a decade, Manuela has shared her love of baking with people around the world. She has published nine baking books, hosted her own baking show on TV in Sweden, and inspires more than 1.6 million followers on Instagram with her cakes, recipes, and beautiful baking ideas.

Inside the Love, Manuela app, you get instant access to more than 470 baking recipes, all written in English, with high-quality step-by-step photos for every recipe from beginning to end.

One-time purchase. No subscription. New recipes are included when they are added.

For Manuela, taste always comes first. Beautiful cakes are lovely, but the most important thing is that every bite tastes delicious. Her recipes are created to let the flavors shine, with soft textures, creamy fillings, balanced sweetness, and desserts that taste just as good as they look. From everyday treats to celebration cakes, the recipes are made for home baking.

Inside the app, you will find sponge cakes in many variations, ganaches in delicious flavors like strawberry, latte, and banana milkshake, lots of Scandinavian-style cakes, light fillings, cheesecakes, ice creams, sweet dough, frostings, cookies, cupcakes, and so much more.

The app is made to feel like a growing digital baking book that you can return to again and again. It is easy to navigate, with clear recipe categories, improved search and filtering, and helpful tags so you can quickly find what you are looking for. A few more categories have also been added to make browsing even easier.

Each recipe opens with a large photo and a short introduction, followed by clear directions, recipe notes, a place where you can write your own notes, and step-by-step photos that guide you through the recipe. Whether you are baking a cake, preparing a filling, whipping a frosting, or making cookies, the app is designed to help you feel confident in every step.

New Cake Mode helps keep your screen awake while you read and follow a recipe, so you do not have to keep touching your phone or tablet while your hands are busy baking. The app has also been refined with improved UI, a smoother overall user experience, and an improved password reset flow.

Love, Manuela is not a subscription. It is a one-time purchase of $12.99, converted to your local currency by the App Store or Google Play. You get access to all recipes inside the app instantly, and when new recipes are added in the future, they are included at no extra cost.

Your purchase is connected to the store account you buy it with, either App Store or Google Play. You can restore your purchase anytime using the same store account.

What you get inside the app:

More than 470 baking recipes
Recipes written in English only
Clear and easy-to-follow instructions
High-quality step-by-step photos for every recipe
Easy recipe categories
Improved search and filtering
Helpful tags to find recipes faster
A place to write your own notes inside each recipe
Recipe notes and tips from Manuela
Cake Mode to keep your screen awake while baking
Access to new recipes when they are added
One-time purchase on this platform
No subscription

This is not a baking video app. The Love, Manuela app is focused on written recipes, high-quality photos, clear directions, recipe notes, and step-by-step pictures for every recipe. It is created for bakers who love to read, follow, save, and return to recipes whenever they want.

The Love, Manuela app has more than 75,000 registered users worldwide, and Manuela’s recipes are loved by home bakers, cake lovers, professional bakers, and bakeries around the world.

If you love soft cakes, sponge cakes, ganache, creamy frostings, light fillings, cupcakes, cookies, Scandinavian-style baking, sweet dough, cheesecakes, ice creams, and homemade desserts that taste as good as they look, you are going to love the Love, Manuela app.

XO,
Love, Manuela

description:
Struggle free, healthy recipes that are easy on the wallet. It’s as simple as that, and it’s a message that’s seen over 1 million people follow FitMenCook on social media.

Be honest, have you ever heard these complaints about healthy eating?

- “Eating healthy is too expensive!”
- “It takes too long! I don’t have hours to spend in the kitchen.”
- “Healthy food is too bland”
- “Meal prep is too complicated”

Kevin Curry, founder of FitMenCook, has been there. After spotting a picture of himself on a friend’s Facebook wall he knew it was time for a change.

He followed all the common advice, changed to a healthy diet and started hitting the gym.

For a few months, things were great, but after a while he found himself craving the old foods he was trying so hard to avoid.

He got his hands on every book he could find on nutrition and started experimenting in the kitchen.

His aims were simple:

A) Food should be easy to prepare and affordable
B) Food should be vibrant and tasty, never boring
C) Preparing food in advance is important
D) Following a, b, c helps you achieve your fitness goals

The results were a game changer for Kevin and now he’s sharing that message to the FitMenCook community on social media, inside the FMC app and as a bestselling cookbook author.

Top 5 features:

#1
SHOPPING LIST

We've taken the hassle out of grocery shopping. Add any recipes you want to your shopping list and we'll organise the list by aisle, so you can easily find the items you need.

#2
EASY STEP BY STEP VIDEO INSTRUCTIONS

If you’ve ever looked at recipe instructions and thought “this just looks too difficult for me” then you’ll find the included recipe videos very helpful. Not only is Kevin a great host, who’ll fill you with inspiration for healthy meals, but he’ll also break down the steps in a way that’s easy to follow.

#3
FOCUS ON MEAL PREP

Many of us don’t have time every day to spend in the kitchen.

Meal prep is the solution. Setting aside two days of the week as your main cooking days, you can prepare your meals in bulk and eat healthy all week.

This is a crucial part of the app, and many of the meals are designed with meal preparation in mind, to make healthy living fit with a busy life.

#4
MACRO COUNTING AND INTEGRATION WITH APPLE HEALTH APP

Every recipe includes nutritional information. Calories, protein, carbs, fat and fiber. You can also sync all this data to your Apple Health app.

#5
SCALE UP A RECIPE

Adjust the number of servings s by tapping the + and - buttons in the recipe view. You can also switch the measurements between metric and imperial.

name: Cookpad: Recipe Book & Meals

Trustworthy recipes, written by the people who cook them every day, not by an editorial team. Every Cooksnap is a photo from someone who made it before you, with comments on how it went: where it goes wrong, whether the measurements add up, how long it really takes. THE RECIPES YOU GREW UP WITH
Cottage pie, corned beef hash, bubble and squeak, Sunday roast, Yorkshire puddings, scones and Victoria sponge: the dishes people actually make at home, written by the people who make them.
IMPORT FROM ANYWHERE, INCLUDING INSTAGRAM AND TIKTOK
Write your own recipes or import your favourites from any website, from Instagram, from TikTok, from a book or from a handwritten notebook. Build your own biggest recipe collection, all in one place.
Tap Share and the recipe is added straight to your collection — ingredients and steps separated, ready to follow. No more screenshots lost in your camera roll. Save them as drafts and finish them whenever you want.
AUTOMATIC TRANSLATION
Find a recipe in Spanish, Italian or Japanese and read it in English: the translation is automatic.
AD-FREE. ALWAYS.
No ads, not even in the free version. No banner to close with flour on your hands, no video starting up while you're reading the measurements.
YOUR DIGITAL RECIPE BOOK, ALL IN ONE PLACE
Your recipe book, recipe keeper and cooking app in one. Save recipes from anywhere and find them in seconds.
• Import & Scan: Import any recipe from a website or a social post in one tap. Snap a photo of a handwritten recipe or a cookbook page: AI turns it into a digital recipe.
• Create with AI: Write your own recipes with the AI Recipe Assistant, without forgetting a single step. Save the draft and finish it whenever you have time.
• Organise & Plan: Sort everything into private folders by theme — chicken, baking, gluten-free, breakfast. Build your weekly menu in a few taps and let your shopping list build itself from your recipes: you only add what's missing.
• Cook What You Have: Cook with what's already in your fridge or cupboard. Save money, use your leftovers and reduce food waste.
FOR EVERY TASTE AND NEED
Healthy lunch ideas, breakfast, easy midweek meals, packed lunches and batch cooking. Comfort food and classics, seasonal veg, and baking from lemon drizzle to sticky toffee pudding — plus cuisines from around the world: Indian, Italian, Thai, Japanese, Chinese.
Filters for vegetarian, vegan, keto, gluten-free, low-carb and baby-led weaning. Tools: air fryer, slow cooker, pressure cooker, bread maker, one-pan and no-bake.
SHARE YOUR COOKING
Share recipes with friends, family and the community — or keep them private, just for you. Upload photos of the dishes you've made (Cooksnaps) and tell everyone how it went. Follow home cooks and food creators from around the world.
JOIN A COMMUNITY THAT COOKS EVERY DAY
For everyone, beginners to experienced cooks.

description:
Love, Manuela is a baking app created by Norwegian baker Manuela Kjeilen, known as @passionforbaking. For more than a decade, Manuela has shared her love of baking with people around the world. She has published nine baking books, hosted her own baking show on TV in Sweden, and inspires more than 1.6 million followers on Instagram with her cakes, recipes, and beautiful baking ideas.

Inside the Love, Manuela app, you get instant access to more than 470 baking recipes, all written in English, with high-quality step-by-step photos for every recipe from beginning to end.

One-time purchase. No subscription. New recipes are included when they are added.

For Manuela, taste always comes first. Beautiful cakes are lovely, but the most important thing is that every bite tastes delicious. Her recipes are created to let the flavors shine, with soft textures, creamy fillings, balanced sweetness, and desserts that taste just as good as they look. From everyday treats to celebration cakes, the recipes are made for home baking.

Inside the app, you will find sponge cakes in many variations, ganaches in delicious flavors like strawberry, latte, and banana milkshake, lots of Scandinavian-style cakes, light fillings, cheesecakes, ice creams, sweet dough, frostings, cookies, cupcakes, and so much more.

The app is made to feel like a growing digital baking book that you can return to again and again. It is easy to navigate, with clear recipe categories, improved search and filtering, and helpful tags so you can quickly find what you are looking for. A few more categories have also been added to make browsing even easier.

Each recipe opens with a large photo and a short introduction, followed by clear directions, recipe notes, a place where you can write your own notes, and step-by-step photos that guide you through the recipe. Whether you are baking a cake, preparing a filling, whipping a frosting, or making cookies, the app is designed to help you feel confident in every step.

New Cake Mode helps keep your screen awake while you read and follow a recipe, so you do not have to keep touching your phone or tablet while your hands are busy baking. The app has also been refined with improved UI, a smoother overall user experience, and an improved password reset flow.

Love, Manuela is not a subscription. It is a one-time purchase of $12.99, converted to your local currency by the App Store or Google Play. You get access to all recipes inside the app instantly, and when new recipes are added in the future, they are included at no extra cost.

Your purchase is connected to the store account you buy it with, either App Store or Google Play. You can restore your purchase anytime using the same store account.

What you get inside the app:

More than 470 baking recipes
Recipes written in English only
Clear and easy-to-follow instructions
High-quality step-by-step photos for every recipe
Easy recipe categories
Improved search and filtering
Helpful tags to find recipes faster
A place to write your own notes inside each recipe
Recipe notes and tips from Manuela
Cake Mode to keep your screen awake while baking
Access to new recipes when they are added
One-time purchase on this platform
No subscription

This is not a baking video app. The Love, Manuela app is focused on written recipes, high-quality photos, clear directions, recipe notes, and step-by-step pictures for every recipe. It is created for bakers who love to read, follow, save, and return to recipes whenever they want.

The Love, Manuela app has more than 75,000 registered users worldwide, and Manuela’s recipes are loved by home bakers, cake lovers, professional bakers, and bakeries around the world.

If you love soft cakes, sponge cakes, ganache, creamy frostings, light fillings, cupcakes, cookies, Scandinavian-style baking, sweet dough, cheesecakes, ice creams, and homemade desserts that taste as good as they look, you are going to love the Love, Manuela app.

Happy baking!

Love, Manuela

description:
Total Keto Diet is your go-to keto diet app for low carb recipes, keto meals & exercise tracking. 1000s of delicious keto recipes, calorie & macro tracker, exercise & workout tracking, keto community, custom meal plans tailored around you and your goals, keto diet articles, shopping lists & more low carb diet goodness.

Total Keto Diet is made by Tasteaholics, a leading keto diet & low carb recipe resource, with the goal to make your keto diet easier and more achievable.

KETO DIET APP & LOW CARB RECIPE FEATURES:
• Macro Tracker - track your calories & macros every day - being on a low carb diet is easier than ever!
• Custom Meal Plans - tailored to you

• Shopping List – add ingredients from keto recipes or your own ingredients.
• Beginner’s Keto Diet Guide - to help you understand everything about the keto diet and get started with your keto diet immediately.

WHAT IS THE KETO DIET?

The keto diet (also known as a ketogenic diet, low carb diet and LCHF diet) is a low carbohydrate, high-fat diet. Maintaining a low carb diet is great for weight loss. Moreover, according to an increasing number of studies, a low carb diet helps reduce risk factors for diabetes, heart diseases, stroke, Alzheimer’s, epilepsy, and more!

WHY REDUCE CARBS?

We’re beginning to understand that carbs in large quantities are more harmful than previously thought, while most fats are healthy & essential (the basis of a low carb diet).

When you eat lots of carbs, your blood sugar is consistently elevated and, as a result, so is insulin. Insulin is a hormone that keeps your blood sugar in check by shuttling the glucose into cells, but when there’s a consistently high amount of insulin, your cells become resistant.

This insulin resistance makes it easier to store fat, and chronically high levels of insulin also cause excessive inflammation in the body, which contributes to heart disease, high blood pressure and eventually type 2 diabetes.

A keto diet can reverse these harmful effects & restores insulin sensitivity.

THE KETO DIET IS STARTING A NUTRITION REVOLUTION!

The nutritional landscape is changing. The keto diet (low carb diet) is growing in acceptance and a nutritional revolution is beginning. We are starting to realize the detrimental effects of our relationship with excess sugar & carbs.

The keto diet focuses on low carb recipes to keep your blood sugar stable, helping your body regain insulin sensitivity and keeping your mood & energy levels stable. When you’re on a ketogenic diet, you can expect to:
• Lose body fat
• Have consistent energy levels during the day
• Stay satiated after meals longer, less snacking and overeating

THOUSANDS OF LOW CARB DIET & KETO RECIPES!

We’ve included thousands of low carb recipes for you to choose from. 
• Keep carbs low – under 30g a day
• Increase your protein intake
• Keep you full and satiated from delicious meals

Be honest, have you ever heard these complaints about healthy eating?

- “Eating healthy is too expensive!”
- “It takes too long! I don’t have hours to spend in the kitchen.”
- “Healthy food is too bland”
- “Meal prep is too complicated”

Kevin Curry, founder of FitMenCook, has been there. After spotting a picture of himself on a friend’s Facebook wall he knew it was time for a change.

He followed all the common advice, changed to a healthy diet and started hitting the gym.

For a few months, things were great, but after a while he found himself craving the old foods he was trying so hard to avoid.

He got his hands on every book he could find on nutrition and started experimenting in the kitchen.

His aims were simple:

A) Food should be easy to prepare and affordable
B) Food should be vibrant and tasty, never boring
C) Preparing food in advance is important
D) Following a, b, c helps you achieve your fitness goals

The results were a game changer for Kevin and now he’s sharing that message to the FitMenCook community on social media, inside the FMC app and as a bestselling cookbook author.

#1
SHOPPING LIST

We've taken the hassle out of grocery shopping. Add any recipes you want to your shopping list and we'll organise the list by aisle, so you can easily find the items you need.

EASY STEP BY STEP VIDEO INSTRUCTIONS

If you’ve ever looked at recipe instructions and thought “this just looks too difficult for me” then you’ll find the included recipe videos very helpful. Not only is Kevin a great host, who’ll fill you with inspiration for healthy meals, but he’ll also break down the steps in a way that’s easy to follow.

#3
FOCUS ON MEAL PREP

Many of us don’t have time every day to spend in the kitchen.

Meal prep is the solution. Setting aside two days of the week as your main cooking days, you can prepare your meals in bulk and eat healthy all week.

This is a crucial part of the app, and many of the meals are designed with meal preparation in mind, to make healthy living fit with a busy life.

#4
MACRO COUNTING AND INTEGRATION WITH APPLE HEALTH APP

Every recipe includes nutritional information. Calories, protein, carbs, fat and fiber. You can also sync all this data to your Apple Health app.

Sync your recipes with iCloud, either privately (default) or by sharing a recipe library with other iCloud users.

IN-APP BROWSER WITH LIVE PREVIEW
Quickly save a recipe while browsing: If Mela detects a recipe on the currently viewed page, it will be displayed in Mela's native recipe viewer*, on the same screen on the iPad and a swipe-left away on the iPhone. Want to add or view a recipe from outside of Mela? No problem, just use Mela's sharing extension.

FEEDS
Subscribe to your favorite recipe blogs to view all the recipes in Mela's native recipe viewer*.

COOK MODE
The cook mode makes it easy to follow all steps while cooking, displayed using a larger font to make sure everything stays readable even when you're not right in front of your device. You can add multiple recipes to the cook mode, easily letting you switch between them.

TIMERS
No need to switch to another app for setting up a timer. When in cooking mode, Mela let's you easily create and manage timers.
Timers come with support for Live Activities (iOS 16.1+).

SCANNER
Scan a recipe from a book: With the help of text recognition, you can just add it to your personal collection and view it in Mela's native recipe viewer, as any other recipe.

GROCERIES
Mela uses the Reminders.app to manage your grocery list. This has the advantage that you’re always able to access your grocery list on all your devices even if Mela is not installed on a specific device.

CALENDAR
Do your meal planning by using Mela's built-in calendar. It's managed by Calendar.app which also has the advantage that you're always able to access it on all your devices. There's also a widget, showing you the next planned meal from your calendar.

ORGANIZING
Recipes can be organized in categories, marked as “Favorite” or as “Want to Cook”.

PRINTING
Of course, Mela supports printing in case there’s a recipe you want to have on paper or save as PDF.


Please note: 
If iCloud Sync is enabled (default), Mela will sync these items with iCloud:
- Recipes
- Browser bookmarks
- Subscription list (feeds)
Not synced:
- Feed recipe entries
- Browser history
Groceries are always stored in Reminders.app

Mela is free to download but will require a one-time purchase to unlock all features.

Mob turns cooking from a daily scramble into the best part of your day. Whether you want to get organised, eat a little healthier, or just stop making the same three dinners on repeat, we've got you, with delicious, reliable recipes and all the tools to plan, shop and cook around your real life.

GET ORGANISED
Pick your recipes and Mob handles the rest. Meal plan your week, get a smart shopping list sorted by supermarket aisle, and change portion sizes with a tap so you only buy what you need. Prep ahead so dinner's covered even on your busiest nights, and with our cook ahead and batch cook recipes you can cook once and eat well all week, we'll even show you how to freeze and reheat. New recipes drop every week from our in house chefs, so there's always something fresh worth cooking. EAT HEALTHIER, NO COMPROMISE
Want more protein, more veg, or just a more balanced plate? Every Mob recipe comes with full nutrition info and macros, including high protein and lighter options, plus veggie and vegetarian recipes. Eating well is easy, and it never feels like a diet.

WHAT YOU GET
- Smart shopping list, add every ingredient in one tap
- Weekly meal plans built for real life
- Search by ingredient to use up what you've already got

- High protein, veggie and family friendly recipes

- Nutrition and macros on every recipe
- Reliable, chef tested recipes that actually work

PERFECT FOR
Busy weeknights, families, meal preppers, and anyone who wants to eat better without spending the whole evening in the kitchen. Whether you're cooking for one, feeding a hungry household, or doing a big Sunday batch cook, Mob fits around you.

NO BOXES, NO LOCK IN
Unlike a meal kit, there's no rigid box turning up at your door. You buy your own ingredients, your way, at your own supermarket, and cook what you actually feel like eating. Mob gives you the plan and the recipes, you stay in control of the rest.

OUR MISSION
We're a community of over 1.5 million home cooks on a mission to make everyday cooking exciting again, not a chore, but something to look forward to. Cooking changes lives. It's better for your health, your mood and your wallet, and we're building a movement of people who cook as part of their weekly routine and are proud to say: "I'm a cook."

name: Cookpad: Recipe Book & Meals
description:
Not sure what to cook tonight? Cookpad recommends: search by ingredient or by meal across thousands of authentic recipes from a global community of home cooks — all verified by the people who have actually cooked them.
WHAT SHALL I COOK TONIGHT?
Tell us what's in the fridge and we'll tell you what to make with it. Chicken, eggs, mince beef, half a bag of pasta: every recipe we put in front of you has already been cooked by someone before you, who left a photo of how it turned out (Cooksnap) and wrote up how it went. It's not a list to scroll — it's a recommendation for tonight, with the proof that it works.
RECIPES VERIFIED BY THE COMMUNITY
Trustworthy recipes, written by the people who cook them every day, not by an editorial team. Every Cooksnap is a photo from someone who made it before you, with comments on how it went: where it goes wrong, whether the measurements add up, how long it really takes. That's how we know what to recommend — no editor decides it, the person who cooked it proves it.
THE RECIPES YOU GREW UP WITH
Cottage pie, corned beef hash, bubble and squeak, Sunday roast, Yorkshire puddings, scones and Victoria sponge: the dishes people actually make at home, written by the people who make them.
IMPORT FROM ANYWHERE, INCLUDING INSTAGRAM AND TIKTOK
Write your own recipes or import your favourites from any website, from Instagram, from TikTok, from a book or from a handwritten notebook. Build your own biggest recipe collection, all in one place.
Tap Share and the recipe is added straight to your collection — ingredients and steps separated, ready to follow. No more screenshots lost in your camera roll. Save them as drafts and finish them whenever you want.
AUTOMATIC TRANSLATION
Find a recipe in Spanish, Italian or Japanese and read it in English: the translation is automatic.
AD-FREE. ALWAYS.
No ads, not even in the free version. No banner to close with flour on your hands, no video starting up while you're reading the measurements.
YOUR DIGITAL RECIPE BOOK, ALL IN ONE PLACE
Your recipe book, recipe keeper and cooking app in one. Save recipes from anywhere and find them in seconds.
• Import & Scan: Import any recipe from a website or a social post in one tap. Snap a photo of a handwritten recipe or a cookbook page: AI turns it into a digital recipe.
• Create with AI: Write your own recipes with the AI Recipe Assistant, without forgetting a single step. Save the draft and finish it whenever you have time.
• Organise & Plan: Sort everything into private folders by theme — chicken, baking, gluten-free, breakfast. Build your weekly menu in a few taps and let your shopping list build itself from your recipes: you only add what's missing.
• Cook What You Have: Cook with what's already in your fridge or cupboard. Save money, use your leftovers and reduce food waste.
FOR EVERY TASTE AND NEED
Healthy lunch ideas, breakfast, easy midweek meals, packed lunches and batch cooking. Comfort food and classics, seasonal veg, and baking from lemon drizzle to sticky toffee pudding — plus cuisines from around the world: Indian, Italian, Thai, Japanese, Chinese.
Filters for vegetarian, vegan, keto, gluten-free, low-carb and baby-led weaning. Tools: air fryer, slow cooker, pressure cooker, bread maker, one-pan and no-bake.
SHARE YOUR COOKING
Share recipes with friends, family and the community — or keep them private, just for you. Upload photos of the dishes you've made (Cooksnaps) and tell everyone how it went. Follow home cooks and food creators from around the world.
JOIN A COMMUNITY THAT COOKS EVERY DAY
For everyone, beginners to experienced cooks.
PREMIUM
With Premium you get even more tools to cook your way:
• The most popular recipes at the top of every search.
• Import unlimited recipes.
• Advanced filters to match every recipe to your preferences.
Premium is available in the United Kingdom and 22 other countries.
Empty the fridge and find tonight's dinner.

name: Love, Manuela
description:
Love, Manuela is a baking app created by Norwegian baker Manuela Kjeilen, known as @passionforbaking. For more than a decade, Manuela has shared her love of baking with people around the world. She has published nine baking books, hosted her own baking show on TV in Sweden, and inspires more than 1.6 million followers on Instagram with her cakes, recipes, and beautiful baking ideas.

Inside the Love, Manuela app, you get instant access to more than 470 baking recipes, all written in English, with high-quality step-by-step photos for every recipe from beginning to end.

One-time purchase. No subscription. New recipes are included when they are added.

For Manuela, taste always comes first. Beautiful cakes are lovely, but the most important thing is that every bite tastes delicious. Her recipes are created to let the flavors shine, with soft textures, creamy fillings, balanced sweetness, and desserts that taste just as good as they look. From everyday treats to celebration cakes, the recipes are made for home baking.

Inside the app, you will find sponge cakes in many variations, ganaches in delicious flavors like strawberry, latte, and banana milkshake, lots of Scandinavian-style cakes, light fillings, cheesecakes, ice creams, sweet dough, frostings, cookies, cupcakes, and so much more.

The app is made to feel like a growing digital baking book that you can return to again and again. It is easy to navigate, with clear recipe categories, improved search and filtering, and helpful tags so you can quickly find what you are looking for. A few more categories have also been added to make browsing even easier.

Each recipe opens with a large photo and a short introduction, followed by clear directions, recipe notes, a place where you can write your own notes, and step-by-step photos that guide you through the recipe. Whether you are baking a cake, preparing a filling, whipping a frosting, or making cookies, the app is designed to help you feel confident in every step.

New Cake Mode helps keep your screen awake while you read and follow a recipe, so you do not have to keep touching your phone or tablet while your hands are busy baking. The app has also been refined with improved UI, a smoother overall user experience, and an improved password reset flow.

Love, Manuela is not a subscription. It is a one-time purchase of $12.99, converted to your local currency by the App Store or Google Play. You get access to all recipes inside the app instantly, and when new recipes are added in the future, they are included at no extra cost.

Your purchase is connected to the store account you buy it with, either App Store or Google Play. You can restore your purchase anytime using the same store account.

What you get inside the app:

More than 470 baking recipes
Recipes written in English only
Clear and easy-to-follow instructions
High-quality step-by-step photos for every recipe
Easy recipe categories
Improved search and filtering
Helpful tags to find recipes faster
A place to write your own notes inside each recipe
Recipe notes and tips from Manuela
Cake Mode to keep your screen awake while baking
Access to new recipes when they are added
One-time purchase on this platform
No subscription

This is not a baking video app. The Love, Manuela app is focused on written recipes, high-quality photos, clear directions, recipe notes, and step-by-step pictures for every recipe. It is created for bakers who love to read, follow, save, and return to recipes whenever they want.

The Love, Manuela app has more than 75,000 registered users worldwide, and Manuela’s recipes are loved by home bakers, cake lovers, professional bakers, and bakeries around the world.

If you love soft cakes, sponge cakes, ganache, creamy frostings, light fillings, cupcakes, cookies, Scandinavian-style baking, sweet dough, cheesecakes, ice creams, and homemade desserts that taste as good as they look, you are going to love the Love, Manuela app.

Happy baking!

XO,
Love, Manuela

description:
Struggle free, healthy recipes that are easy on the wallet. It’s as simple as that, and it’s a message that’s seen over 1 million people follow FitMenCook on social media.

Be honest, have you ever heard these complaints about healthy eating?

- “Eating healthy is too expensive!”
- “It takes too long! I don’t have hours to spend in the kitchen.”
- “Healthy food is too bland”
- “Meal prep is too complicated”

Kevin Curry, founder of FitMenCook, has been there. After spotting a picture of himself on a friend’s Facebook wall he knew it was time for a change.

He followed all the common advice, changed to a healthy diet and started hitting the gym.

For a few months, things were great, but after a while he found himself craving the old foods he was trying so hard to avoid.

He got his hands on every book he could find on nutrition and started experimenting in the kitchen.

His aims were simple:

A) Food should be easy to prepare and affordable
B) Food should be vibrant and tasty, never boring
C) Preparing food in advance is important
D) Following a, b, c helps you achieve your fitness goals

The results were a game changer for Kevin and now he’s sharing that message to the FitMenCook community on social media, inside the FMC app and as a bestselling cookbook author.

Top 5 features:

#1
SHOPPING LIST

We've taken the hassle out of grocery shopping. Add any recipes you want to your shopping list and we'll organise the list by aisle, so you can easily find the items you need.

#2
EASY STEP BY STEP VIDEO INSTRUCTIONS

If you’ve ever looked at recipe instructions and thought “this just looks too difficult for me” then you’ll find the included recipe videos very helpful. Not only is Kevin a great host, who’ll fill you with inspiration for healthy meals, but he’ll also break down the steps in a way that’s easy to follow.

#3
FOCUS ON MEAL PREP

Many of us don’t have time every day to spend in the kitchen.

Meal prep is the solution. Setting aside two days of the week as your main cooking days, you can prepare your meals in bulk and eat healthy all week.

This is a crucial part of the app, and many of the meals are designed with meal preparation in mind, to make healthy living fit with a busy life.

#4
MACRO COUNTING AND INTEGRATION WITH APPLE HEALTH APP

Every recipe includes nutritional information. Calories, protein, carbs, fat and fiber. You can also sync all this data to your Apple Health app.

#5
SCALE UP A RECIPE

Adjust the number of servings s by tapping the + and - buttons in the recipe view. You can also switch the measurements between metric and imperial.

There’s more including:
- Over 1000 recipes
- Search by ingredient: Type in Chicken Rice to see all recipes containing both of these ingredients
- Filter by tags
- Add recipes to favorites
- Add notes to recipes
- Share recipes with friends and family
- Available in English and Spanish

description:
Total Keto Diet is your go-to keto diet app for low carb recipes, keto meals & exercise tracking. 1000s of delicious keto recipes, calorie & macro tracker, exercise & workout tracking, keto community, custom meal plans tailored around you and your goals, keto diet articles, shopping lists & more low carb diet goodness.

Total Keto Diet is made by Tasteaholics, a leading keto diet & low carb recipe resource, with the goal to make your keto diet easier and more achievable.

KETO DIET APP & LOW CARB RECIPE FEATURES:
• Macro Tracker - track your calories & macros every day - being on a low carb diet is easier than ever!
• Custom Meal Plans - tailored to you
• Hundreds of Keto Recipes
• Keto Calculator - get on track with your low carb diet using our keto calculator.
• Truly Low Carb -  our macro tracker includes total or net carbs to make your low carb diet even easier to follow.

• Shopping List – add ingredients from keto recipes or your own ingredients.
• Beginner’s Keto Diet Guide - to help you understand everything about the keto diet and get started with your keto diet immediately.

WHAT IS THE KETO DIET?

The keto diet (also known as a ketogenic diet, low carb diet and LCHF diet) is a low carbohydrate, high-fat diet. Maintaining a low carb diet is great for weight loss. Moreover, according to an increasing number of studies, a low carb diet helps reduce risk factors for diabetes, heart diseases, stroke, Alzheimer’s, epilepsy, and more!

WHY REDUCE CARBS?

We’re beginning to understand that carbs in large quantities are more harmful than previously thought, while most fats are healthy & essential (the basis of a low carb diet).

When you eat lots of carbs, your blood sugar is consistently elevated and, as a result, so is insulin. Insulin is a hormone that keeps your blood sugar in check by shuttling the glucose into cells, but when there’s a consistently high amount of insulin, your cells become resistant.

This insulin resistance makes it easier to store fat, and chronically high levels of insulin also cause excessive inflammation in the body, which contributes to heart disease, high blood pressure and eventually type 2 diabetes.

A keto diet can reverse these harmful effects & restores insulin sensitivity.

THE KETO DIET IS STARTING A NUTRITION REVOLUTION!

The nutritional landscape is changing. The keto diet (low carb diet) is growing in acceptance and a nutritional revolution is beginning. We are starting to realize the detrimental effects of our relationship with excess sugar & carbs.

The keto diet focuses on low carb recipes to keep your blood sugar stable, helping your body regain insulin sensitivity and keeping your mood & energy levels stable. When you’re on a ketogenic diet, you can expect to:
• Lose body fat
• Have consistent energy levels during the day
• Stay satiated after meals longer, less snacking and overeating

THOUSANDS OF LOW CARB DIET & KETO RECIPES!

We’ve included thousands of low carb recipes for you to choose from. 
• Keep carbs low – under 30g a day
• Increase your protein intake
• Keep you full and satiated from delicious meals

name: SuperCook Recipe By Ingredient
description:
How many times have you found yourself looking for that perfect recipe – only to find that you’re missing one or more ingredients?

How many times have you opened the fridge and thought to yourself -- what can I make ?

How many times have you thrown away an ingredient, because you couldn't figure out how to use it before it expired ?

SuperCook to the rescue!

Unlike other recipe apps,  SuperCook only shows you recipes that require the ingredients you already have.  

All the recipes you see on SuperCook  are recipes you can make right now.  No more inconvenient grocery runs for a missing ingredient, at a time when you should be home, with your family and friends

Why purchase new ingredients when you can focus on what you already have?

Here’s how it works:
• For Supercook to do its magic, it needs to know all the ingredients you have at home.
• Visit the pantry page in the SuperCook app and choose from a list of 2000+ ingredients broken down into categories like fruits, vegetables, meats, and many more. 
• Start adding ALL the ingredients you have at home to your SuperCook pantry – including oils, spices, and yes - even that old bottle of Worcestershire sauce in the back of the fridge!
• Sit back and watch SuperCook work its magic by finding recipes that match your ingredients.

SuperCook’s Unique App Features:
 
--Customized Recipe Ideas--
We’ve consolidated over 11 million recipes from 18,000 recipe websites, in 20 languages to create the largest recipe collection ever.   This knowledge was fed into an AI system that learnt the intricacies of all ingredients and how they can be mixed together.

All you have to do is build your pantry on the app – and you’re ready to make delicious meals without ever leaving your house!

SuperCook will find you any recipe you need, whether it’s for breakfast, lunch, dinner, or even a midnight snack.  

--Easily Add Your Ingredients--
Save time and money with an intelligent pantry. SuperCook’s voice dictation mode allows you to quickly add ingredients to your in-app pantry by simply saying them out loud.

Just open your fridge, click the microphone button, and start listing everything inside. The app will automatically add the ingredients to your pantry for a quick and easy way to find recipes!
 
--Automatic Recipe Recommendations--
The app will automatically find you recipes to make with what’s in your fridge – so all those lost ingredients in the back of your cupboard now have a place on your table.  It’s that simple!

When you run out of an ingredient, simply open the SuperCook app and remove it from your pantry -  and all the recipe ideas will adjust accordingly.
 
--Get Creative in the Kitchen--
SuperCook inspires new ideas and activities in the kitchen for new cooks, busy parents, foodies, and pro chefs alike.

With over 11 million recipes available in 20 different languages, SuperCook promises that you’ll never cook the same thing twice (unless you want to, of course!).

--What's on the menu ?--
The menu page is where you'll find all your recipe ideas.  Why is it called menu?  Because just like the menu in a restaurant, everything on the menu page is available to you now.  SuperCook instantly analyzes 11 million recipes and finds the ones that match your unique ingredients.

Most likely your menu page will contain thousands of recipes, but don't worry, we've broken them down into helpful categories like soups and stews, appetizers and snacks, salads, entrees, desserts and more.

--Reduce food waste--
Most people don't realize how much food they throw away every day — from uneaten leftovers to spoiled produce. SuperCook is one of the best ways to reduce food waste in the home.   It finds recipes that use as many of your ingredients as possible, so nothing goes to waste.    SuperCook makes food waste prevention fun and easy, just open the menu page on the app and choose a recipe.   We help you use what you have, so nothing goes to waste!

name: FODMAP & Histamine: InTolerApp
description:
Never worry about intolerances, allergies or other dietary restrictions again. 

You now know in seconds whether you can tolerate a product or not in any situation! No matter whether it's a product, recipe or whatever.

"Perfect and unique app without unnecessary bells and whistles for people with histamine problems. The barcode scanner is great, works quickly and easily when shopping. The ability to scan ingredient lists is particularly noteworthy. Thank you very much" - Symera, App Review

What can the InTolerApp do?
The InTolerApp supports you with all your allergies & intolerances by allowing you to scan barcodes & ingredient lists directly with two practical scanners and immediately see the result / compatibility.

After installation, simply select your intolerances, allergies and other dietary restrictions and get started right away.

You can use the search function to quickly find or look up foods you can tolerate (e.g. fruit, vegetables or spices) or processed foods (e.g. Nutella). You can also give each food its own rating, which then flows directly into the results of the scanner. This means that the InTolerApp is always tailored to you. It is also possible to set products that are tolerable for you, but would be filtered out due to your filters, as tolerable and thus improve your diet step by step. This prevents you from slipping into malnutrition. Special grace period filters also offer you a perfect start after a new diagnosis.

Which intolerances & allergies are supported? 
Basically almost everything is supported, if something is missing, just contact support!
An excerpt:
- Histamine intolerance
- Lactose intolerance
- Fructose intolerance
- Low FODMAP
- gluten
- Sorbitol intolerance
- Xylitol intolerance
- Mannitol intolerance
- Milk allergy
- AlphaGal
- Pork
- Cross allergies (e.g. to grasses or pollen)
- Wheat, barley etc.
- soy
- glutamate
- Oxalic acid
- sulphites
- Nuts of all kinds
- Flavor enhancers 
- sweeteners
- all other important allergens

Also filters for vegetarians, vegans and pescetarians.

Many other filters and settings. If a list is missing, I will be happy to add it shortly.

Who is behind the app?
My name is Jonah and unfortunately I have been suffering from histamine intolerance for several years. For this reason, I developed the app for myself to make my everyday life easier, as there was no good app available before. In the meantime, after a successful histamine diet with a phase of restriction and build-up, I feel much better and I can eat almost anything again without having to worry about symptoms (you can find an explanation of how to do this in the app). When I uploaded the app to the App Store, the feedback was so positive and good that I got even more involved with it and delved deeper into the technical and nutritional aspects. The result is the InTolerApp version 2.0. 

If you have any questions or problems, you can contact me at any time by email at mail@intoler.app or by WhatsApp at +49 231 86443177. I look forward to your message!

name: Love, Manuela
description:
Love, Manuela is a baking app created by Norwegian baker Manuela Kjeilen, known as @passionforbaking. For more than a decade, Manuela has shared her love of baking with people around the world. She has published nine baking books, hosted her own baking show on TV in Sweden, and inspires more than 1.6 million followers on Instagram with her cakes, recipes, and beautiful baking ideas.

Inside the Love, Manuela app, you get instant access to more than 470 baking recipes, all written in English, with high-quality step-by-step photos for every recipe from beginning to end.

One-time purchase. No subscription. New recipes are included when they are added.

For Manuela, taste always comes first. Beautiful cakes are lovely, but the most important thing is that every bite tastes delicious. Her recipes are created to let the flavors shine, with soft textures, creamy fillings, balanced sweetness, and desserts that taste just as good as they look. From everyday treats to celebration cakes, the recipes are made for home baking.

Inside the app, you will find sponge cakes in many variations, ganaches in delicious flavors like strawberry, latte, and banana milkshake, lots of Scandinavian-style cakes, light fillings, cheesecakes, ice creams, sweet dough, frostings, cookies, cupcakes, and so much more.

The app is made to feel like a growing digital baking book that you can return to again and again. It is easy to navigate, with clear recipe categories, improved search and filtering, and helpful tags so you can quickly find what you are looking for. A few more categories have also been added to make browsing even easier.

Each recipe opens with a large photo and a short introduction, followed by clear directions, recipe notes, a place where you can write your own notes, and step-by-step photos that guide you through the recipe. Whether you are baking a cake, preparing a filling, whipping a frosting, or making cookies, the app is designed to help you feel confident in every step.

New Cake Mode helps keep your screen awake while you read and follow a recipe, so you do not have to keep touching your phone or tablet while your hands are busy baking. The app has also been refined with improved UI, a smoother overall user experience, and an improved password reset flow.

Love, Manuela is not a subscription. It is a one-time purchase of $12.99, converted to your local currency by the App Store or Google Play. You get access to all recipes inside the app instantly, and when new recipes are added in the future, they are included at no extra cost.

Your purchase is connected to the store account you buy it with, either App Store or Google Play. You can restore your purchase anytime using the same store account.

What you get inside the app:

More than 470 baking recipes
Recipes written in English only
Clear and easy-to-follow instructions
High-quality step-by-step photos for every recipe
Easy recipe categories
Improved search and filtering
Helpful tags to find recipes faster
A place to write your own notes inside each recipe
Recipe notes and tips from Manuela
Cake Mode to keep your screen awake while baking
Access to new recipes when they are added
One-time purchase on this platform
No subscription

This is not a baking video app. The Love, Manuela app is focused on written recipes, high-quality photos, clear directions, recipe notes, and step-by-step pictures for every recipe. It is created for bakers who love to read, follow, save, and return to recipes whenever they want.

The Love, Manuela app has more than 75,000 registered users worldwide, and Manuela’s recipes are loved by home bakers, cake lovers, professional bakers, and bakeries around the world.

If you love soft cakes, sponge cakes, ganache, creamy frostings, light fillings, cupcakes, cookies, Scandinavian-style baking, sweet dough, cheesecakes, ice creams, and homemade desserts that taste as good as they look, you are going to love the Love, Manuela app.

Happy baking!

XO,
Love, Manuela

name: Balanced Roots Nutrition App
description:

The Balanced Roots Nutrition App is a dietitian-designed meal planning app built around one simple method: the 90-30-50 method. At least 90g of protein, 30g of fiber and 50g of healthy anti-inflammatory fat every single day. When you consistently hit these three minimums, maintaining a calorie deficit, balancing hormones, stabilizing blood sugar and losing weight sustainably becomes effortless...without restriction, without obsession and without starting over every Monday.

Created by Courtney Kassis, Registered Dietitian, this app gives you everything you need to finally bridge the gap between knowing what to eat and actually doing it consistently.
WHAT'S INSIDE:

Dietitian-Created Structured Programs — Every meal and snack planned for you by a registered dietitian. Each program is built around the 90-30-50 method so your protein, fiber and healthy fat minimums are hit automatically every single day. No guesswork. No planning. Just follow the plan.

Auto-Generated Grocery List — Your full week of ingredients organized and ready. Shop once. Eat well all week. Never stand in the grocery store wondering what to buy again.

Recipe Swap Feature — Don't love what's on the plan? Swap it with one tap from the growing recipe library. Your grocery list and macros update automatically. The method stays intact. The meal changes.

Automatic Tracking — Calories, protein, fiber, fat and carbs are tracked automatically as you follow your program. Calories are visible for awareness, but they are never the focus. Hitting your 90-30-50 minimums is.

Growing Recipe Library — A database of 90-30-50 approved recipes added weekly. Every recipe is designed to be delicious, satisfying and built around real whole food ingredients. New recipes every week. Your subscription stays the same.

Community Platform — Connect with others following the method. Share wins, ask for support and stay consistent with a community that understands the journey.

Learn Section — Articles, blogs and education written by a registered dietitian to help you understand the method, apply it to everyday life and maintain it long term.

COMING SOON: New programs added regularly, including seasonal resets, blood sugar balancing, hormone health, autoimmune support, plant-based options and more. One subscription. Everything included. Forever.

THE 90-30-50 METHOD: The 90-30-50 method was developed and tested by Courtney Kassis, RD, through her own health journey, including losing 55 lbs postpartum and putting her Hashimoto's thyroiditis into remission through nutrition alone.

The method is simple. Every day hit a minimum of 90g of protein, 30g of fiber and 50g of healthy anti-inflammatory fat. When these three minimums are consistently met your body gets everything it needs to feel full, reduce cravings, balance hormones, stabilize blood sugar and lose weight sustainably without restriction, without calorie obsession and without white-knuckling through your day.

Not a diet. No starting over. Just minimums. And when you hit them consistently, everything changes.
For anyone who is tired of starting over. Built by a dietitian who was too.

- “Eating healthy is too expensive!”
- “It takes too long! I don’t have hours to spend in the kitchen.”
- “Healthy food is too bland”
- “Meal prep is too complicated”

Kevin Curry, founder of FitMenCook, has been there. After spotting a picture of himself on a friend’s Facebook wall he knew it was time for a change.

He followed all the common advice, changed to a healthy diet and started hitting the gym.

For a few months, things were great, but after a while he found himself craving the old foods he was trying so hard to avoid.

He got his hands on every book he could find on nutrition and started experimenting in the kitchen.

His aims were simple:

A) Food should be easy to prepare and affordable
B) Food should be vibrant and tasty, never boring
C) Preparing food in advance is important
D) Following a, b, c helps you achieve your fitness goals

The results were a game changer for Kevin and now he’s sharing that message to the FitMenCook community on social media, inside the FMC app and as a bestselling cookbook author.

Top 5 features:

#1
SHOPPING LIST

We've taken the hassle out of grocery shopping. Add any recipes you want to your shopping list and we'll organise the list by aisle, so you can easily find the items you need.

#2
EASY STEP BY STEP VIDEO INSTRUCTIONS

If you’ve ever looked at recipe instructions and thought “this just looks too difficult for me” then you’ll find the included recipe videos very helpful. Not only is Kevin a great host, who’ll fill you with inspiration for healthy meals, but he’ll also break down the steps in a way that’s easy to follow.

#3
FOCUS ON MEAL PREP

Many of us don’t have time every day to spend in the kitchen.

Meal prep is the solution. Setting aside two days of the week as your main cooking days, you can prepare your meals in bulk and eat healthy all week.

This is a crucial part of the app, and many of the meals are designed with meal preparation in mind, to make healthy living fit with a busy life.

#4
MACRO COUNTING AND INTEGRATION WITH APPLE HEALTH APP

Every recipe includes nutritional information. Calories, protein, carbs, fat and fiber. You can also sync all this data to your Apple Health app.

#5
SCALE UP A RECIPE

Adjust the number of servings s by tapping the + and - buttons in the recipe view. You can also switch the measurements between metric and imperial.

name: THISBOWL: Fresh Food, Fast
description:
THISBOWL (formerly FISHBOWL) is a fast-casual food brand making fresh, asian-inspired bowls — with a side of everything we're obsessed with: design, music, art, fashion, movement and community. We’re on a mission to change the culture of fast food, one bowl at a time. We make healthy food you’ll crave, made fast, from whole, fresh, minimally processed ingredients. Yep, our Culinary Dept. cut and process all the veg for ~60 stores across Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane and Gold Coast. Every single day, seven days / week.

Better yet, every bowl is gluten-free and dairy-free as standard. We’ve got halal-friendly, vegan, vegetarian, and even picky eater options across our menu too.

What’s in a bowl? Good question friend. 

* Start with your base – mixed leaves, sushi rice, brown rice or cabbage.
* Choose your veg – kale, bok choy, beets, carrot, onion to name a few.
* Add protein into the mix – poached chicken, slow-cooked beef, miso-glazed salmon fillet, salmon sashimi, miso-glazed eggplant or roasted tofu.
* Toss in our house dressings – think miso, sesame, tamari, shoyu – with a fresh, modern twist.
* Top it off with crunch – how does house tamari almonds or umami cashew crunch sound?

Build your own bowl with only the ingredients you like or go with one of our tried and tested house favourite bowls or boxes. Diehard fans love THE O.G, BEEF BRISKET and SPICY SALMON. A cheeky HOUSE SODA on the side is the perfect pairing (no lie).

Why get the THISBOWL app?

* Order ahead — pre-order for pickup and smugly skip the queue or get it delivered to you.
* Track your order in real time — you’ll know the moment your order hits our kitchens and we’ll send you a notification when your bowl is ready for you.
* Earn rewards with your healthy habits – Earn 10 points per $1 spent, hit 2000 points and your next bowl is on us. Unlock more rewards with every challenge you complete.
* Member perks – get first access to new seasonal menu drops, secret menu, limited merch, birthday surprises and exclusive offers.

We take allergies seriously — tell us when you order and we’ll take extra care. Because of our open kitchen and supply chain, we can't guarantee any item is 100% allergen-free — check our allergen matrix online for more info.

Find us on Instagram and TikTok @thisbowl_au, or give us a shout at thisbowl.com.

name: HelloFresh: Meal Kit & Recipes
description:
The #1 meal kit app in the app store! Loved by thousands for weekly meal delivery of easy recipes and fresh ingredients. With HelloFresh, you can enjoy convenient cooking with a menu of 33+ delicious recipes available each week. It’s meal prep made easy!

Keep your cost of living down (and your bank balance in the green!) without missing out on easy, delicious food – every week! With scrumptious recipes, quality food, convenient cooking and your weekly meal prep sorted, HelloFresh is so much more than just a meal planner. It’s the meal kit you need to level up your food prep game, all at a great price!

HOW DOES HELLOFRESH WORK?
- Plan your perfect menu: With our meal planner, you know exactly what easy meals are coming up on your menu. Select from a variety of delicious recipes, from dinnertime classics to globally-inspired favourites, with the flexibility to tailor your food to suit your needs; from vegetarian and vegan recipes to Calorie Smart and Carb Smart meals and more. Make every recipe your own with options to swap ingredients or double the protein. 
- Meal prep delivered: Get all the fresh, pre-portioned ingredients you need in every meal kit, with delivery straight to your door.
- Cook delicious and fresh food: It’s never been easier to meal prep and fill your diet with great tasting cooking and easy meals. Customise the size of your fresh box to feed everyone at the table, and cook with easy, step-by-step recipes every time.

WHY SHOULD YOU USE HELLOFRESH?
We know how tedious and stressful grocery shopping, meal planning, meal prep and cooking is. Between rising prices, shrinkflation and sticker shock, food shopping at the supermarket these days is a recipe for disaster for you and your wallet.

That’s why we take the stress out of meal prep with our easy, fresh and simply delicious meal kits. So you can spend less time on prep and cooking, and more time doing the things you love – like enjoying delicious food!
- We create tasty recipes: Every week, our cooks create delicious, easy recipes, using fresh, seasonal ingredients. Enjoy meals full of the flavours you love, with easy classics, adventurous global fusions and more, HelloFresh has a meal to suit everyone.
- We do the shopping for you: Tired of wasting time and money on food shopping at the grocery store? We’ll be your meal planner and shopper, and get all the ingredients and recipes you need to you in a convenient weekly meal kit delivery.
- Delivery to you: Choose a day that works for you, and we’ll organise your fresh food delivery straight to your door. So easy! Our top-quality packaging makes sure your ingredients stay fresh all day, so you don’t need to be home at the time of delivery.
- Cooking you’ll love: With our easy recipes, you won’t need any fancy equipment or complex techniques. Prep and cooking are a breeze so you’ll be tucking into delicious food in no time!

WHAT WILL YOU FIND ON THE HELLOFRESH APP?
- A menu of 33+ recipes every week, with options to add or upgrade ingredients, update your dietary preferences and change your meal kit size to make each dish suit you.
- Step-by-step recipes for each dish, including a handy built-in timer that makes your prep and cooking easier.
- A flexible online account where you can choose your meals, change your fresh box size or pause, skip a week or cancel at any time.
- When you finish with your meal kit, you can sync the nutritional info with your Health app.

MORE THAN MEALS
With a delicious range of upgrade recipes available in HelloFresh’s meal kits, including Gourmet meals and food for more meal occasions like Sides, Brunch and Desserts – prep and cooking delicious food for any occasion has never been so easy!

Features

- Meal planning function.
- Shopping list formulation.

name: Love, Manuela
description:
Love, Manuela is a baking app created by Norwegian baker Manuela Kjeilen, known as @passionforbaking. For more than a decade, Manuela has shared her love of baking with people around the world. She has published nine baking books, hosted her own baking show on TV in Sweden, and inspires more than 1.6 million followers on Instagram with her cakes, recipes, and beautiful baking ideas.

Inside the Love, Manuela app, you get instant access to more than 470 baking recipes, all written in English, with high-quality step-by-step photos for every recipe from beginning to end.

One-time purchase. No subscription. New recipes are included when they are added.

For Manuela, taste always comes first. Beautiful cakes are lovely, but the most important thing is that every bite tastes delicious. Her recipes are created to let the flavors shine, with soft textures, creamy fillings, balanced sweetness, and desserts that taste just as good as they look. From everyday treats to celebration cakes, the recipes are made for home baking.

Inside the app, you will find sponge cakes in many variations, ganaches in delicious flavors like strawberry, latte, and banana milkshake, lots of Scandinavian-style cakes, light fillings, cheesecakes, ice creams, sweet dough, frostings, cookies, cupcakes, and so much more.

The app is made to feel like a growing digital baking book that you can return to again and again. It is easy to navigate, with clear recipe categories, improved search and filtering, and helpful tags so you can quickly find what you are looking for. A few more categories have also been added to make browsing even easier.

Each recipe opens with a large photo and a short introduction, followed by clear directions, recipe notes, a place where you can write your own notes, and step-by-step photos that guide you through the recipe. Whether you are baking a cake, preparing a filling, whipping a frosting, or making cookies, the app is designed to help you feel confident in every step.

New Cake Mode helps keep your screen awake while you read and follow a recipe, so you do not have to keep touching your phone or tablet while your hands are busy baking. The app has also been refined with improved UI, a smoother overall user experience, and an improved password reset flow.

Love, Manuela is not a subscription. It is a one-time purchase of $12.99, converted to your local currency by the App Store or Google Play. You get access to all recipes inside the app instantly, and when new recipes are added in the future, they are included at no extra cost.

Your purchase is connected to the store account you buy it with, either App Store or Google Play. You can restore your purchase anytime using the same store account.

What you get inside the app:

More than 470 baking recipes
Recipes written in English only
Clear and easy-to-follow instructions
High-quality step-by-step photos for every recipe
Easy recipe categories
Improved search and filtering
Helpful tags to find recipes faster
A place to write your own notes inside each recipe
Recipe notes and tips from Manuela
Cake Mode to keep your screen awake while baking
Access to new recipes when they are added
One-time purchase on this platform
No subscription

This is not a baking video app. The Love, Manuela app is focused on written recipes, high-quality photos, clear directions, recipe notes, and step-by-step pictures for every recipe. It is created for bakers who love to read, follow, save, and return to recipes whenever they want.

The Love, Manuela app has more than 75,000 registered users worldwide, and Manuela’s recipes are loved by home bakers, cake lovers, professional bakers, and bakeries around the world.

If you love soft cakes, sponge cakes, ganache, creamy frostings, light fillings, cupcakes, cookies, Scandinavian-style baking, sweet dough, cheesecakes, ice creams, and homemade desserts that taste as good as they look, you are going to love the Love, Manuela app.

Happy baking!

XO,
Love, Manuela

name: Weber Connect
description:
The Weber Connect app is your secret ingredient to smart barbecuing!

Weber Connect is the companion app to Weber smart barbecues and devices. When paired to a Weber Connect barbecue or device, the app becomes your sensor dashboard, remote control and recipe book all in one!

Track temperatures from anywhere

The temperature of your barbecue is important. Weber Connect barbecues and devices can track your barbecue's temperature and alert you when it drops below your target temp due to a flameout or spikes because of a flareup. With the Weber Connect app, you can follow its temperature and get alerts for important events.
Even more important is the temperature of your food! A few degrees are all that stand between perfect and overdone. Weber Connect barbecues and devices let you track your food's internal temperature precisely with connected food probes and transmit them to your app. Watch the temp rise on the graph so you know when it's almost time to head back outside to take the steaks off or set a target temp and get alerted when it's done no matter where you are.

Adjust the barbecue without getting up from the couch

Some Weber barbecues, like the SmokeFire, can have their cook temperature and mode changed by the app. That means you can turn the heat up, go into SmokeBoost mode or shut down your barbecue without taking your eyes off the game.

Never wonder what to make for dinner again

The Weber Connect app has over 800 built-in recipes, with more being published every month. Every recipe has been crafted and tested by Weber Grill Masters, and many are fan favourites, so you know you can't go wrong with any of them! And almost half of our recipes are Smart Recipes, which walk you through, step-by-step, with short looping videos and clear instructions so you know when you're doing it right. Barbecuing has never been easier or more fun!

The new Weber Connect 2.0 app has the important features of the original app:

 • Remote temperature monitoring

name: SuperCook Recipe By Ingredient
description:
How many times have you found yourself looking for that perfect recipe – only to find that you’re missing one or more ingredients?

How many times have you opened the fridge and thought to yourself -- what can I make ?

How many times have you thrown away an ingredient, because you couldn't figure out how to use it before it expired ?

SuperCook to the rescue!

Unlike other recipe apps,  SuperCook only shows you recipes that require the ingredients you already have.  

All the recipes you see on SuperCook  are recipes you can make right now.  No more inconvenient grocery runs for a missing ingredient, at a time when you should be home, with your family and friends

Why purchase new ingredients when you can focus on what you already have?

Here’s how it works:
• For Supercook to do its magic, it needs to know all the ingredients you have at home.
• Visit the pantry page in the SuperCook app and choose from a list of 2000+ ingredients broken down into categories like fruits, vegetables, meats, and many more. 
• Start adding ALL the ingredients you have at home to your SuperCook pantry – including oils, spices, and yes - even that old bottle of Worcestershire sauce in the back of the fridge!
• Sit back and watch SuperCook work its magic by finding recipes that match your ingredients.

SuperCook’s Unique App Features:
 
--Customized Recipe Ideas--
We’ve consolidated over 11 million recipes from 18,000 recipe websites, in 20 languages to create the largest recipe collection ever.   This knowledge was fed into an AI system that learnt the intricacies of all ingredients and how they can be mixed together.

All you have to do is build your pantry on the app – and you’re ready to make delicious meals without ever leaving your house!

SuperCook will find you any recipe you need, whether it’s for breakfast, lunch, dinner, or even a midnight snack.  

--Easily Add Your Ingredients--
Save time and money with an intelligent pantry. SuperCook’s voice dictation mode allows you to quickly add ingredients to your in-app pantry by simply saying them out loud.

Just open your fridge, click the microphone button, and start listing everything inside. The app will automatically add the ingredients to your pantry for a quick and easy way to find recipes!
 
--Automatic Recipe Recommendations--
The app will automatically find you recipes to make with what’s in your fridge – so all those lost ingredients in the back of your cupboard now have a place on your table.  It’s that simple!

When you run out of an ingredient, simply open the SuperCook app and remove it from your pantry -  and all the recipe ideas will adjust accordingly.
 
--Get Creative in the Kitchen--
SuperCook inspires new ideas and activities in the kitchen for new cooks, busy parents, foodies, and pro chefs alike.

With over 11 million recipes available in 20 different languages, SuperCook promises that you’ll never cook the same thing twice (unless you want to, of course!).

--What's on the menu ?--
The menu page is where you'll find all your recipe ideas.  Why is it called menu?  Because just like the menu in a restaurant, everything on the menu page is available to you now.  SuperCook instantly analyzes 11 million recipes and finds the ones that match your unique ingredients.

Most likely your menu page will contain thousands of recipes, but don't worry, we've broken them down into helpful categories like soups and stews, appetizers and snacks, salads, entrees, desserts and more.

--Reduce food waste--
Most people don't realize how much food they throw away every day — from uneaten leftovers to spoiled produce. SuperCook is one of the best ways to reduce food waste in the home.   It finds recipes that use as many of your ingredients as possible, so nothing goes to waste.    SuperCook makes food waste prevention fun and easy, just open the menu page on the app and choose a recipe.   We help you use what you have, so nothing goes to waste!

name: Recipe Keeper
description:
Recipe Keeper is the easy to use, all-in-one recipe organizer, shopping list and meal planner available across all of your devices.

ADD RECIPES QUICKLY AND EASILY
Enter your recipes with as much or as little information as you like. Copy and paste recipes from your existing documents or apps. Categorize your recipes by course and category. Add photos, rate your recipes and flag your favorites.

IMPORT RECIPES FROM WEBSITES
Search for recipes on the web and add them straight to your collection. Hundreds of popular recipe websites supported. Customize imported recipes to suit your needs.

SCAN FROM COOKBOOKS, MAGAZINES AND HANDWRITTEN RECIPES
Scan recipes using your phone's camera or from your existing photos and PDF files. OCR technology automatically converts images to text. Keep all your favorite family recipes safe forever.

FIND ANY RECIPE INSTANTLY
Quickly lookup your recipes by name, ingredient or directions or simply browse your recipes by course, category and rating. Got leftovers in the fridge? Search for a recipe to use them up. Cook more of your favorite meals and rediscover those long-forgotten recipes to make mealtimes interesting again.

SHARE RECIPES WITH FRIENDS AND FAMILY
Share your recipes by email and to your favorite social networks. Create a shared family recipe collection. Add recipes from other Recipe Keeper users with a single tap.

CREATE BEAUTIFUL COOKBOOKS
Create cookbooks from your recipes for printing or sharing as a PDF with cover page, table of contents, custom layouts and more.

UNEXPECTED GUESTS?
Adjust a recipe serving size up or down and let Recipe Keeper automatically recalculate your ingredients for you.

PLAN AHEAD AND STAY IN CONTROL
Integrated weekly and monthly meal planner allows you to plan your meals in advance. Add all your meals to your shopping list in one step. Recipe Keeper can even create a random meal plan for you based on your hints and suggestions. Get rid of that "what should I cook tonight?" feeling.

MAKE SHOPPING SIMPLER
Fully featured shopping list that automatically groups your items by aisle. Save money by only buying what you need. No more trips back to the store for that one thing you forgot.

AVAILABLE ACROSS ALL OF YOUR DEVICES
Share your recipes, shopping lists and meal planner across all your iPhones, iPads, Macs, PCs and other mobile and tablet devices (separate purchase required for other platforms).

"ALEXA, ASK RECIPE KEEPER FOR COOKIE RECIPES."
Search your recipes, cook hands-free with step-by-step instructions and add items to your shopping list using the Recipe Keeper skill for Amazon Alexa, (English language only).

TRANSFER YOUR EXISTING RECIPES
Transfer your recipes from other apps such as Living Cookbook, MasterCook, MacGourmet, BigOven, Cook'n, My Cookbook, My Recipe Book, Paprika Recipe Manager, Pepperplate, OrganizEat, Recipe Box and many more.

AND MORE!
• Choose from 25 different color schemes, light & dark modes
• Format recipes using bold and italics
• Customizable recipe collections, courses and categories
• Add nutrition information and search for recipes by nutritional amounts
• Check off ingredients while cooking, highlight the current direction
• Adjustable text size when viewing recipes - great for reading recipes across the kitchen
• Convert recipes between US/Imperial and Metric units
• Link related recipes together
• Add links to online videos
• Pin your favorite recipes to the home screen for quick access
• Works offline - take your recipes with you wherever you go
• Bulk update multiple recipes at once
• Screen lock disabled while viewing recipes - no more messy fingers on screen trying to wake your device
• Available in 15 languages

GREAT SUPPORT
We love hearing from you! If you need any help, have a question, or want to suggest a new feature, please email us at support@tudorspan.com

Cook more. Eat healthier. Shop smarter. Try Recipe Keeper free today!

name: WeChef - Recipe Journal
description:
DISCOVER WECHEF: YOUR ALL-IN-ONE RECIPE & MEAL COMPANION

WeChef transforms the way you cook, plan, and explore new dishes. From turning leftovers into something exciting, to saving recipes from the web, or organizing meals for special occasions – WeChef makes cooking easier, more fun, and stress-free. It’s your go-to partner for creating tasty, well-organized, and unforgettable meals.

SEARCH RECIPES BY INGREDIENTS
Turn your fridge into inspiration! Just enter what you have on hand, and WeChef will suggest creative recipes that help you minimize waste and maximize flavor. From veggies sitting in the fridge to random pantry staples – transform them into meals you’ll actually love. Cooking smarter has never been this easy.

IMPORT RECIPES FROM THE WEB
Spotted a great recipe online? Simply paste the link into WeChef, and it will pull in the ingredients, steps, and photos for you. Build your own personalized recipe library with favorites from across the web and keep everything organized in one place. Never lose track of your go-to recipes again!

DIGITIZE RECIPES WITH THE SCANNER
Bring your handwritten notes, cookbooks, or magazine clippings into the digital age. With WeChef’s smart OCR scanner, you can convert family recipes or PDFs into editable, searchable text – and keep those culinary treasures safe forever, accessible anytime, anywhere.

MOOD-BASED RECIPE SUGGESTIONS
Not sure what you’re craving? Just tell WeChef how you feel, and get recipe ideas that match your mood. Comfort food, quick & healthy bites, or festive treats – WeChef’s smart algorithm makes sure you always land on the perfect dish.

SIMPLIFIED MEAL PLANNING
Plan your meals like a pro! Add recipes to your calendar, generate shopping lists, and even set reminders so dinner is always on time. Whether you’re prepping for the week or planning a family feast, WeChef keeps everything organized and stress-free.

SURPRISE MODE FOR ADVENTUROUS COOKS
Feeling spontaneous? Let WeChef surprise you with a random recipe! Explore new cuisines, rediscover old favorites, and add some excitement to your meals. Who knows what delicious adventure awaits?

EFFORTLESS PORTION ADJUSTMENTS
Cooking for one or feeding a crowd? WeChef automatically adjusts recipe quantities for perfect portions every time. No more guessing or wasted ingredients – just accurate, reliable measurements tailored to your needs.

INTERACTIVE RECIPE ORGANIZER
Save and organize your recipes beautifully. Sort by type, occasion, or rating, add personal notes and photos, and find your favorites in seconds. Your collection has never looked this good – or been this easy to use.

ADVANCED RECIPE SEARCH
Looking for something specific? Search by name, ingredient, category, or dietary need. Whether it’s a gluten-free dinner, a quick breakfast, or a clever way to use leftovers, WeChef helps you find exactly what you need in no time.

WHY CHOOSE WECHEF
WeChef isn’t just another recipe app – it’s your personal kitchen assistant. From inspiration and planning to cooking and sharing, it makes every step of the journey easier, more fun, and more delicious. Say goodbye to the daily “What’s for dinner?” struggle, and hello to endless possibilities.

WE’D LOVE YOUR FEEDBACK
Your opinion helps us grow! Share your ideas, suggestions, or feedback at support@wechef.site and help shape the future of WeChef. Together, we’ll make cooking even more inspiring and stress-free.

Start your 7-day FREE TRIAL today!

OVER 1500 SIMPLE RECIPES

It’s easy to search for, filter and save over 1500 delicious, nutritious recipes for every age and stage. You’ll NEVER be stuck for mealtime inspiration again. Plus, enjoy a fresh batch of recipes from Annabel’s kitchen every week.
